fdroid:ch.cryptobit.letterbox.name: LetterBox
fdroid:ch.cryptobit.letterbox.summary: Learn letters with animal pictures: a simple, offline game for young children
fdroid:ch.cryptobit.letterbox.description:
LetterBox is a game for young children who are learning their letters. It shows a picture, usually an animal, and three letters. Tap the letter the word starts with. Tap the picture to hear its name; after a correct answer, the name is spoken aloud as well.
After a wrong answer, the same picture comes back so your child can try again. There are no scores, timers, or penalties.
 Features 
 Nine languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese (hiragana), and Korean (hangul). The language can be changed in the menu, independently of the system language.
 About 90 pictures, with several pictures for many letters, so rounds stay varied.
 A second game mode: a letter is shown and your child picks the picture whose name starts with it.
 Practise a selection of letters: all of them, the ten most common, or just one.
 Optional progress tracking: letters your child knows well come up less often. Progress fades gently after a few weeks without practice, so forgotten letters return.
 Works with a physical keyboard: press 1, 2, or 3, or the letter itself.
 The menu button can be hidden until the app is closed, so small hands do not change settings by accident. Press and hold the top-right corner to bring it back.
 Privacy 
LetterBox requests no permissions and has no internet access. There are no ads and no tracking. Progress is stored only on the device and is excluded from cloud backups.

fdroid:com.aidinhut.simpletextcrypt.name: Simple Text Crypt
fdroid:com.aidinhut.simpletextcrypt.description:
This app does not claim any permissions, so you can trust that it cannot send
any of your private data to anyone.
Messages produced by this app are secure and, for example, can be
confidently sent over a network. It uses AES in GCM mode with no padding for
encryption. It uses Argon2 and a random Salt to derive a secure key from the
entered passphrase.
This is a very powerful encryption. It also encrypts its settings before storing
them on the device.
However, the app might be vulnerable to some attacks. Although it is secure
enough to stand attacks from non-expert crackers, e.g. normal users,
should not be used for serious data encryption.
 Upgrading from 4.x to 5.x 
The encryption of the settings is changed. The app should be able to detect the
old settings and upgrade them with the new encryption algorithm. However, it's
a good idea to back-up your passphrase . (Well, it's generally a good idea to
back-up encryption keys and passwords in a secure place).
If the app didn't work after upgrade, uninstall and install it again.

fdroid:io.github.acidefluorhydrique.v2ra.name: Forkray
fdroid:io.github.acidefluorhydrique.v2ra.summary: A V2Ray client for Android, forked from v2rayNG and built from source
fdroid:io.github.acidefluorhydrique.v2ra.description:
Forkray is a fork of v2rayNG , the V2Ray client for Android, supporting Xray core . It follows every upstream v2rayNG release and keeps its features and settings.
 How it differs from v2rayNG Built entirely from source on public CI, including the Xray core, which upstream downloads as a prebuilt library. Every release publishes the exact sources, toolchain and checksums used, so it can be rebuilt and compared byte for byte.
 Its own application ID, so it installs alongside v2rayNG rather than replacing it.
 No in-app update check (your F-Droid client handles updates) and no promotion link.
 Never switches to a direct connection silently. v2rayNG fetches subscriptions and other data directly, from your real IP address, whenever the proxy fails, even in the background. Forkray skips background updates while disconnected, tells you when it has to connect directly, and asks before retrying without the proxy.
 Routing databases built from freely licensed sources in forkray-geodata , instead of prebuilt downloads.
 Geoip and Geosite The bundled geoip.dat and geosite.dat come from v2fly/domain-list-community, gfwlist, china-operator-ip, DB-IP Lite and the address ranges operators publish. IP Geolocation by DB-IP .
 They are in Android/data/io.github.acidefluorhydrique.v2rayng/files/assets (the path may differ on some devices).
 The download feature fetches the larger lists from Loyalsoldier/v2ray-rules-dat instead, through your proxy when it is running.
Source code and issues: github.com/AcideFluorhydrique/v2rayNG . Documentation for the shared features: the v2rayNG wiki .

fdroid:space.subread.anki.name: SubRead Anki
fdroid:space.subread.anki.summary: Select a word in any app: an Anki card with its sentence, picture and sound
fdroid:space.subread.anki.description:
SubRead Anki is a pop-up for Anki cards, used the same way as a dictionary. Select a text in any app and choose "SubRead Anki" in the text selection menu. The pop-up shows the text and the terms at the word. Tap "＋ Anki": the card goes into AnkiDroid with the word, its reading and definition, the sentence around the word, a picture of the screen and the sound of the sentence. It is made for people who read and listen in a language that they learn.
 What it does 
* Works in each app that lets you select a text: readers, browsers, OCR apps.
* A tap on a character of the text moves the word there, so one selection gives cards for several words.
* The reading, the definition and the word audio come from SubRead Dictionary.
* The capture keeps the sound of the device and the newest picture of the screen while it is on. The card gets the screen of the moment you selected the text, and the sound of the seconds before it: the audiobook that plays while you read. A tile in the quick settings starts and stops it.
* With SubRead Overlay, a subtitle word shows its whole line, and the card gets the sound of that line.
* Another app, or a link on a web page, can send a whole card: word, sentence, audio and its times, picture.
* Works with the Lapis note type, the basic note types, or its own.
* Black on white and nothing that moves: usable on an e-ink screen.
 Permissions 
* AnkiDroid: to add the cards.
* Screen capture and the microphone permission: for the sound of the player and the picture of the screen, only while the capture is on. Android asks each time it starts. No microphone is recorded.
* Internet: only for an audio or a picture at a URL that a sender gives.
Nothing leaves the device.

apple-macos:1214399336.name: iMyVoice: AAC Communication
apple-macos:1214399336.description:
iMyVoice turns an iPhone, iPad or Mac into a voice for people who cannot rely on speech — children with autism or apraxia, adults recovering from a stroke, anyone whose words do not come easily.
Build a communication board, tap a cell, and the app speaks.
OVER 12,000 BUILT-IN SYMBOLS
Find a symbol by typing a word in the app's language. When the built-in symbol is not the right one, use your own photo or a video from your library. iMyVoice is available in English, Hebrew, Russian and Romanian.
BOARDS THAT FIT THE PERSON
Pick a layout, from one large cell up to a 5×5 page. Set the background colour, border colour and width, text size and weight for each cell, with the text above or below the picture. Link cells to other pages, to a video or to YouTube, so the vocabulary grows with its user.
VISUAL SCENES
Use a real photograph — a kitchen, a classroom, a family picture — and place hotspots directly on it. For many people, pointing at a scene they recognise is far easier than navigating a grid of symbols.
REAL VOICES, NOT JUST SYNTHETIC ONES
Speak with the system voices at whatever rate suits the user, or record a human voice for any cell — a parent's voice, a sibling's, the user's own from before. Each tap speaks the word and adds it to the sentence bar.
FOR FAMILIES, THERAPISTS AND CLASSROOMS
With a subscription, separate profiles keep each user's boards apart. Boards and users share by AirDrop, so what you build at a clinic arrives at home intact.
ACCESSIBLE
The board, the sentence bar and the symbol pickers work with VoiceOver, and animations respect Reduce Motion.
WHO USES IT
Families, speech and language therapists, special education teachers, and rehabilitation clinics working with autism, apraxia of speech, aphasia, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, stroke and traumatic brain injury.
FREE AND SUBSCRIPTION
Free: one user, up to 3 pages and 5 links, with the full symbol library. The iMyVoice subscription unlocks unlimited users, pages and links.

• The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Flexible layer system
Artstudio Pro introduces a new layer system with grouping, non-destructive layer effects, and adjustment layers.
• Groups
• Masks, clipping masks
• Adjustment layers
• 9 layer effects: Bevel/Emboss, Stroke, Inner Shadow, Inner Glow, Outer Glow, Color/Gradient/Pattern Overlay, Drop Shadow
• 27 blending modes
• Text layers

Advanced Brush engine
Perfectly optimized, lag free mechanism generating smooth, real looking strokes, making the most of the stylus.

• Brush editor with 80 customizable settings

Professional photo editor

Import/Export
We have implemented many parsers from the most popular assets/images formats and we are especially proud of our ABR/TPL parser which not only reads brush stamps and patterns, but also most settings which are converted to Artstudio Pro brush engine values.
Import

• Brushes - ABR, TPL
• Color swatches - ASE, ACO
• Patterns - PAT
• Gradients - GRD
• Fonts - TTF, OTF
Export

Other features

• Screen recording
• All features available on macOS, iPad and iPhone
• Selection displayed as marching ants, quick mask or invisible
• Snapping to guidelines, dynamic guidelines, grid

flathub:io.github.tobagin.digger.name: Digger
flathub:io.github.tobagin.digger.description:
Digger is a feature-rich DNS lookup tool designed for the GNOME desktop. It provides an 
 intuitive interface for exploring DNS records, from simple queries to complex diagnostics.
 Key features include:
 Support for all major DNS record types (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, etc.)
 Advanced options like reverse lookups, trace options, and custom servers
 DNS Blacklist (DNSBL) checking and performance monitoring
 Malware domain checking and DNSSEC chain-of-trust validation
 History with search and favorites management
 Batch lookup and server comparison tools

flathub:io.github.tobagin.sonar.name: Sonar
flathub:io.github.tobagin.sonar.description:
Sonar is a native tool for debugging webhooks. It captures incoming requests and
 lets you inspect headers, body content, and query parameters in real-time.
 Core Features:
 Instant public URLs via ngrok integration for webhook testing
 Real-time capture of incoming webhook requests as they arrive
 Detailed inspection of headers, body content, query parameters, and metadata
 Quick copy functionality including JSON, cURL, and HTTP formats
 Clean Libadwaita interface that integrates perfectly with GNOME
 Fast and lightweight native application with minimal resource usage
 Advanced Features:
 Request bookmarking and starring for quick access
 Request replay to resend webhooks to custom URLs
 Side-by-side request comparison to spot differences
 Request templates for saving and reusing webhook patterns
 Automatic webhook forwarding to multiple URLs
 Advanced filtering by method, content-type, time range, and search
 Persistent history with JSON storage

flathub:io.github.zingytomato.netpeek.name: NetPeek
flathub:io.github.zingytomato.netpeek.description:
NetPeek is a simple network scanner that helps you
 discover active devices on your local network.

flathub:net.sourceforge.squirrel_sql.name: SQuirreL SQL Client
flathub:net.sourceforge.squirrel_sql.summary: SQL client for any JDBC compliant database
flathub:net.sourceforge.squirrel_sql.description:
SQuirreL SQL Client is a graphical Java program (GUI) that will allow you to view the structure of a JDBC compliant database, browse the data in tables, issue SQL commands etc.
 The Flatpak version currently includes drivers for MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Actian Avalanche, Apache Derby, H2, HSQLDB, Microsoft MSSQL, Sybase, Mckoi, and SQLite.

flathub:org.eyecreate.qiflora.name: QiFlora
flathub:org.eyecreate.qiflora.summary: Mobile friendly application to monitor plants using Mi Flora devices.
flathub:org.eyecreate.qiflora.description:
Mobile friendly application to monitor Mi Flora devices.
 Plants using this device will have their data logged when app is used and graphed to better monitor plant health.

flathub:org.gnunet.Messenger.name: GNUnet Messenger
flathub:org.gnunet.Messenger.description:
Messenger-GTK is a convergent graphical messaging application using the GNUnet Messenger service.
 The goal is to provide private and secure communication between any group of devices.
 The application provides the following features:
 Creating direct chats and group chats
 Managing your contacts and groups
 Invite contacts to a group
 Sending text messages
 Sending voice recordings
 Sharing files privately
 Deleting messages with any custom delay
 Renaming contacts
 Exchanging contact details physically
 Verifying contact identities
 Switching between different accounts
 Chatting live via video or voice streaming
 Sharing your screen with a selected group
 Writing notes to yourself
 Chats will generally created as opt-in. So you can decide who may contact you directly and who
 does not, accepting to a direct chat. Leaving a chat is also always possible.

flathub:org.neverball.Neverball.name: Neverball
flathub:org.neverball.Neverball.summary: Deftly Guide a Rolling Ball through Many Slick 3D Levels
flathub:org.neverball.Neverball.description:
Guide a rolling ball through dangerous territory that you control by tilting the floor. Balance
 on narrow bridges, navigate mazes, ride moving platforms, and dodge pushers and shovers to get
 to the goal. Race against the clock to collect coins to earn extra balls. With nice physics and
 very clean and appealing 3D graphics, this is definitely a must play.
 Bundled with Neverball is also Neverputt, a hot-seat local multiplayer miniature golf game,
 built on the physics and graphics engine of Neverball.

fedora-packages:cpuinfo/cpuinfo.name: cpuinfo
fedora-packages:cpuinfo/cpuinfo.summary: A library to detect information about host CPU
fedora-packages:cpuinfo/cpuinfo.description: cpuinfo is a library to detect essential for performance optimization information about host CPU. Features * Cross-platform availability: * Linux, Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS operating systems * x86, x86-64, ARM, and ARM64 architectures * Modern C/C++ interface * Thread-safe * No memory allocation after initialization * No exceptions thrown * Detection of supported instruction sets, up to AVX512 (x86) and ARMv8.3 extensions * Detection of SoC and core information: * Processor (SoC) name * Vendor and microarchitecture for each CPU core * ID (MIDR on ARM, CPUID leaf 1 EAX value on x86) for each CPU core * Detection of cache information: * Cache type (instruction/data/unified), size and line size * Cache associativity * Cores and logical processors (hyper-threads) sharing the cache * Detection of topology information (relative between logical processors, cores, and processor packages) * Well-tested production-quality code: * 60+ mock tests based on data from real devices * Includes work-arounds for common bugs in hardware and OS kernels * Supports systems with heterogenous cores, such as big.LITTLE and Max.Med.Min * Permissive open-source license (Simplified BSD)

fedora-packages:gfs-garaldus-fonts/gfs-g.description: As it is known, the Greek alphabet was used in majuscule form for over a millennium before the minuscule letters gradually replaced it until they became the official script in the 9th century A.D. Thereafter, majuscule letters were confined to sparse use as initials or elaborate titles until the Italian Renaissance. The new art of Typography, as well as the need of the humanists to mimic the ancient Greco-Roman period brought back the extensive use of the majuscule letter-forms in both Latin and Greek typography. Greek books of the time were printed using the contemporary Byzantine hand with which they combined capital letters modeled on the Roman antiquity, i.e. with thick and thin strokes and serifs. At the same time the Byzantine majuscule tradition, principally used on theological editions, remained alive until the early 19th century. It has been designed by George D. Matthiopoulos.

firefox-addons:2983704.name: LeakLens - Privacy Inspector
firefox-addons:2983704.summary: Inspect trackers, cookies, fingerprinting, WebRTC leaks, permissions and security headers locally in your browser.
firefox-addons:2983704.description:
LeakLens is a privacy inspector that shows what data websites can access and what privacy risks appear while you browse.
Analyze trackers, cookies, fingerprinting attempts, WebRTC and network leaks, security headers, permissions, redirects, and URL tracking parameters directly in the browser.
 🔍 REAL-TIME PRIVACY AUDIT 
• See a privacy score from 0 to 100 and a risk grade from A to F for the active website
• Review trackers, cookies, fingerprinting signals, security headers, and permission activity in one view
• Follow a timeline of privacy-relevant events for each domain
 🛡 TRANSPARENT TRACKER BLOCKING 
• Block trackers in Balanced, Strict, or Custom mode
• See which rule matched and why a request was blocked
• Manage domain-level rules and editable tracker lists without external connections
 🔐 FINGERPRINTING DETECTION 
• Detect Canvas, WebGL, Audio, and WebRTC fingerprinting attempts in real time
• Use Detect, Prompt, or Mitigate modes depending on how much control you want
• Review per-signal counters and last-seen timestamps
 🧹 URL AND REDIRECT CLEANER 
• Remove UTM, gclid, fbclid, and other tracking parameters from URLs
• Edit the parameter list to match your own privacy preferences
• Clean redirects and navigation events quietly in the background
 🌐 WEBRTC AND NETWORK LEAK SHIELD 
• Help prevent WebRTC IP leaks by controlling browser IP handling behavior
• Detect and block requests to private IP ranges
• Review TLS and certificate details where the browser platform allows it
 ⏱ TEMPORARY PERMISSIONS 
• Grant geolocation, camera, microphone, or notifications only for a limited time
• Use Allow once, 10 minutes, 1 hour, or Always
• Automatically revoke temporary permission grants when the timer expires
 🔒 SECURITY HEADERS AND SESSION CONTROL 
• Analyze HSTS, CSP, Permissions-Policy, X-Frame-Options, and related headers
• Use a Security Posture Score from 0 to 100 with actionable recommendations
• Isolate tab sessions and manage cookies per domain
 📌 PANEL, OVERLAY AND QUICK ACTIONS 
• Use a clean popup with tabbed navigation and live scores
• Pin a draggable overlay on supported pages while browsing
• Run quick actions from the context menu, including inspect, shield, clear data, and open in isolation
 🧠 UNDERSTAND WHAT SITES SHARE 
Make trackers, cookies, fingerprint scripts, URL tracking parameters, security headers, permissions, and network leaks visible in one focused interface.
Explainable results help you understand what happened, why it matters, and what action you can take.
 🔒 PRIVACY FIRST 
The extension does not collect personal data, track browsing behavior, run analytics or profiling, or contact external servers.
Domain rules, event logs, and settings are stored locally in the browser and remain on the device.
 🏢 ABOUT THE AUTHOR 
LeakLens is developed by POLPROG, a Polish technology company creating browser extensions, web applications, and mobile apps with a focus on privacy.
Website: https://polprog.pl/ 
LeakLens product page: View product page 
Browser version: View in Chrome Web Store

firefox-addons:866226.name: LeechBlock NG
firefox-addons:866226.summary: LeechBlock NG is a simple productivity tool designed to block those time-wasting sites that can suck the life out of your working day. All you need to do is specify which sites to block and when to block them.
firefox-addons:866226.description:
LeechBlock NG (Next Generation) is a simple free productivity tool designed to block those time-wasting sites that can suck the life out of your working day. (You know: the ones that rhyme with 'Blue Cube', 'Space Hook', 'Sticky Media', 'Quitter', and the like.) All you need to do is specify which sites to block and when to block them.
You can specify up to 30 sets of sites to block, with different times and days for each set. You can block sites within fixed time periods (e.g., between 9am and 5pm), after a time limit (e.g., allow up to 10 minutes in every hour), or with a combination of time periods and time limit (e.g., allow up to 10 minutes in every hour between 9am and 5pm).
Additional features include:
 Lockdown: Block sites immediately for a specified duration.
 Access control: Set a password or random access code for the options page, to slow you down in moments of weakness!
 Delaying: Set a countdown to delay access to sites instead of completely blocking them.
 Password: Require a password to allow access to blocked sites.
 Wildcards: Block a range of sites (e.g., *.somesite.com).
 Exceptions: Whitelist sites you don't want to be blocked (e.g., +allowedsite.com).
 Keywords: Block or allow pages based on keywords (e.g., ~badword).
Version history: https://www.proginosko.com/leechblock/version-history/ 
Documentation: https://www.proginosko.com/leechblock/documentation/ 
Usage examples: https://www.proginosko.com/leechblock/examples/ 
Permissions: https://www.proginosko.com/leechblock/faq/permissions/ 
Frequently asked questions: https://www.proginosko.com/leechblock/faq/ 
Support: https://www.proginosko.com/leechblock/support/ 
GitHub repo: https://github.com/proginosko/LeechBlockNG

firefox-addons:2830973.summary: This extension help to block site selected by the user
firefox-addons:2830973.description:
Web Blocker Extension is a productivity tool that helps users stay focused on their work by blocking unproductive websites. This extension offers a user-friendly interface for blocking a website, selecting blog type, and easily managing a block list for adding or removing sites.
In addition, the extension features a permanent block and an attempt-wise block, which limits the number of attempts to access a blocked site and timewise block which limits the time of hour or minute to access a blocked site, encouraging more productive behavior and Exact URL meaning that the selected URL is exactly the same as all tab URLs and Contains URL meaning that the selected URL is included in exactly all tab URL.
 • A simple and easy-to-use extension that blocks distracting websites.
• Ability to add sites to the block list with a single click.
• Permanent block: Permanently block a site so it will always be inaccessible.
• Attempt-wise block: Option to limit the number of attempts to access a blocked site, encouraging more productive behavior.
• Time-wise block: Option to limit the hour or minute of times to access a blocked site, encouraging more productive behavior.
• Exact: This means that the URL must be exactly the same as all tab URLs.
• Contain: This means can have additional parameters, subdomains, and protocols that match with all tab URLs.
• Offers a user-friendly interface for adding or removing sites from the block list.
The Web Blocker extension is designed with ease of use and a hassle-free solution for managing online distractions. The interface is intuitive and user-friendly, making it easy to add or remove sites from the block list with just a few clicks. With its user-friendly interface and comprehensive features, anyone can increase productivity and minimize distractions in no time.

firefox-addons:1004684.name: Clockify Time Tracker
firefox-addons:1004684.summary: Track time from anywhere on the web and improve productivity.
firefox-addons:1004684.description:
Clockify is a free time tracker which you can use to manually track where you spend time.
Learn more here: http://clockify.me/firefox-time-tracking 
HOW TO TRACK TIME
1. Click "+ Add to Firefox".
2. Log in to Clockify from the extension menu (or visit https://clockify.me/tracker and you'll be automatically logged in)
3. You will start noticing the "Start timer" Button in your favourite productivity tools (Trello, Jira, Asana, Gitlab, Gmail, etc.)
4. Start timer inside one of the supported web tools and the task’s name and project will be added to your time entry.
Clockify add-on also has advanced features like:
* Pomodoro timer
* Idle detection
* TIme tracking reminders
Clockify Browser Extension is open source and is welcome to all contributions: https://github.com/clockify/browser-extension 
PRIVACY
The add-on doesn't collect any private information in the background (it doesn't even collect crash reports or usage analytics).
The only data the add-on collects is the one you choose to enter yourself. You can enter data manually yourself or the add-on can pick up data from other websites (such as task name in Trello) when you press "Start timer" button in them. You can see what data is picked up and it's saved once you click "Stop timer".
If you don't wish for "Start timer" to appear, you can open Settings>Integrations and revoke access to all websites and disable all integrations.
All data you enter into the add-on is covered by our Privacy Policy (in a nutshell, we don't share your data with anyone). You can find the full policy here: https://clockify.me/privacy

bluejetty:00091102:ios.summary: Spaceship launch, let's go! Destination, the cosmos! DinoCode: A Dinosaur Coding Adventure for Kids, crafted by Yateland, invites you to traverse the universe in an extraordinary space exploration game. This educational and fun coding game
bluejetty:00091102:ios.description:
Spaceship launch, let's go! Destination, the cosmos! DinoCode: A Dinosaur Coding Adventure for Kids, crafted by Yateland, invites you to traverse the universe in an extraordinary space exploration game. This educational and fun coding game for kids offers an out-of-this-world experience, teaching children programming during an unforgettable journey with our adorable dinosaur.
With DinoCode: A Dinosaur Coding Adventure for Kids, learning to code is as simple as playing with blocks. The game incorporates a drag-and-drop interface, making the children's coding experience intuitive and engaging. The coding blocks are designed like building blocks, thus promoting learning through play.
While having a blast in space, you'll get to pilot dinosaur mechs across planets to solve cosmic crises. These adventures provide an exciting backdrop to learning important coding concepts like sequences, loops, conditions, and functions.
Your mission, if you choose to accept it, includes stopping space spider invasions in future cities, repairing mechanical faults in unmanned factories, extinguishing raging fires aboard spacecraft, making thrilling escapes from bases during undersea earthquakes, protecting alien animals when volcanoes erupt, and collecting energy crystals in meteorite mining areas.
To aid in your space exploration, the game provides 36 diverse space mechs, each equipped with their own unique abilities. Whether it's combat, repairs, firefighting, deep-sea exploration, rescue, or mining, there's a mech for every task.
Key Features of DinoCode: A Dinosaur Coding Adventure for Kids
• Graphical block instructions making children's coding accessible even without literacy
• 36 impressive mechs with unique skills for space adventures
• 6 engaging space themes for a diverse planetary exploration experience
• 108 meticulously designed levels for a progressive learning of coding for kids
• Intelligent assistance system providing help when difficulties arise
• A completely offline game, playable without internet
• No third-party ads, ensuring a safe gaming environment for children
About Yateland: Yateland creates apps with educational value that can inspire children around the globe to learn through play. The team at Yateland believes in the motto: "Apps children love and parents trust." For more about Yateland and their apps, visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy: Yateland values user privacy highly. To learn more about our approach to these matters, please read our full privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.
Join the space adventures now and immerse yourself in this enthralling coding game for kids, brought to you by Yateland, the trusted brand for educational apps that kids love and parents trust.

bluejetty:00068853:ios.description:
Educar para Inspirar Pessoas e Transformar o Mundo é o nosso propósito vivenciado integralmente nas atividades presenciais e também no meio digital. Esta plataforma educacional conecta os usuários às unidades da Rede Damas Educacional. Após o login, você será direcionado para a sua unidade específica e terá acessos a diversos serviços.
A plataforma tem acesso unificado e é possível fazer o login por meio dos e-mails do Google e da Microsoft cadastrados no colégio ou faculdade. Também há integração total com o sistema de gestão escolar, possibilitando o acesso à Agenda Digital, Calendário, Comunicados, Quadro de Horários, Notas, Faltas, Visão Financeira e muito mais.
A Rede Damas Educacional
Com a missão de formar a pessoa humana com base nos valores cristãos, éticos e acadêmicos, de maneira participativa e comprometida, encarnando a face atual do Cristo educador para construir uma sociedade sustentável, a Rede Damas Educacional está presente em seis estados do Brasil e possui 12 escolas, uma faculdade e um centro social. São mais de 16 mil alunos sendo formados de maneira integral e para fazerem a diferença no mundo.

bluejetty:00033616:ios.summary:
With the Stumptown Coffee Roasters app you can order and pay ahead, and pick up your drink when it’s most convenient. No line, no fuss, and no compromising quality for the sake of convenience.
ORDER AHEAD
Take your time exploring our menus
bluejetty:00033616:ios.description:
With the Stumptown Coffee Roasters app you can order and pay ahead, and pick up your drink when it’s most convenient. No line, no fuss, and no compromising quality for the sake of convenience.
ORDER AHEAD
Take your time exploring our menus for what’ll hit just right, be it drinks, locally made treats, whole bean coffee, or Stumptown branded merchandise. Choose the Stumptown cafe you’d like to pick up at, let us know when you’ll show up, and leave the rest to us.
CUSTOMIZE
We all like our drinks just the way we like them. Don’t be shy; let our baristas know what you want, from alternative milks, to sweeteners, to drink temperature—we’re delighted to make your pre-caffeinated dreams come true. Even better, the Stumptown app saves your order history so once you find your go-to brew, you’re just a few taps away from an easy reorder.
PAY AHEAD
Credit card? You got it. ApplePay? Sure thing. Store your payment method in the app for convenient purchasing every time. While you’re at it, you can add a tip for our supremely talented and wonderful baristas.
SECRET NOTES
Turn on app notifications to get updates on your order. Better yet, we may have secret notes to send once in a while. Be among the first to know about new seasonal drinks, fresh coffee releases, cafe events, the occasional special deals.

bluejetty:00175607:ios.description:
911 is a scary Hide & Seek horror game with puzzle elements.
In this horror game you are a kidnapped teenager. Maniac - cannibal keeps you in his creepy house. Hide and search items that can help you find a way out of the scary place and survive the nightmare. Solve puzzles to get to inaccessible places. And do not forget about attentiveness - you need to carefully cover up your tracks so that the maniac does not suspect anything.
Can you hide and outsmart the cannibal and survive without missing a single detail? Or will he catch you in the very first minutes and in the evening you will find yourself in his plate? In this horror, survival depends only on your ingenuity, attentiveness and memory.
Explore the scary house and look for notes to learn more about Minnesota's scariest maniac. This knowledge can allow you to make decisions that will affect the development of events. Your actions may help other victims survive... or they may harm them. Try to cope with the horror that the character immersed in and complete all the hidden tasks.
911 Horror Adventure Game features:
- Branching detective story
- Fascinating story and investigation
- Interesting puzzles
- Horror elements, hide and seek, and survival
- Quality sound and detailed environment
Download the new horror game and try to survive. Test yourself and your mind!

bluejetty:00121752:ios.summary:
Get the latest New Jersey lottery results within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
- Pick 6 (including Double Play)
- Powerball (including Double Play)
- Mega Millions
- Powerball Xs
bluejetty:00121752:ios.description:
Get the latest New Jersey lottery results within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
- Pick 6 (including Double Play)
- Powerball (including Double Play)
- Mega Millions
- Powerball Xs & Os
- Millionaire for Life
- Jersey Cash 5
- Pick 4
- Pick 3
- Cash Pop
Pick 6, Powerball, Mega Millions, Powerball Xs & Os, Millionaire for Life, Jersey Cash 5, Pick 4, Pick 3 and Cash Pop also include a full breakdown displaying the number of winners and amount paid out for each prize level.
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support
----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.

- Background Music : Enjoy peaceful background music while reading the Bible.
- Alarm : Set reminders and get alerts for activities scheduled within the app.
- Mark as Read Quiz : Explore quizzes designed around the verses you have finished reading.

bluejetty:00141384:ios.description:
Corazo Credit Union is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Corazo Credit Union:
 -Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
 -Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
 -Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
 -Transfer money between your accounts
 -Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
 -Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
 -View and save your monthly statements
 -Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Corazo Credit Union Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a Corazo Credit Union digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

Contraceptive Ring Reminder + is the perfect app to keep track of your contraceptive ring birth control with a beautiful, intuitive, and easy-to-use design.
It's very simple to set up and use. You just have to select how many days you stay with the ring, and the app will start notifying you when you'll have to insert or remove your contraceptive ring. In addition, you can always check the status of the current ring.
Contraceptive Ring Reminder + is the application you need to keep track of your ring: easy, effective, and free!
FEATURES WE LOVE
• Cycle overview
• Custom calendar with notes for each day
• Custom notifications
• What time to insert or remove your ring
• Total control over your cycle
• Automatic backup of your data to iCloud
• And much more…
PREMIUM FEATURES
• Ad-free
Ad sponsors help us keep offering the free version. By becoming Premium, you won't see ads anymore.
• Custom notifications
Premium users have access to advanced customization options like sounds, intervals, time, and more.
• Time to insert / remove the ring
Premium users have the option to select the exact time they want to insert and remove their rings.
REVIEW
If you like it and find it useful, please review the app! This means the world to us.
Your love will keep motivating us, and it will also influence other users. Reviews are the best way to prove that this app is great. Please review us!
SUPPORT

Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00031187:ios.summary: Check if you need a travel visa or an embassy registration for your next trip, and get it all in a few taps! No more confusing and long gov forms. Get the travel documents for your next trip in the most easy and convenient way with iVisa.
bluejetty:00031187:ios.description:
Check if you need a travel visa or an embassy registration for your next trip, and get it all in a few taps! No more confusing and long gov forms. Get the travel documents for your next trip in the most easy and convenient way with iVisa.
Don't worry about the paperwork, our streamlined process will make applying for your visa a breeze so you can have peace of mind. 
Disclaimer: iVisa is a government document provider for various countries across the world. Additionally, we are immigration consultants where the focus is on consultation and not mere assistance acquiring particular travel documents. iVisa is not a government agency or law firm. Our customer service team does not offer legal advice and is not composed of lawyers. You can apply directly on government websites if you prefer. 
Benefits of using iVisa:
Updated source of travel requirements
Just enter which country you're from and your destination, and you'll find up-to-date travel requirements for visas, health declarations, embassy registrations, and more.
Passport scanning technology
Thanks to our app's OCR technology, you can scan your passport, and the information will be transferred directly to your travel visa application, saving you time and effort.
Save your profile for the next time
If you choose to save your information to a profile, your next visa or travel document application will be even faster. All user data is handled according to strict privacy guidelines.
Track your application
Receive real-time alerts and stay up-to-date on the status of your application.
Expert review
Don't get your travel visa rejected because you made a simple mistake! Our platform provides a full visa service that includes an expert review of every application to ensure maximum success.
One-stop-shop
iVisa is your one-stop shop for visas and other travel requirements. You can apply for online electronic visas, visas on arrival, or embassy visas.
Electronic visas have a 100% online application process, while embassy visas could require an appointment. But don't worry! We'll help you through the process and increase your approval chances. 
Our top products:
Australia ETA:
Ideal for short visits, this electronic visa permits multiple entries for up to 3 months for citizens from select countries within a 12-month period. iVisa is registered with the Australian Government Department of Home Affairs. https://portal.mara.gov.au/search-the-register-of-migration-agents/register-of-migration-agent-details/?ContactID=1728680f-a252-e311-9402-005056ab0eca
ESTA
Eligible travelers can visit the US without a traditional visa, enhancing border security and simplifying the process. Particularly advantageous for visa-exempt travelers, applying for an ESTA is quicker and simpler compared to a regular visa.
NEW ZEALAND ETA
Allows hassle-free visits to New Zealand without the need for a visa, with a straightforward online application process. iVisa is registered with the New Zealand Immigration Advisers Authority. https://iaa.ewr.govt.nz/PublicRegister/View.aspx?Firstname=mi&LastName=zhou&search=1&p=1&adviserNumber=202300997
COLOMBIA CHECK-MIG
A vital health-focused document for travelers heading to Colombia, requiring health, travel, and personal information.
SINGAPORE ARRIVAL CARD
An electronic document that travelers need to complete within three days before entering Singapore.
UK VISA
A travel authorization, suited for visitors traveling to the UK for tourism, business, medical treatment, studies, or visiting family.
INDIA EVISA
An electronic travel authorization for travelers from eligible countries visiting India, simplifying the existing visa services and process.
TURKEY EVISA
An electronic visa allowing citizens from over 25 countries to enter Turkey without the need for a physical stamp or sticker on their passport. The Turkey eVisa is electronically linked to your passport for a seamless experience.

bluejetty:00060801:ios.summary:

Businesses everywhere are desperate for vital consumer feedback - and they pay for it. Now, with iSecretShop on your phone, they p
bluejetty:00060801:ios.description:
Install the iSecretShop app on your smart phone today and turn your everyday shopping experiences into cash!
Businesses everywhere are desperate for vital consumer feedback - and they pay for it. Now, with iSecretShop on your phone, they pay YOU.
iSecretShop gives you access to dozens of Market Research and Mystery Shopping Providers' opportunities. So you can see all of the available secret shopping opportunities available near you from numerous agencies, not just one. And more are being added all the time! Smartphone technology has revolutionized the industry, made the shopper's job easier, and improved the quality, accuracy and speed of the entire process. This is the way mystery shopping should be - register now and see for yourself!
HERE'S HOW IT WORKS: Register as an evaluator and the iSecretShop app will show you which restaurants, retailers and other businesses in your area (or wherever you plan to go) are looking for input from secret shoppers. Secret shoppers are customers who go 'undercover' to give very specific feedback to the owners and managers about the service quality and the customer experience they received. You discreetly complete an evaluation using the ISS application (think Secret Agent: gathering information, taking pictures of messy facilities, beautiful food, etc.) then, report it back instantly through your smart phone (or online - or a combination of both, as you prefer). When you are finished, you'll get paid (cash, meal and purchase reimbursements, Gift Cards and more)!
The iSecretShop app is FREE to you and FREE to use - it is the businesses that pay for the service. The merchants get vital intelligence, you get cash and reimbursements - and the power of having your opinions heard by the decision makers at businesses that care.
Download the iSecretShop app, register, and get started today!
Please Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00062380:ios.description:
Learn languages with Bunpo! Learn Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Arabic, English and more!
Master speaking, grammar, and vocabulary from beginner to advanced, trusted by over 5 million learners worldwide. From your first Hiragana あ to JLPT N1, from "annyeong" to a real Korean conversation, or any of our 10+ languages, Bunpo takes you from day one to fluency.
=========
Why Bunpo works for language learning
- Speak from day one: Start speaking from your very first lesson with advanced speech recognition technology.
- 10+ languages, one app: Learn Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Arabic, and English, and switch between them anytime without juggling multiple apps.
- Grammar that makes sense: Detailed explanations in plain English, plus exercises that make it stick.
- Smart review: A personalized study plan powered by spaced repetition (SRS) so you remember more, faster.
- From the alphabet to advanced: Start with your very first character and build all the way to advanced grammar, whatever language you choose.
Whether you're learning for travel, a higher grade, JLPT, a career boost, or just to feel confident in a new conversation, Bunpo's got your back.
=========
Japanese Course
- Master the Japanese alphabets (Hiragana & Katakana) so you can read menus, train signs, and even your favorite manga without guessing.
- Learn Japanese grammar for every JLPT level (N5 to N1) with clear, no-nonsense explanations because "This is a pen" will only get you so far.
- Build real-world Japanese vocabulary and kanji knowledge you can actually use in daily conversations, not just in textbooks.
- Practice with 1,800+ Japanese example sentences and 8,000+ interactive quizzes designed to make new grammar and vocab stick.
- Search any topic instantly in the Japanese grammar dictionary, perfect for "What does that mean again?" moments.
- Review smarter, not harder, with a spaced repetition system (SRS) that reminds you before you forget.
=========
Korean Course
- Master the Korean alphabet (Hangul) with a guided chart, listening, and writing practice.
- Build Korean vocabulary you'll actually use in everyday conversations.
- Practice reading, writing, listening, and speaking so every skill grows together.
=========
Spanish Course
- Learn Spanish offline
- Master Spanish grammar from A1 to B1 level
- Spanish verb conjugation
- Perfect your Spanish pronunciation
=========
French Course
- Learn French offline
- Master French grammar from A1 to A2 level
- French verb conjugation
- Perfect your French pronunciation
=========
German Course
- Learn German offline
- Master German grammar from A1 to C1 level
- German verb conjugation
- Perfect your German pronunciation
=========
Chinese Course
- Learn Chinese offline
- Master Chinese vocabulary and phrases
- Listen, speak, and write Chinese
=========
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
https://bunpo.app/privacy.html
Any feedback? Feel free to contact us at: iphone@bunpo.app

Capture your most precious moments without leaving anyone of out of the photo. Timer Auto Camera will allow you to take group photos of families and friends simply by setting the seconds till photo capture. This is the most powerful camera auto timer utility you will find! You know you've had those instances where you want to take a photo of the both of you and only wished a timer option was available. This is the app for those rare moments when you need a timer to capture all the family and friends in one photo shot. 
The Timer Auto Camera app has been completely redone and now supports tablets as well. 
The core functionality of the app is same, take group photos and set the time till photo capture. Once you hit capture simply get back to the group, and viola you are also now in the photo. Timer Auto Camera allows you to set a timer up to 60 seconds duration before taking a photo. Plus it allows you to save the captured photos & videos to your photo library through Setting. In addition, the app provides the ability to manage your photos & videos separately.
FEATURES:
• Camera Zoom
• Supports All Orientations
• Grid Selection
• Timer Sounds
• Custom Photo Sec Duration
• Save & Share From Album
• Front & Back Camera Support
• Flash Light On/Off Option
The app is simple and fun to use. What are you waiting for download Timer Auto Camera? Keep this app for emergencies, you never know when this app might come in handy.

bluejetty:00014827:ios.description:
Work communication that won’t distract you all day.
Twist makes collaboration easy from anywhere. Unlike Slack and Teams, it uses threads to organize all your team’s conversations — asynchronously.
ORGANIZATION
• Twist threads never bury important information in an avalanche of chit-chat (like Slack)
• Keep conversations organized and on topic → one topic = one thread
CLARITY
• Create a central place to gain visibility on your team’s work with channels
• Organize channels by topic, project, or client
FOCUS
• Help your team focus on the work that matters, instilling more calm and less anxiety with smarter notifications
• The inbox gathers threads in one place, allowing team members to easily prioritize what matters to them
ACCESS
• Give your team a historical record to learn from
• Quickly onboard new employees and easily share context to past decisions

Welcome to Candy Sort: Fruit Puzzle Game, where the lovely candies are put haphazardly. Everyone who plays this puzzle game must move and sort the same-colored candies into the available bottles.

-Tap the top candy of any bottle.

- Colorful, adorable candies make a visual impact.

- Brain Training and reducing stress
- Free 2D casual game

bluejetty:00014373:ios.name: Landlord Tycoon: Own the World
bluejetty:00014373:ios.summary:
Landlord Tycoon is a real estate investment game where you buy, sell, and trade virtual properties based on real-world locations. Build your empire, collect rent, and compete with players worldwide in this business simulation.
Buy propertie
bluejetty:00014373:ios.description:
Landlord Tycoon is a real estate investment game where you buy, sell, and trade virtual properties based on real-world locations. Build your empire, collect rent, and compete with players worldwide in this business simulation.
Buy properties near you, upgrade them, and earn passive income as other players check in. Start with a small amount of virtual cash and make strategic investments to grow your wealth. Your goal is to dominate the market and become the top property mogul.
Every real-world location is an opportunity. Invest in popular landmarks, local businesses, or high-traffic areas to maximize earnings. Upgrade properties to increase their value and generate more income. Compete against other players in your city or globally.
In Landlord Tycoon, you can own and trade some of the most famous locations in the world, turning global landmarks into your personal empire. Imagine owning the Eiffel Tower in France, the Statue of Liberty in the United States, or the Colosseum in Italy, collecting rent every time someone checks in. Expand your portfolio across major cities like New York, Tokyo, London, and Dubai, investing in iconic skyscrapers such as Burj Khalifa, Empire State Building, and the Shard. Not just limited to cities, you can even claim natural wonders like the Grand Canyon, Mount Everest, or the Great Barrier Reef, making your empire truly unique. 
Feeling even more ambitious? Buy and manage entire countries, invest in continents, or even claim ownership over vast oceans like the Pacific, Atlantic, and Arctic. Whether you’re building a global network of urban properties or owning breathtaking landscapes, your journey to becoming a real estate tycoon is limitless.
Features include real-world property ownership, passive income generation, leaderboards, strategy-based investment, GPS-powered trading, and financial management elements. Make smart investment decisions, manage your assets, and climb the rankings.
How to play: Start with virtual cash, purchase properties, collect rent, upgrade investments, and trade strategically. Expand your portfolio and use data-driven insights to make the best choices. The more active you are, the bigger your empire will become.
Landlord Tycoon offers a unique experience with its combination of real-world data, finance simulation, and competitive strategy. Unlike traditional business games, it lets you interact with actual locations. If you enjoy Monopoly-style real estate games, business simulators, or investment challenges, this game is for you.
Compete with friends and global players. Track your progress, learn valuable financial skills, and test your ability to grow wealth. The game combines elements of property management, trading, and decision-making.
This is more than a game; it’s an interactive investment simulation that allows you to develop strategic thinking and real estate management skills in a risk-free environment. Whether you want to test your abilities or simply enjoy a fun real estate game, Landlord Tycoon provides an engaging experience.
Download now and start building your real estate empire. Buy properties, earn rent, and compete with others in this exciting business simulation. Play for free and see if you have what it takes to become the next top real estate investor. 
This game is free to play, but you can choose to pay real money for some extra items, which will be charged to your Apple account.
You can disable in-app purchasing by adjusting your device settings.
Advertising appears in this game.
Privacy Policy
https://reality.co/privacy-policy-products/
Terms of Service
https://reality.co/terms-of-service/Terms of Service

Do you want to make your own music video or just want to add music on video? Then look no further! Video Maker with Music is here for iPhone / iPad. Add awesome customized video background music or remix songs in an effortless way without any special training on video editing! For jingle videos or for advertisement movie makers, this app will as a handy trial tool.
Check out what some of our users from all over the world are saying about this app:
=================================================
"I finally get the appropriate app that I was looking for - Great App" by Jigsaw1800 (AU)
"Easy to use, can edit music start which is a plus, as well as where in the song. Cool app. - Swaggy" by Neyachi (US)
"Very simple and easy to use. Guides you through steps and easy to pick up. - Great and easy to use" by Bathing monkey (UK) 
With this music video editor app you will get to add songs or sound effects to your videos from your mobile device. You can post it on Instagram, Vine, and YouTube for sharing with your musical video with online friends and followers.
How the app works?
=================================================
Video Maker with Music app is really easy to operate to add music to videos. 
Just follow these 5 steps:
• Select source video (camera or videos on your iPhone) to add music to video.
• Add video background music from your iPhone, from app's track list, or add video background music by recording your own voice.
• This creative video editor let you mark where you want to add music to video: you can trim the part, if you want, to add to the video.
• Configure volume of audio or songs added to video. Just tap one button to merge video background music when done.
• Now it’s time, you can save it to camera roll like an expert movie maker. 
• Enjoy your music video, it is now ready to be shared on social networking sites like Instagram, Facebook, Vine, and YouTube or via email.
App’s Features:
=================================================
Take a quick look at the creative features of the music video editor app before you get engrossed in the process to make your own music video: 
• User friendly interface no matter if you are beginner movie maker,
• You need to tap the music track to trim music, adjust volume, or adding fade effect.
• You can do as much adding music to video and voice recording as you want.
• Slide the music track to set starting time for adding video background music.
• Using feature like "share to Instagram" to let the Music on Video square the final video for you.
Download the Video Maker with Music app, and start making your own music video like a pro movie maker! Turn your iOS device into a video editor tool and collect more likes from Instagram or Facebook.
Making an own music video is now an easy task and the app Music on Video is completely free to download!

bluejetty:00152131:ios.description:
Welcome to the Club Car Wash Mobile App—the fast lane to managing your wash membership, rewards, and more.
Whether you're a loyal Member or just exploring, our app puts the full power of Club Car Wash in your pocket. Find nearby locations, manage your membership, track rewards, send gift cards, and stay connected—all in one seamless experience designed to make clean simple.
Key Features:
 - Find Locations Near You
Whether you’re at home or on the go, quickly locate any of our Club Car Wash locations across multiple states. Get directions and view hour with ease.
 - Manage Your Membership
Start, upgrade, or manage your membership with just a few taps. View your plan details, renewal date, and billing—all in one place.
 - Access Your Platinum Rewards
Earn points for purchases, referrals, and more. Redeem points for exclusive gifts and offers.
 - Buy & Send Digital Gift Cards
Give the gift of clean. Instantly purchase and send digital gift cards—perfect for family, friends, or the car enthusiast in your life.
 - Refer Friends. Get Rewarded.
Easily refer friends all from the app for rewards. When your friends sign up, you both win—because clean cars are better shared.
 - Quick Access to Support
Need assistance? Contact our support team directly from the app for billing questions, feedback, or general help.
Whether you're commuting, road-tripping, or just love a spotless ride, the Club Car Wash Mobile App keeps you connected to everything that matters—membership, rewards, convenience, and control.
Download now and take your car wash experience to the next level.

bluejetty:00023000:ios.description:
GLOBAL WEATHER: The easiest way to get weather forecasts!
JUST TAP!
This is a unique, interactive, easy to use app for anywhere-weather on the go. Just tap the map anywhere in the world to get the weather instantly. That's all you need to do to get a forecast! The perfect app for travelers.
YOUR FUN INDIVIDUAL SCREEN
Don't like the Weather? Like Your Design! Use Your Photos! Select your own photos and create your own individual screen for your favorite locations. Make it yours!
A STUNNING EYE-CATCHER
Enjoy a fascinating view from space showing our planet Earth with its worldwide clouds systems. Explore Global Weather's spectacular meteorological snapshot. Watch weather situations as they unfold around the world. A world-wide cloud formation view is available that refreshes every three hours.
CITY and AIRPORT SEARCH
You can navigate to all parts of the world, search for a city or an airport (ICAO, IATA code or name). Any city/town worldwide with a minimum of 1000 inhabitants can be searched directly in Global Weather. Or use the magnifier enabled by touching the screen for two seconds.
WORLD CLOCK
Analog and digital time is displayed in the bubble and can be turned on/off in settings.
WEATHER DETAILS
Global Weather includes a wide range of professional features.
GPS
As opposed to most free weather apps we DO NOT track your GPS position to sell it for ad targeting.
UNIVERSAL APPLICATION:
Fully functional on iPad, iPhone, iPod at no additional costs!
Get Global Weather and get ready for any weather to come!

bluejetty:00122225:ios.description:
Are you brave enough to begin the ultimate Halloween quest?
Scary, funny, and bizarre adventures are what Troll Face Quest: Horror 2 has in store for you in this second installment of the mind-blowing TFQ horror series! 
So head to your bedroom, your dorm room, or, well, any room and get ready to scream yourself silly while you LOL at tons of crazy pranks and puzzles based on the scariest movies ever made. This game definitely isn’t for your granny or young kids! 
These terrifying but hilarious puzzles are filled with scary references to many of your favorite horror movies and TV shows. They’ll chill you to the bone while making you LOL. How is that even possible? Point and click your way through the game to find out! Will you make it all the way to the final level and escape with your sanity? 
Here’s the features that could make you scream with despair!
 Challenge yourself with each tricky point and click puzzle.
 Immerse yourself in various amazing adventures that will allow you to escape boring, everyday reality.
 LOL at scary pranks inspired by your favorite horror movies while you solve the funnest mystery puzzles out there.
 Explore cool levels with awesome graphics that not only troll but also mimic the atmosphere of popular horror movies and TV shows.
 Unlock tons of surprising achievements.
 Climb up the ultimate leaderboard, which has plenty of room for the world’s greatest Troll Face Quest players.
Troll Face Quest: Horror 2 will take you on the ultimate adventure into the realm of point and click terror. 
You won’t be able to escape all the horrifying hilarity that’s waiting for you in these scary movie and TV parodies! We’re not kidding around!
You’ll be up against scary clowns that love to have kids for dinner (literally!) and some truly nightmarish nuns who really don’t like pranks that make everybody around them LOL. The only way to get past all the vampires that are waiting to sink their teeth into you is by using your wits along with lots of points and clicks.
So get ready for an awesome adventure that’s truly terrifying and remember to tell your granny to scram before you hit the play button!

bluejetty:00023027:ios.description:
This game gives you the freedom to let your creative side run riot – nothing is impossible. Create and design your own constructions and watch the cars and trucks pass over them - or see them fall and crash while your inferior creations collapse due to weight and the laws of physics!
In addition to the normal mode the game features the Level Editor mode for make your own puzzles and bridge designs. You can also use in-game hint system if things get too hard. With 120+ levels of challenging physics puzzles you will not run out of things to do quickly.

• 120+ campaign levels
• Level Editor mode
• Different materials to build from - Wood, Metal, Cables, Rope, Hydraulic Pistons
• Multiple cars to test out your constructions
• Realistic physics engine
• Gorgeous 3D graphics
• Relaxing music

bluejetty:00141709:ios.description:
Welcome to Merge Restyle – The Ultimate Fusion of House Design and Pet Companion! 
Are you ready to become a legendary design master? Do you dream of transforming a run-down house&town into a modern paradise? In Merge Restyle, you don't have to choose! Join forces with us in one of the most addictive merge games on the market.
Merge Restyle is not just another puzzle game; it is a creative journey where home decoration meets the excitement of pet games. Here, you will combine items, pair tools, and unlock the secrets to a beautiful life. Whether you are a fan of matching games or you simply love to decorate and makeover, this game is your perfect match!
GAME FEATURES 
MERGE & MATCH TO CREATE The core of the game is simple yet deeply satisfying. Forget stressful timers; here, you can relax. Simply drag and combine identical items on the board to create better, more useful tools.
- Match objects to clear the board and solve puzzles.
- Pair up items to discover new equipment for your renovation projects.
- Experience the satisfaction unique to merging games as you turn basic materials into high-end decor and gourmet ingredients.
- Challenge hundreds of levels that require strategy and a bit of magic!
DESIGN YOUR DREAM HOME & TOWN You are the lead architect and interior designer! The old house is waiting for a makeover.
- Design every corner: From a cozy bedroom and a sunny living room to a luxurious garden.
- Choose your style: Do you prefer modern minimalism or classic elegance? The fashion of your home is entirely up to you.
- Renovate different areas: It’s not just about one house; it’s about rebuilding an entire community. Unlock new buildings and bring the town back to life.
FASHION & MAKEOVER Your character needs to look the part!
- Dive into the world of fashion. Unlock stylish outfits, accessories, and hairstyles.
- Give characters a complete makeover to match their new surroundings.
- Express your personality through your avatar’s look while you design the world around you.
ADORABLE PET SYSTEM What is a home without a furry friend?
- Adopt cute pets to accompany you on your journey.
- Take care of them, play with them, and let them bring joy to your newly renovated spaces.
- Evolve your pets as you progress through the game!
WHY PLAY MERGE RESTYLE?

bluejetty:00015019:ios.description:
Bimi Boo kids piano game is a music game for toddlers of 1 to 5 years old. Our learning game for girls and boys will allow your toddlers to develop creativity, an ear for music, hand-eye coordination, fine motor and attention.

- Nursery rhymes. There are many classic simple songs for your kid to enjoy! Jingle Bells, Happy Birthday, Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, Old MacDonald Had a Farm, ect.

- Different sounds for kids. Being not only entertaining but also educational, this games for toddlers will allow your kid to learn sounds of different animals, vehicles and much more! Baby piano contains many amazing sounds for kids across.
- Lullabies for babies and toddlers. Outstanding lullabies will help your sweet baby to fall asleep. Let your kid to choose a lovely character to watch them fall asleep while listening to a bedtime song.
- Learning games for kids. Educational music games for toddlers to choose from. Help Bimi Boo in his adventures at different locations. Baby piano for kids & toddlers will help your girls and boys to develop love for music. The games for toddlers are perfect for 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 year olds.
The following content is available for free:
- 20+ ambient sounds.
- 2 music instruments.
- 2 popular songs for babies.
- 2 baby games.
- 2 lullabies.
Trusted by the largest teacher community in the USA: "We Are Teachers"!
Please kindly note that an in-app purchase is required to unlock additional content. Baby piano is a game that doesn’t require Wi-Fi to be played and you will never find annoying ads inside our apps. We are always glad to receive your feedback and suggestions.

bluejetty:00086777:ios.name: AxReg
bluejetty:00086777:ios.summary: AxReg é uma plataforma completa para todo o processo perioperatório. Com ela, o profissional anestesista consegue registrar de maneira fácil e dinâmica, todos os dados necessários, além de acompanhar os indicadores de produtividade do centr
bluejetty:00086777:ios.description:
AxReg é uma plataforma completa para todo o processo perioperatório. Com ela, o profissional anestesista consegue registrar de maneira fácil e dinâmica, todos os dados necessários, além de acompanhar os indicadores de produtividade do centro cirúrgico em tempo real.
O AxReg substitui a ficha anestésica em papel, e muito além disso, empodera toda equipe com importantes indicadores. 
A versão AxReg 4.0, trazemos inúmeras novidades para melhorar cada vez mais o seu fluxo de trabalho. Entre elas:
- Interface simples e intuitiva priorizando o que importa;
- Mais segurança para o paciente com novos itens como, inserção de lateralidade e alertas para alergias;
- Avaliação pré-anestésica completa, com mais opções e categorizada de maneira simples de preencher;
- Ficha transoperatória mais rápida, organizada e com novas funcionalidades;
- Perfil pessoal, reunindo suas configurações, informações pessoais e estatísticas profissionais em um único lugar;
Baixe agora e faça parte do admirável mundo da Anestesia 4.0
Foco no usuário
A interface foi desenvolvida com foco nas necessidades dos profissionais anestesiologistas, revolucionando a forma de realizar o registro anestésico desde a consulta pré-anestésica, passando pela ficha de anestesia no trans-operatório até as visitas na recuperação pós-anestésica.
Consulta Pré Anestésica
Sendo uma ferramenta completa, o AxReg possibilita não apenas o registro do procedimento anestésico, mas também o cadastro de consultas pré anestésicas.
Trans-operatório
Na tela de registro anestésico, o grid é apresentado de forma similar ao registro anestésico impresso convencional para fácil identificação e compreensão. As mudanças que o aplicativo traz são com o único intuito de tornar o registro ainda mais fácil e rápido.
Pós-Operatório
O módulo de Avaliação Pós-Anestésica em Sala de Recuperação Pós-Anestésica (RPA) vem fechando um ciclo da plataforma AxReg.
Agilidade no registro anestésico
Utilizando gestos simples, como pressionar, pressionar+segurar e deslizar, o registro da ficha anestésica é realizado em tempo real com o AxReg. Desta forma, a documentação de uso de drogas, bombas de infusão, anestésicos inalatórios, monitorizações e demais dados relacionados ao procedimento anestésico é realizada de forma intuitiva, ágil e acurada.
Segurança dos dados
Após a finalização do procedimento, o aplicativo gera um documento em PDF personalizável com todos os dados referentes ao registro anestésico e ao pré anestésico, que pode ser impresso, armazenado na nuvem, compartilhado por email ou outros meios que o usuário preferir.
Anestesia.cloud
No endereço anestesia.cloud o profissional anestesiologista possui um inédito dashboard próprio com sua produtividade, horas trabalhadas, procedimentos realizados e a sua cópia pessoal do registro de anestesia guardado em nuvem e disponível em qualquer lugar sempre que o profissional desejar.

Agilidade no registro anestésico
Utilizando gestos simples, como pressionar, pressionar+segurar e deslizar, o registro da ficha anestésica é realizado em tempo real com o AxReg. Desta forma, a documentação de uso de drogas, bombas de infusão, anestésicos inalatórios, monitorizações e demais dados relacionados ao procedimento anestésico é realizada de forma intuitiva, ágil e acurada.

Segurança dos dados
Após a finalização do procedimento, o aplicativo gera um documento em PDF personalizável com todos os dados referentes ao registro anestésico e ao pré anestésico, que pode ser impresso, armazenado na nuvem, compartilhado por email ou outros meios que o usuário preferir.

Anestesia.cloud
No endereço anestesia.cloud o profissional anestesiologista possui um inédito dashboard próprio com sua produtividade, horas trabalhadas, procedimentos realizados e a sua cópia pessoal do registro de anestesia guardado em nuvem e disponível em qualquer lugar sempre que o profissional desejar.

bluejetty:00155565:ios.description:
Préservez vos souvenirs, simplement. Si les enfants, la famille et les amis sont le centre de votre univers, faites de Cute!, l’application de vos plus beaux souvenirs!
Cute! facilite la gestion de vos souvenirs : elle permet de capturer, d’organiser et de partager facilement avec vos proches les mots et les photos de celles et ceux qui vous sont chers. Cute!, c’est aussi votre réseau de partage familial numérique et physique. Avec Cute!, vos livres photos sont créés et commandés en moins de 5 minutes, et conservés facilement, pour toujours. Cute! c’est votre histoire… en toute simplicité.
Enfin, un réseau familial sociaBLE! Cute! est l’application numéro un pour capturer et préserver tous ces mots et moments que vous ne voulez pas oublier. Nous avons créé un outil simple pour vous aider à immortaliser votre histoire familiale tout en allégeant votre charge mentale. Cute! permet de capter, sauvegarder, organiser et partager vos souvenirs en un seul endroit. Avec Cute! vous pouvez aussi créer et commander des livres photos en moins de 5 minutes et ainsi, rendre pérennes tous vos moments précieux. Notre mission : faire sourire et rapprocher! Pas de jugement, pas de critique, juste du Cute! Cute! permet de noter les mots et moments cutes rapidement dans ton profil, de les garder privés, de les partager, de les mettre publics ou de les rendre visibles uniquement à tes abonnés ou à des personnes choisies. Vous pouvez également créer des groupes privés, pour organiser et partager encore plus facilement et rapidement vos cutes. Cute! est positif et intime: si votre compte est privé, vous pouvez accepter ou refuser les demandes d’abonnement à votre compte. Vous pouvez apposer votre texte sur une photo ou sur un des fonds exclusifs offerts dans l’application et les partager. Vous pouvez aussi voir et lire les publications (les cutes) des autres utilisateurs qui l’ont permis, les “aimer” et les commenter. Sur Cute!, jamais trop de vos chers petits cocos! Jamais trop de Fido, votre fidèle et mignon compagnon. Voici la manière la plus rapide et la plus simple de préserver les souvenirs de tous ceux qui vous sont chers... Vous pouvez répertorier vos “cutes” dans des albums, les modifier ou les supprimer. Cute! immortalise votre histoire, un cute à la fois! Tout le monde a son côté cute: parents, oncles, tantes, amoureux-amoureuses, amis-amies, patron-patronnes, collègues, profs, éducateurs-éducatrices, grands-parents, fous de minou, folles de pitou… Votre vie est occupée, chargée et pressée... Laissez-nous vous aider à y ajouter un peu de Cute! Tout ce qui est cute est maintenant retenu POUR vous! Fièrement pensée et conçue au Québec!
Produit local. Impression en 24 à 48 heures. Livraison entre 5 et 10 jours.

First of all, we tell you about the crazy police officer simulator who gets up early in the morning in a police car chase game. He goes to the washroom to take a shower and then wear uniform in police officer games. After that goes to the kitchen to do breakfast in these cop games of 2021. 
Now the police officer simulator goes to the car garage and drives his car to the office in police chase games. The police arrives at the office on time and then marks your attendance in the police chase simulator. Then look at his daily tasks list to see their daily routine tasks in the cop chase game. The police chase officer is given the task of checking every vehicle that enters the city in police games 2021. Searches of the people's vehicles and checks their luggage in a police simulator games. The search for vehicles illegal weapons and other smuggling things in city police simulator. After that, the city police officer checks the id cards from the peoples who enter the city in a police simulator game. 
Be the officer in miami police crime department and arrest the culprits that are trying to snatch money from citizens or make robbery in the banks. The police department sees your performance and gives you a challenging task in the police officer game. Your mission is to control the gangster who destroy the peace of the town in this police chase games. The city gangster steals a lot of things from the peoples in cop games. The people of the city are worried from crime gangster. The criminal make a bank robbery plan, so go and destroy the plan of the gangster in this police cop simulator. The police officer chase the gangster and attack on gangsters in crime police games. The police cops saves the bank from robbery and catch a lots of criminals from crime city in this police cop simulator game. 
The city police officer shut down criminal people in the prison and punish them in this police cop simulator. The virtual police officer encounter of the criminal peoples in crime city games. Arrest all the gangster and come back to police station for investigation in police chase simulator game. The people of the city are worried about of criminal because the gangster steal the things when peoples walk on the road in police chase simulator. Now people of the city go to the market without any worries. The virtual police officer successfully missions completed and clear the city from the gangster in crime city games. 
 Features:
• Stunning and exciting cop games officer tasks to accomplish
• Take multiple challenging missions along with police squad
• Arrest the criminal peoples and come back police station
• High quality graphics with 3D environment in police chase games

bluejetty:00074045:android.description:
You’re a mustached hero and you've awakened the Eye God by stealing his sacred ruby - bad move.
The race of death is on - POW! It started when you grabbed the sacred ruby and ignited the temple laser.
Run fast, climb each hill, and combat every obstacle while you shoot down the Eye God’s worshipers (they’re a bit slow and get in your way).
Collect gems on your path, build your gun inventory and shoot your way to survival, A.K.A your highest score (let’s face it, you’re going to die).
If you like our Hopeless series, then you’ll love this action game!
Ruby Run's Key Features:
 • Earn gems for having friends! When logged-in with Facebook, if any of your friends join, you will get more gems.
 • Get even more gems when you defeat your friends when logged-in to Facebook.
 • Build your weapon collection with the Gun Lottery to help you wipe out those pesky worshipers. Collect them all!
 • In the mood for grenades today? You can choose any gun (even a grenade launcher!) from your inventory.
 • Get other free goodies along the way.
 • A new game from the developers of Hopeless: The Dark Cave
