bluejetty:00116951:android.description:
Children love to play, this is not news to anyone.
Now, a group of friends who live in a shantytown in Brazil launched the following challenge: Irritate the neighborhood! 
The aim is to Lady Coroca, an old lady grouchy neighborhood resident.
They have to: ring the bell of her house and try to escape it up as far as possible in order to let her furious.
The scenario has very similar characteristics to the Brazilian peripheries, full of national reference, such as houses, cars, buses, cards, among others.
But it is easy to understand for any player in the world. The focus is that everyone can have the "experience" and feel how fun is the day to day of children in Brazilian peripheries.
The game has a help screen, so you go and learn all about the game.
-Run away as far as you can and compete the highest score among your Facebook friends and world ranking.
-Earn rewards every record sharing overcome.
-Collect coins to buy characters or enhance your gaming experience.
-Buy And from 8 characters with personalities and different soundtracks.
-Find The Magnet to attract more coins.
-Find The spring to increase the height of your jump and facilitate his escape.
-Find The multiplier to multiply your points.
-Multiply your points every game to achieve the highest position in the ranking.
-Have a good time to each character's collision with obstacles and share your gaming experience with your friends in various social networks.
-The game is available in languages: Portuguese, English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Russian.

bluejetty:00087437:ios.summary: PC Tycoon 2 is a brand new version of PC Tycoon. In the game you have to manage your computer company and develop your PC components: processors, video cards, motherboards, RAM, disks. You can create your own laptop, monitor, or develop an
bluejetty:00087437:ios.description:
PC Tycoon 2 is a brand new version of PC Tycoon. In the game you have to manage your computer company and develop your PC components: processors, video cards, motherboards, RAM, disks. You can create your own laptop, monitor, or develop an operating system that you can test. You will also be able to build a PC, as in PC Creator 2 or PC building simulator. Research new technologies, improve your office and your factory, hire the best employees, invest in marketing, or save money and buy one of the computer giants!
PC Tycoon 2 gives you almost complete freedom of action. Create components for your computer from scratch by selecting the desired characteristics and design. The game has a lot of features that are not found in other games of this genre, such as PC Creator 2 or Devices Tycoon: detailed statistics of your company and products, intelligent algorithms for evaluating products and behavior of companies, a computer simulator, interactive operating systems created by the player that you can test. You can become a PC Builder. You can create a gaming, office or server PC. 
PC Tycoon 2 is a company management simulator and a PC or laptop building simulator. The variety of game mechanics makes the game very exciting. 
Also in the game there are:
* 3000+ technologies for research
* Challenging mode for fans of economic strategies
* Smart behavior of competitors, automatic development and release of products
* The ability to run the OS on your gaming PC
* 10 levels of office improvement with beautiful 3D models
* Many ways to invest your money, including buying companies, marketing, paid employee search
Many more new features are planned to be added in future updates, such as:
* PC Assembly
* Animations of employees in the office
* Office skins
* Many new component designs 
* Season passes with exclusive rewards
* Cloud synchronization
Computer tycoon 2 is a business simulator game that is worth your attention and is a serious player among economic strategies.
You can always ask your question, suggest an idea, communicate with developers and other players and become part of the game community by logging into discord or telegram:
https://discord.gg/enyUgzB4Ab
https://t.me/insignis_g
Have a good game!

bluejetty:00098399:ios.summary: Ragnarok Crush — Your epic quest begins now! Adventurers, assemble! Step into a world where your favorite Ragnarok Online characters and classes unite in a new match-merge strategy game. Solve ingenious puzzles, power up your heroes, and fa
bluejetty:00098399:ios.description:
Ragnarok Crush — Your epic quest begins now! Adventurers, assemble! Step into a world where your favorite Ragnarok Online characters and classes unite in a new match-merge strategy game. Solve ingenious puzzles, power up your heroes, and face MVP Bosses in the ultimate showdown across the Midgard continent!
▼ Game Highlights ▼ 
Legendary RO Classes Unite – Fight alongside Swordsmen, Mages, Thieves, and more. Unlock Awakening skills to build the ultimate party. 
Innovative Match-Merge Combat – Strategically combine allies on the board—every move tests both wits and tactics. 
Hundreds of Dynamic Stages – Diverse mechanics and puzzle twists push your problem-solving limits. 
Hero Progression System – Gather gear and resources, strengthen your roster, and unleash rare Arcane abilities. 
Explore the RO Universe – Journey through Prontera, Payon, and other iconic maps; hunt MVP monsters to uncover hidden lore. 
Epic MVP Boss Battles – Outsmart colossal foes through puzzle combat and claim exclusive skins & legendary materials. 
Seasonal Events – Regular RO themed modes and dungeons that deliver fresh challenges and unique rewards.
▼ Top 3 Reasons to Play ▼ 
Endless Strategy – Merge evolution × tower-defense placements × match combos—mix and match playstyles to conquer every map. 
Authentic RO Art Style – Fully licensed assets ensure faithful visuals—no clones, no reskins, Just real RO vibes. 
Party Up with Friends – Join guilds, team up in co-op raids, and tackle dual-player dungeons together.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RagnarokCrush
Discord: https://discord.gg/ZjMAseG7Wp
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@GravityGameHub/videos

***For Free NOW***
Always going to the print shop?
*FP scanner is the top and easy to use App of its kind, which can help you save a lot of money. It is tiny yet powerful, and there is no need to pay. It is committed to becoming the best scanner for your IPhone.
Still typing one by one?
*Fast Text recognition&Extraction. Whether it is PPT courseware, company documents transcription, paper books, shopping receipts, photo translation text, ID card recognition and so on, FP Scanner can accurately and efficiently extract all of the text for you.
Work with peace of mind and leave the rest to me!
----Key Feature----
[Precise trimming, No watermark]
-Excellent image processing engine, Remove cluttered backgrounds automatically, and generate PDF files comparable to scanners.
-No watermark, You may rest assured to use for formal occasions.
[Text recognition, Accurate and Efficient]
- Automatic detection of multiple languages, supporting OCR function of English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, Spanish, Arabic, Italian, German, Portuguese, Vietnamese, Malay, Russian, Dutch, Swedish, Finnish, Danish, Norwegian, Hungarian, Thai and other languages.
- Automatic segmentation of recognition results, free editing and selection, can be copied to a variety of APP for use.
- Image upload encryption processing, No privacy disclosure.
[Unlimited export, Easy manage]
-3s extremely fast export file, refused to crash.
-Support iCLOUD SYNC and local management, wherever you go, there is a record, everything is recorded, and you can completely release your brainpower.
[Concise page, Efficient editing]
-Function-oriented, flashy and useless design can only reduce efficiency.Your scanning experience should be rapid and humanized.
-A variety of image optimization modes, manual adjustment of image parameters, quickly converted to a clear scan.
[Subscribe Service]
* Subscribe reminder: This product may contain pay fees, please pay attention to management subscriptions. 
FP Scanner provides a monthly subscription, becoming a FP Scanner member to unlock more interesting features.
- Pay: After successful subscription, the iTunes account will be charged.
- Renewal: The iTunes account will deduct a deduction 24 hours before the current subscription cycle, and the subscription service will be delayed after the renewal fee is successful.
- Cancellation: If you need to cancel the renewal after successful purchase, you need to manually turn the automatic renewal function in iTunes / Apple ID settings 24 hours before the current subscription. Privacy Policy：http://resource.guansuqx.com/FP_Scanner/privacy.html
We’d love to hear your feedback:
1.Tap the "Setting" icon -- Help
2.Send e-mail to: fpfreescanner@gmail.com
3.Like us on Facebook&Instagram：FP Scanner
REMINDER:
In order to bring a better scanning experience, please ensure that your documents are smooth and sensitive to light.
When scanning with old equipment, it is recommended to scan at least 25cm away from the document to avoid problems such as blurring of the finished product.
It is recommended to use a dead color background to make the scanning more accurate.

bluejetty:00115830:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone, iPad, or PC into a bigger-screen experience with Screen Mirroring：PigeonCast.
Screen Mirroring：PigeonCast to TV helps you screen mirror, screen share, and cast to TV with fewer steps and smoother playback. Whether you want to mirror iPhone to TV for videos, cast iPad to TV for presentations, or send content from PC to TV, PigeonCast makes wireless display simple.
KEY FEATURES
▶ Screen Mirroring for iPhone and iPad
Mirror your iPhone or iPad screen to a larger display for streaming, demos, learning, and family viewing. PigeonCast is designed to make screen mirror sessions stable, clear, and quick to start.
▶ Cast to TV with Google Cast-compatible devices
Use PigeonCast to cast to TV on supported smart TVs and compatible TV boxes. This is especially useful when you want a flexible screen mirroring app that works across different device environments.
▶ Cross Devices File Transfer
Send Photos, Videos, Music, Files, Folders,Messages to TV/PC installed with our PigeonCastReceiver app.
▶ Screen Share Across More Devices
Need more than phone-to-TV mirroring? PigeonCast also supports broader screen share scenarios, including connecting to PC, Mac, and other large-screen receivers through our own receiver workflow.
▶ HD Wireless Display Experience
Enjoy a clean wireless display experience with high-quality screen mirroring, low-latency performance, and flexible connection options depending on device support.
▶ Easy Connection Methods
Connect by device discovery, Wi-Fi search, or code scanning. Whether you are using PigeonCast for home entertainment, school, or work, setup stays simple.
Our mirroring app is built for users who want an easy screen mirroring app without complicated setup. Open the app, find a compatible device, and start sharing your screen in moments. For Google Cast-compatible TVs and displays, PigeonCast gives you a more direct way to cast content across devices and ecosystems.
Why choose PigeonCast:
- Screen mirror iPhone and iPad to compatible TVs
- Screen share content from your phone, tablet, or computer
- Cast to TV for videos, presentations, browsing, and everyday use
- Smooth playback with optional audio control
- HD mirroring with support up to 2K depending on device
Perfect for:
- Watching videos on a bigger screen
- Sharing slides, documents, or teaching content
- Casting casual games and apps to TV
- Mirroring iPhone or iPad during meetings
- Sending content from PC to TV for a larger view
PigeonCast also fits common screen-sharing needs such as phone mirroring, iPad mirroring, screen sharing, wireless display, cast videos to TV, and mirror phone to TV. It can be used with supported Samsung, LG, Sony, Roku, Vizio, TCL, Hisense, Apple TV, Fire TV, Google TV, Chromecast and other compatible smart TVs or receivers.
Works perfectly with Apple TV & other smart TVs such as Sony, Samsung(2018-2023), LG(after2018, higher than webOS 4.0), TCL, Roku, Vizio, Xiaomi, Hitv,etc.
Notes:
- Google Cast-compatible TVs must support the relevant cast protocol.
- Your phone, tablet, computer, and TV should be on the same Wi-Fi for best results.
- Resolution and performance may vary by device and network conditions.
Terms of Use: https://pigeoncast.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://pigeoncast.com/privacy

Standly looks at real lifestyle factors, not just age
We combine genetics, posture, nutrition, sleep quality, and growth stage to give a more realistic estimate of your potential height.
Your plan is built around how growth actually happens
Standly creates a personalized routine focused on posture, mobility, recovery, and daily habits that support natural hormone activity and long-term growth.
Instead of giving you a single number and guessing from a chart, Standly looks at the full picture. As your habits improve, your prediction adjusts over time, so you can see real progress as you stay consistent.
Standly includes:
A dynamic prediction model that updates as you improve
A personalized daily routine designed for posture and flexibility
Lifestyle guidance to help you optimize sleep, nutrition, and recovery
Ongoing tracking so you stay accountable and motivated

bluejetty:00184848:ios.description:
Horizontal Speed is not enough for snanic, now it is the time to blast the limits and gotta go HIGH! time to conquer the sky! , side by side you and sniac will do!
And then suddenly Sainc crashed through your window and took your hand. Told you everything would be fine and took you to the hight council of the illuminati at began the travel around the world.
The story shifts with every choice, but not in that fake “your choices matter” way. Nah, this one actually remembers who you are. You make a selfish choice early? The world subtly twists — people look at you differently, music turns colder, and suddenly even the sunlight feels judgmental. Make a kind choice? The world breathes again. It’s like the game’s emotionally synced to your soul. Halfway through, you stop playing for loot or missions. You start playing to find yourself. Every scene feels like therapy wrapped in a dream. There’s no “final boss” — just a moment where you finally understand why everything happened the way it did. And that realization? Bro… goosebumps

bluejetty:00042501:ios.description:
***Enhance Your Wedding Guest Experience With WedTexts!***
Wedding text messages and pre-scheduled wedding text reminders to keep your guests informed and your stress levels at a minimum.
WedTexts is FREE to Use With Your Entire Wedding Party!
All messages are sent directly to guests’ cell phones via SMS text message which means your guests don’t need to download any apps!
***Create Memories With Your Guests***
Wedding text messages perfectly complement all of your wedding events by bringing wedding communication into the future. 
Keep your guests in the loop so they don’t miss out on one minute of your wedding celebrations! 
Using WedTexts for your wedding communication will keep your guests talking about your wedding for years to come!
***Be Prepared For Anything***
Murphy’s Law says, “if anything can go wrong, it will.” 
With wedding text messages you’ll be prepared for anything that tries to ruin your wedding experience! 
With unlimited pre-scheduled wedding text reminders, you’ll be able to plan your wedding weekend months in advance. 
And because WedTexts allows you to send unlimited real-time wedding text messages, you won’t be stressed when something inevitably goes wrong at the last minute.
****Features for You****
>Cost Saving Communication - Average cost of one-time invitations + postage = $4.50/guest … Average cost of unlimited messages with WedTexts = $1.33/guest
>Unlimited Groups - Organize guests into unlimited groups, so you can personalize their WedTexts reminders
>Unlimited Pre-scheduled Reminders - Schedule unlimited WedTexts reminders in advance, so you don’t have to think about them later
>Unlimited Real-time Messages - When things don’t go according to plan, your guests won’t be left in the dark, you can send unlimited real-time messages to your guests at no extra cost
>WedTexts Templates - Schedule all your automatic wedding reminders in 5-minutes or less with WedTexts Templates
>One Message to All Guests - Send any message, to all your guests, all at once
>Custom messages - Fully customizable text messages for a unique guest experience
>Editable messages - Scheduled WedTexts reminders can be edited in case something changes
>Mobile apps - Edit your WedTexts account from anywhere with our mobile apps
****Features for Your Guests****
>No App Needed - Communicate with your guests w/o requiring them to download an app
>No Smartphone, No Problem - Guests can receive your WedTexts reminders if they can receive a text message
>Messages are sent as an SMS - No matter what phone carrier, operating system, or cell phone your guests have, they will get your WedTexts reminders
>All-Inclusive Guest Experience - Remind guests about all of the fun things you have planned for them, so they don't miss out on any of your wedding experience.
>Addresses Link to Map Apps - Guests can get directions with one click inside a WedTexts reminder
>Guest Groups - Your entire guest list can receive reminder messages or you can send out custom messages to unique groups of guests, so guests get exactly the information they need when they need it.
What are you waiting for?
Take your guest experience to the next level with wedding text messages from WedTexts!
*****Sign Up For Free Today!*****

bluejetty:00137265:ios.description:
If you enjoy interior decoration and relaxing Jigsaw puzzles we have a game just for you! Collect pisces and build furniture! Transform an empty space into a cozy little house of your dreams: you can sit back and do simple, quick puzzles to assemble furniture for a room you’re decorating. bluejetty:00128457:ios.description:
'Incredible. Meditation made easy.' - Franca Attoh
'Great App, I read it before mass, first thing at morning, when I feel down.it's the best!' - Chigozie Ofor
Over 100,000 people are diving deeper into the daily gospel readings from the Catholic Mass with eScrivalite. Let St Josemaria Escriva guide you to a fuller understanding of the Gospel as you meditate on his words. Users have said using the App has made Meditation easier. Why not make it a part of your daily prayer routine?
St Josemaria's writings emphasize the laity's calling to sanctification. Pope St John Paul II made the following observation in his homily at the beatification of Escrivá: 'With supernatural intuition, Blessed Josemaría untiringly preached the universal call to holiness and apostolate. Christ calls everyone to become holy in the realities of everyday life. Hence work too is a means of personal holiness and apostolate, when it is done in union with Jesus Christ.'
This free App makes the reading of the Gospel easy, attractive and straightforward. Just click on TODAY to access the Gospel of the day and the writings from St. Josemaria's published works about that Gospel.
Click on the relevant points to read St. Josemaria's commentaries on the Gospel. Just click on the text you want to read, and the point opens up.
If you upgrade to the Premium version you can download and own eight of St Josemaria's books; The Way, Furrow, The Forge, Christ is Passing By, Friends of God, Conversations, Holy Rosary, and The Way of the Cross.
Available in 11 different languages, eScrivaLite identifies your preferred language, and it also comes with an inbuilt language selection tool for greater flexibility.

bluejetty:00072577:ios.description:
Are you ready to unleash your creativity and dive into a world of stunning home decor and interior design? Look no further than Art Assemble, the immersive decorating game that allows you to transform your dream home into a breathtaking art house. With its unique blend of puzzle solving and decor placement, Art Assemble is the ultimate destination for design enthusiasts of all levels.
• Assemble Numerous Projects in a Fun Setting with a 3D Puzzle Twist
 In Art Assemble, you'll be challenged to complete a variety of projects by placing items in a playful 3D puzzle environment. Art Assemble offers endless possibilities for you to explore and assemble your own unique design masterpieces.
• An Ever-Expanding Variety of Designs with Unique Interior Furniture
 Get ready to embark on a design journey like no other. Art Assemble offers a vast range of designs, each with its own unique interior furniture and theme such as the elegant Glee Boutique, the Learning Loft, or the perfect Barber Shop, every design project presents a new adventure for you to embark on. 
• Create Your Own Town Once the Designs are Complete
 In Art Assemble, your design journey doesn't end with individual projects. Once you've completed a design, you have the opportunity to create your own town using the completed projects as building blocks. Imagine having your dream home and many other unique designs all in one captivating town. With Art Assemble, you can bring your vision to life and showcase your creativity to the world.
• Relaxing and Simple-to-Play Experience

Identify any plant with one click of an image, and our advanced plant identification tool recognizes thousands of species, helping you learn more about its medicinal properties. Simply take a photo of your plantnet, and our app will provide detailed information on its care needs and ideal growing conditions, helping you treat your health problems and illnesses with home remedies.
This plant identification app with herb brings together natural medicine experts, herbalists, botanists, and naturalists to teach you the science of plants and plant flora. 
Perhaps you don't know which plant you have? You can simply take a photo and our plant identifier will tell you instantly. You can scan all your houseplants to find out their scientific and common names, then learn how to care for them.
Its AI plant identification module allows you to identify the mushrooms, and flowers in your garden, botanical herb, and forest. Simply snap a plant or fruit, and our AI will predict the recognition of this image with over 90% accuracy and suggest its benefits in garden Flora.
The Forum menu is a space for discussion between forum members, naturopaths specializing in natural medicine, botanists,naturalists, and herbalists. The Video menu explains in more detail herbs, bark, and Ayurvedic spices with medicinal properties from the forest. We recommend seeking the advice of a doctor or botanist before making any medical decisions based on medicinal plant and their tips. You must capture a close-up image to ensure a good identification result with our AI.
With our application, plants, herbs, barks and spices no longer hold any secrets for you.

Pay invoices and deposits with Apple Pay or a saved card. Tip your sitter, set up auto-pay with a spending limit you control, and view your full payment history.

MESSAGING
Message your pet sitter directly through the app.
BULLETINS
Stay up to date with announcements, news, and updates from your pet sitter.
DOCUMENTS
View contracts, agreements, and other important files your sitter has shared with you.

bluejetty:00099124:ios.description:
*Try SILT for free and unlock the full game to continue your journey!*
Dive into a surreal ocean abyss in an atmospheric puzzle-adventure. Explore dangerous waters, possess sea creatures and solve environmental puzzles to discover what lies deep below the surface…
SILT is a surreal underwater puzzle-adventure game. Alone in an underwater abyss, you are a diver searching the deep to uncover long-forgotten mysteries. 
Possess the creatures around you to solve puzzles and travel further into the darkness…
Nature has evolved into bizarre forms. Discover strange organisms, unexplored ruins and ancient machinery hidden beneath the water’s surface.
Survive encounters with giant deep-sea goliaths. Harness their power to awaken a long-dormant force at the centre of the abyss.
Experience art brought to life.  SILT’s unsettling, monochrome world is constructed from the sketches and dark imagination of artist Mr Mead. A harrowing journey awaits you…
EPILEPSY WARNING
Please read before playing this game or allowing your children to play it:
Some people are susceptible to epileptic seizures or loss of consciousness when exposed to certain flashing lights and moving patterns in everyday life. Such people may have a seizure while watching television images or playing certain video games. This may happen even if the person has no medical history of epilepsy or has never had any epileptic seizures.
If you or anyone in your family has ever had symptoms related to epilepsy (seizures or loss of consciousness) when exposed to flashing lights or moving patterns, consult your doctor prior to playing this game. If you or your family experience any symptoms of seizure while playing this game, such as dizziness, nausea, or loss of consciousness, stop playing immediately and seek medical attention.

* Robotics & Physical Computing

前两天发布了我要在一周内制作一个文字游戏，是类似于人生重开模拟器这样的游戏，有玩家说市面上已经有了为什么我还要做呢？因为1.我想做的是武侠重开模拟器，2.市面上的打开就是广告，干什么都是广告，我玩起来很不爽，我觉得不是人生重开模拟器，是广告重开模拟器，所以我要自己做一个纯文字武侠重开游戏，想参与测试和讨论的小伙伴已经想策划游戏的小伙伴都可以加入了QQ群：299807533，或者关注微信公众号：Lairdodox 或 bearNC

【职业系统】玩家可以在其中扮演木匠、铁匠、矿工、渔夫等职业。
【结婚系统】可以和心仪的武林侠士结婚了。
【好友系统】部分武功秘籍、神兵利器就看你有没有找对人搞好关系了，异性角色还可以结婚。
【门派系统】你可以加入各门各派，每一个门派都有职位小至弟子大道掌门，你的身份会因为你的行为发生变化。
【生活系统】在过程中你会进行很多小游戏的互动。
【奇遇系统】命运造化天注定，武林秘籍、神兵利器就看你机缘了，金庸、古龙著名人物都将现身其中。
【善恶系统】正邪不两立，两种人生两种命运可自由抉择，善恶将影响游戏发展和所能拜入的门派。
【天气系统】不同区域有特别的天气现象出现，或是下雨或是下雪，不同的天气会有不一样的奇遇经历。
【秘籍系统】许多绝世武功可能藏匿于某处或记载在某本书卷之中，若是寻获便可以习得上面的武功。
【结伴系统】闯荡江湖怎么能少得了好友相助，与人关系到一定程度之后便可以邀请对方加入自己队伍。

bluejetty:00030905:ios.description:
Litely – A simple, balanced way to manage your weight and feel good every day.
Litely is designed for user who want to build healthy habits without extreme dieting. Instead of focusing on just one method, Litely brings together nutrition, tracking, fasting, and wellness guidance into one easy, supportive space.
With Litely, you don’t just track your progress — you understand your body, your habits, and what actually works for you.
MAIN FEATURES
Smart Nutrition Tracking
Track more than just calories and get a complete view of your daily intake:
• Calories and macros (protein, carbs, fat)
• Fiber for gut health and fullness
• Sugar and sodium for better balance and less bloating
• Easy food scanner for quick, stress-free logging
Meal Plans & Recipes
Take the guesswork out of eating:
• Simple, realistic meal plans
• Easy recipes designed for weight management
• Flexible approach with no strict restrictions
Intermittent Fasting Made Simple
Explore fasting in a healthy, sustainable way:
• Personalized fasting plans
• Built-in fasting tracker
• Guidance tailored for women
Daily Habit Tracking
Stay consistent with small habits that matter:
• Exercise tracking
• Water intake tracking
• Daily progress insights to keep you on track
Wellness & Education
Learn what your body really needs with practical content:
• Intermittent fasting
• Nutrition and healthy eating
• Weight loss strategies
• Women’s health
• Fitness and exercise
AI Wellness Coach
Get instant answers anytime you need support:
• Ask about fasting, workouts, recipes, or nutrition
• Get guidance based on your goals and habits
• Feel supported throughout your journey
WHY LITELY
Most apps focus on one thing. Litely connects everything — so your nutrition, habits, and progress all work together.
No pressure. No extremes. Just a simpler way to feel lighter, more confident, and in control.
Start your journey with Litely today.
Contact: support@mail.litely.life
Litely Terms of Service: https://www.litely.life/terms/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.litely.life/privacy/
Disclaimer
This app is designed for informational purposes only and does not provide medical advice. Always consult your professional healthcare provider before starting any fasting routine or making decisions about your body and health.
INFORMATION ON USING THE APP AND REGARDING SUBSCRIPTION
Litely app is free to download and use. However, to unlock the full range of features, you can choose from various subscription plans. When you opt for a subscription, the price is determined based on your country and displayed within the app. If you wish to continue your subscription, it will automatically renew for the originally chosen duration, charging your selected payment method, unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current term expires. You also have the option to disable the auto-renewal feature in your App Store account settings.

The OnBoard board intelligence platform enables teams and boards be forward-looking and strategic. OnBoard provides a secure and comprehensive set of tools to help you and your organization prepare, conduct, and analyze board meetings to maximize post-meeting productivity. 
Key features include a seamless Zoom integration for virtual meetings, annotations, eSignatures, secure messaging, RSVP, voting and approvals, a resource library, offline access, multi-board and subcommittee support, and more. 
OnBoard's industry-leading Microsoft Azure-based and multi-certified security protocols keep meeting materials safe and within compliance. Features include end-to-end encryption, two-factor authentication, Face & Touch ID, granular access permissions, remote device wipes, and multiple data centers. 
Key Features and Capabilities: 
• Fully integrated Zoom web conferencing that allows remote participation while having access to all the features of OnBoard 
• Always up-to-date board books in real-time on any device, anywhere 
• Secure Messaging 
• Vote on motions and approvals 
• Powerful analytics and insights 
• In-Meeting Agenda and Time Tracker & Post-Meeting Ratings 
• RSVP and attendance tracker 
• Resource center for bylaws, past notes, annual budget, and key governance materials 
• Personalized Dashboard with access to the latest meetings, meeting materials, and announcements 
• Notes and Annotations that sync across every device 
• Two-factor authentication 
• Multi-board and sub-committee support 
• Offline access 
• eSignatures 
• D&O Surveys and Questionnaires 
• Industry-Leading Support and Customer Success 
Security: 
OnBoard’s security features keeps your meeting materials safe and your organization in compliance. We apply industry-leading security measures. 
• Encryption in Transit and Rest and the most robust standards in the board portal industry. Our data centers utilize industry-leading RSA 4096-bit encryption for data in transit between a user's device and the data centers. 
• Compliant with a broad range of international information security standards, including but not limited to: GLBA, FERPA, HIPAA, FISMA ISO 27001/27002, SOC 1, SOC 2, SOC 3, SSAE 16/ISAE 3402. 
• Azure Security Partnering with Microsoft Azure, OnBoard offers world-class security, full disaster recovery, and active geo-replication. 
Support and Training: 
OnBoard support includes 24/7 U.S. based phone and online chat. An online resource center includes detailed guides on how to use OnBoard. 
Customer Success Managers provide ongoing support. This includes strategic guidance and best practices as well as live, interactive, training to administrators and end-users whenever needed. 
Support is wide-ranging and comprehensive.

bluejetty:00028746:ios.description:
Work Time Calculator is the all-in-one tool designed for shift workers, freelancers, and anyone who tracks their hours. With a clear, user-friendly interface, it makes logging your work simple, accurate, and stress-free.
Easily calculate your working hours, break times, and earnings – just enter your shift’s start and end times, and the app does the rest.
Key Features:
- Customisable shift entries with support for multiple jobs
- Automatic calculation of total hours and pay
- Break tracking that adjusts your paid time accurately
- Flexible shift rotation for recurring work patterns
- Notes for adding shift-specific details
- Daily pay adjustments, including tips and bonuses
- Smart search to find past shifts by date or keyword
- Seamless support for both hourly and daily rates
Whether you’re managing a full-time job, part-time gig, or juggling multiple roles, Work Time Calculator helps you stay organised, on schedule, and in control of your pay.
Subscription terms:
- The subscription auto-renews at the end of each term.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy policy and Terms of Use: https://applorium.com/privacy-policy-work-time-calculator

bluejetty:00167673:ios.description:
BetterBanking™ starts here. Simple. Fast. Personal.
Open accounts, send money, pay bills, manage cards, and grow your savings, all from one app.
Open an account in minutes
Sign up with one valid ID and a quick selfie.
Already have a Security Bank account? Just register and everything syncs automatically.
Send money in seconds
Transfer funds via InstaPay or PESONet, or scan and pay with QR Ph at over one million merchants.
Gold Circle members and Wealth customers enjoy unlimited free InstaPay transfers.
Pay thousands of billers in one place.
Save more with GoalSetter
Use GoalSetter to build savings Goals and grow your money with tiered interest.
Stay in control of your cards
Activate, lock, or unlock your cards anytime.
Turn purchases into installments with ChargeLight or access funds instantly with Ready Cash.
Travel with confidence
Manage your card in the app and pay for travel fares with your Security Bank Platinum or World Mastercard to get free travel insurance for accidents, flight cancellations, and baggage loss.
Designed around you
Choose from accounts like Easy Savings, All Access, Money Builder, and USD Savings.
Talk to a real person, anytime
Get real-time updates and support when you need it.
Connect with a real support specialist through in-app live chat, 24/7.
Reliable banking you can count on
The Security Bank app is available over 99% of the time, helping ensure uninterrupted access to your finances.
Deposits are insured by PDIC up to ₱1 Million per depositor. Security Bank Corporation is regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas https://www.bsp.gov.ph 
For assistance, visit the Help Center in the app or contact: customercare@securitybank.com.ph or (+632) 8887 9188

bluejetty:00132067:ios.summary:
Are you ready to explore the world one guess at a time? Worldle is the ultimate geography game for everyone, from students and teachers to puzzle enthusiasts and casual gamers. It’s easy and fun to play at any skill level.
HOW IT WORKS:
*
bluejetty:00132067:ios.description:
Are you ready to explore the world one guess at a time? Worldle is the ultimate geography game for everyone, from students and teachers to puzzle enthusiasts and casual gamers. It’s easy and fun to play at any skill level.
HOW IT WORKS:
* Guess the mystery country or territory in as few tries as possible.
* Each guess provides clues to help you narrow down your options.
* Learn new facts about countries, territories, flags, and geography with every game.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORLDLE:
* Daily Challenges: Enjoy a new puzzle every day.
* Educational: Improve your geography skills and learn about different cultures.
* Competitive: Challenge friends and family to see who guess the answer in the fewest tries.
* Fun and Addictive: Experience the satisfaction of solving a challenging puzzle.
* Share Your Progress: Show off your skills and connect with other players.
* Multiple Game Modes: Subscribe for unlimited play of classic and flag game modes. 
Worldle is more than just a game; it's a daily adventure. Join the millions of players who have fallen in love with this unique and engaging puzzle experience. Just like the New Your Times Games: Mini, Tiles, Letter Box, Connections, Wordle, Spelling Bee, Strands, Crossword, and Sudoku; Worldle will become one of your favorite Daily Games. 
Download Worldle today and start exploring the world!
WHY EDUCATORS, STUDENTS, AND PARENTS SHOULD PLAY:
Worldle presents students with a fun and easy way to learn about the countries and territories in the world. Students will not only learn what a country looks like but also where it is in relation to other countries in the world. 
Teachers who make this game part of their grade level curriculum will find that not only does it give student’s something that they can all work on independently but will allow for great discussions as students share their wins and losses. 
Parents can have fun challenging their children to find the location first. Subscribing to premium is the best way to get the most out of the game. 
Note: a limited number of educator licenses are available. If you are a teacher and are interested email us at XingAppsLLC@gmail.com.
DIGITAL SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS:
You can purchase a weekly or annual subscriptions. As a subscriber, you’ll enjoy the full Worldle experience including Classic and Flagle Modes. See our subscription offers for further details.
PAYMENT AND AUTOMATIC RENEWAL TERMS:
If you subscribe to Worldle within this app, your Apple ID account will be charged at the time of purchase and automatically renewed at the end of each billing period. To cancel your subscription, you must turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage your subscription settings through your iTunes account.
Privacy Policy: http://www.XingApps.com/Privacy
Terms of Use: http://www.XingApps.com/Terms
Note: A subscription to Worldle does not grant access to any other app’s paid platform.

bluejetty:00115934:ios.summary:
STEP UP TO THE PLATE
Relive the second baseball game in the Backyard Sports franchise, now enhanced to run on iOS. Whether you're picking your dream team, playing a pick-up game, or diving into a full season, step up to the plate and experi
bluejetty:00115934:ios.description:
STEP UP TO THE PLATE
Relive the second baseball game in the Backyard Sports franchise, now enhanced to run on iOS. Whether you're picking your dream team, playing a pick-up game, or diving into a full season, step up to the plate and experience the game that made baseball fun for everyone!
Backyard Baseball ‘01 teams up the Backyard kids with Backyardified MLB legends. Create your own Backyard team, customize your uniforms, and strategize to win the Championship. Play a single pick-up game or play through an entire season. Backyard Baseball ‘01 features intuitive controls for all ages!
SWING BACK INTO BASEBALL
Enjoy baseball like it’s 2001!
30 Charming Backyard kids
Legendary MLB Players
MLB Team Marks
Hilarious Bloopers
8 Classic Ballparks
9 Pitching Power-ups and 4 batting Power-ups
Lively commentary from Sunny Day and Vinnie
To get into the swing of things, choose a batter and face Mr. Clanky for some batting practice. This is where you’ll learn just when to click to make your chosen batter hit the ball!
THE GOAT RETURNS
Play with the legend himself, Pablo Sanchez. Build a roster from a cast of 30 hilarious child athletes and 28 legendary pros that made Backyard Baseball ‘01 a sports classic. Returning MLB players include Derek Jeter, Alex Rodriguez, Cal Ripken Jr., Sammy Sosa, Mike Piazza, Randy Johnson, Nomar Garciaparra, Jeff Bagwell, Jason Giambi, Chipper Jones, Jeromy Burnitz, Mark McGwire, Shawn Green, Vladimir Guerrero, Kenny Lofton, Jason Kendall, Barry Larkin, Marty Cordova, Mo Vaughn, Raul Mondesi, Curt Schilling, Alex Gonzalez, Juan Gonzalez, Larry Walker, Carlos Beltran, Tony Gwynn, Ivan Rodriguez, and Jose Canseco.
Game Modes include:
Choose from three modes of play (Easy Mode, Medium Mode, Hard Mode)
Random Pick-up: A quick way to jump right in! The computer chooses a random team for you and itself and the game starts immediately.
Single Game: You take turns with the computer choosing players from a random pool of characters.
Season: You pick your home field, create a team, and manage the team through a 14 game series. The opposing teams are computer generated. At the end of the season, the best two teams advance to the BBL playoffs (best of 3). If you keep winning, you’ll compete in the Super Entire Nation Tournament and Ultra Grand Championship of the Universe Series!
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
At our core, we are fans first – not just of video games, but of the Backyard Sports franchise. Fans have asked for accessible and legal ways to play their original Backyard titles for years, and we are excited to deliver.
Without having access to the source code, there are hard limitations on the experience we can create. As an example, we can’t use the original 32bit code to support modern macOS, as even with an incredibly clever wrapper, macOS can’t execute the binaries.
Backyard Baseball ‘01 runs well, looks better than ever, includes new bonus features to test your mettle, and creates a new installation for digital preservation within the Backyard Sports catalog that allows the next generation of fans to fall in love with the game.

Munbyn Print is a powerful, smart thermal label printing app that transforms your label creation and printing workflow. Simply connect your label printer via Bluetooth on your mobile device. It fits perfectly for office work, home organization, study planning, DIY crafts, e-commerce shipping and more. Design freely and print high-quality labels in seconds.
Multi-language Support
English/Chinese/Spanish/French/Japanese/German/Italian/Portuguese (Brazil)
Key Features
Rich Template Library
- Thousands of free templates for tags, storage labels, shipping stickers and daily scenarios
- One-click access and full customization to create unique personalized labels effortlessly
Smart Editor
- All-in-one visual editor: add text, tables, illustrations, icons, images, dates & more
- Built-in voice recognition, QR, barcode and bulk serial generators for professional labels
- Intuitive interface; beginners can design labels easily
AI Creative Tools
- AI Text-to-Image: Enter prompts to generate custom graphics for your labels
- AI Image-to-Image: Restyle original images to quickly refine label assets
- AI Background Remover: One-click background removal to extract design subjects
Bulk Import, Printing & Batch Cropping
- Batch import files for continuous printing, saving repetitive work for shipping and asset tagging
- Crop flexibly: Current Page / All Pages / Odd Pages / Even Pages
Clarity Enhancement Algorithm
- Image optimization auto-adjusts brightness and contrast for crisp graphics
- Text sharpening enhances edge clarity to keep small text sharp and blur-free
Multi-Format File Printing
- Supports direct printing for PDF, TXT, PNG and JPG files
- Built-in cropping and one-click preprocessing for perfect print results
Powerful OCR Text Recognition
- Built‑in OCR extracts text from images, ready for editing and layout adjustments to skip manual typing
Folder Management
- Create categorized folders to organize all your label projects
- Quickly find and reuse saved designs for tidy project management
Cloud Storage
- Encrypted cloud storage saves templates & designs with seamless cross-device sync
- Access, edit and manage your works anytime across mobile devices
Professional Technical Support
- Submit feedback, report issues and share usage tips online to receive fast professional guidance
- Dedicated support team on standby to provide end-to-end assistance and resolve your questions
Auto-Renewable Subscription Terms
1. Available Subscription Plan
a) Starter Plan: Monthly auto-renewing subscription (valid for 1 calendar month)
2. Subscription Pricing
a) Starter Plan: $9.99 per month with auto-renewal; original annual price $59.99.
Membership Benefits: 60 total AI credits, unlock Text-to-Image, Image-to-Image and AI Background Remover.
3. Payment
After purchase confirmation, payment will be charged to your Apple ID account.
4. Auto-Renewal Rule
Your Apple ID will be charged automatically within 24 hours before your current subscription expires. Upon successful payment, your subscription will be extended for another month.
5. How to Cancel Auto-Renewal
Go to iPhone Settings → Tap your Apple ID → Subscriptions, locate this app to manage your subscription.
You may turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours prior to the next billing cycle. Your active membership benefits remain available until the expiry date after cancellation.
6. Terms of Service
MUNBYN Paid Services Agreement: https://appapi.munbyn.com/subscriptionPaymentTermsOfService/?language=en
User Agreement: https://appapi.munbyn.com/common/user-agreement.html
7. Privacy Policy
Privacy Policy: https://appapi.munbyn.com/common/privacy-policy.html
Download Munbyn Print now to enjoy unprecedented printing convenience and fun. Our label printing application provides excellent technical support and service to ensure every use is a pleasant experience.

bluejetty:00023390:ios.name: 2 Player Quiz Multiplayer Game
bluejetty:00023390:ios.summary:
Two players. One phone. Fastest correct answer wins.
2 Player Quiz Battle is a head-to-head trivia game built for two people on the same phone. Sit opposite each other. One of you plays the top half of the screen, the other the bottom. Ans
bluejetty:00023390:ios.description:
Two players. One phone. Fastest correct answer wins.
2 Player Quiz Battle is a head-to-head trivia game built for two people on the same phone. Sit opposite each other. One of you plays the top half of the screen, the other the bottom. Answer the same question at the same time.
HOW IT WORKS
Every question is a race. Tap the right answer first and the point is yours. Tap the wrong one and you’re locked out for that question but your opponent can still steal the point if they get it right. Rush and you hand it to them; hesitate and they beat you to it.
At the end you’ll see who won, and your head-to-head record against that player: match wins build up every time you two play.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT
- Two players, one phone, no second device, no sign-ups
- Both players see the question and answer at the same time
- Thousands of general knowledge questions across a wide mix of topics
- Lockout and steal rules that reward speed and accuracy
- Pick your game length, from a quick 5 questions to an epic 50
- Match wins tracked for every pair of players
- Perfect for friends, couples, siblings, car journeys and waiting rooms
Think you’re faster? Think you’re smarter? Grab a friend and settle it.
This app contains an auto-renewing subscription for $2.99 per week. You can try out the subscription first, with a 3 day free trial. Once subscribed, you can cancel your subscription at any point. 
Terms of Service:
https://sites.google.com/view/dh3games-terms-of-service/home
Privacy Policy:
https://sites.google.com/view/dh3games-privacypolicy/home

bluejetty:00159177:ios.name: tkts
bluejetty:00159177:ios.summary:
The Official TKTS app is the only way to get fast, accurate, real-time listings of all Broadway and Off Broadway shows available at the world famous TKTS Discount Ticket Booths in New York City.
Don’t know which show to see? That’s OK! Use
bluejetty:00159177:ios.description:
The Official TKTS app is the only way to get fast, accurate, real-time listings of all Broadway and Off Broadway shows available at the world famous TKTS Discount Ticket Booths in New York City.
Don’t know which show to see? That’s OK! Use this app to learn about every production listed at TKTS. If you’re looking for a New York City theatre adventure, use our Show Search feature to discover other Broadway, Off Broadway, off-Off Broadway, Dance and Music events happening all over New York.
Features:
- Real-time display of what is currently on sale at all three TKTS Discount booths. 
- A comprehensive show search where you'll find what is happening onstage in New York City - including show descriptions, performance schedules, theatre locations, accessibility information and links to official show websites.
- TDF Stages - TDF's online theatre magazine featuring articles, videos and podcasts.
-TKTS tips to help you plan your visit
TKTS offers same-day tickets to Broadway and Off Broadway shows at discounts of up to 50% off full price. The Official TKTS app is directly linked to the display boards at the TKTS Discount Booths, so what you're seeing, in real time, is exactly what the people waiting in line are seeing. The listings are updated in real time so you'll have a completely up-to-date list of available shows right in the palm of your hand.
The TKTS Discount Booths have become an international destination for theatre lovers from the United States and around the world since 1973. There are two locations in New York City: 
(1) Times Square – Broadway and 47th Street, Manhattan - "under the red steps";
(2) Lincoln Center – in the David Rubenstein Atrium at 61 West 62nd Street;
The Official TKTS app is offered exclusively by Theatre Development Fund (TDF), the not-for-profit service organization for the performing arts, which operates the TKTS Discount Booths.

About EVOLUTION 3:59
Considered to be “Hollywood’s Hardest Workout” and endorsed by Arnold himself—EVOLUTION 3:59 is the cutting edge gym routine to build the body you’ve always wanted. Follow the exact fitness plan that deemed Joe Manganiello one of Men's Health's 100 Fittest Men of All Time and got him shredded for his role on HBO’s True Blood. 
This app will provide you the step by step guide to track your entire year of workouts while being coached through video tutorials on proper form by one of Hollywood’s top personal trainers and CrossFit Games champion, Ron Mathews with the exercises demonstrated by Joe himself. 
Features
- Top Hollywood Elite Personal Training & Programming
- Simple and easy to follow design 
- Follow one program for your FULL YEAR of WORKOUTS
- No more getting overwhelmed by too many programs to choose from
- Exercise Video Library of over 100 expert tutorials on proper form & technique

- Supersets gray-out as you complete for easy tracking of workout
- Barbell Calculator helps to quickly add up weight
- Ad-free!

bluejetty:00072704:ios.description:
Chirpo BirdSound ID Australia is the most comprehensive bird sound identification app for Australia – easy to use and accurate for beginners and experts alike. Completely free to use for identifications, with extra features available an optional paid add-on.
Whether you're in your garden, a city park, bushland, or the outback, simply record a bird’s sound using your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch. The app analyses the song or call and shows you the best match, complete with sound descriptions, variation notes, and a photo of the bird.
Developed by the creators of ChirpOMatic, the trusted bird sound ID app used across Europe and North America.
PRO FEATURES (Optional upgrade)
> In-depth sound reference – A comprehensive guide with expert-written sound descriptions and key features to listen for.
> Save and revisit recordings – Store audio clips with time and location, helping you build your own birding log.
> Share your recordings – Easily send clips via AirDrop, WhatsApp, email, or messages.
UNIQUE FEATURES
> Beginner-friendly
No birding knowledge needed – simply tap to record.
> Ethical and responsible
Includes Bird-safe and automatic Night-time modes to prevent disturbing birds in the wild.
> Apple Watch support
Forgot your phone? Record sounds on your Watch for ID later.
> High accuracy
Continuously updated and tested by a dedicated team with over 10 years of experience in bird sound recognition.
> Privacy-focused
We collect no personal data and no recordings are uploaded without your permission.
> Contribute to science
Share your best recordings to help ornithologists worldwide via Xeno-canto.
> Fast customer support
We reply to all support messages within 24 hours.
ChirpOMatic Pro is available as an optional upgrade. Unlock the reference section, save and organise your recordings, and access advanced tools for serious birders.
If you subscribe, payment will be charged to your Apple account and will renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscription in your App Store settings.
Privacy Policy: https://www.spinysoftware.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00148435:ios.name: LaserPecker Design Space
bluejetty:00148435:ios.summary:
嗨兴科技
LaserPecker Design Space is a comprehensive software solution developed specifically for LaserPecker laser machines. It seamlessly integrates design, editing, and machine control functionalities, enabling a streamlined and efficient e
bluejetty:00148435:ios.description:
嗨兴科技
LaserPecker Design Space is a comprehensive software solution developed specifically for LaserPecker laser machines. It seamlessly integrates design, editing, and machine control functionalities, enabling a streamlined and efficient engraving and cutting workflow. Whether you're using a mobile phone, tablet, or laptop, the LaserPecker Design Space provides a consistent and user-friendly experience.
Design, Control and Engrave
1. Connect your machine via Bluetooth or WiFi and start the engraving process on the go.
2. Quickly upload photos, patterns, and images of various formats to create your custom designs.
3. Select materials and precisely control engraving settings to achieve your desired results.
4. Access a rich collection of shapes and upload your own local files.
5. Easily generate barcodes and QR codes for batch laser marking.
6. Preview your project in real-time, and fine-tune the position and size on the material.
7. Explore inspirations from the LaserPecker community Craftzone. Get the project with one-step engraving procedure.
*Note*
This app is compatible with LP2, LP3, LP4, LP5, and LX series laser machines. To ensure optimal performance, please make sure to update your machine's firmware to the latest version.
For users with the LP1 series or earlier versions of the LP2 and LP3 models, we recommend downloading the Community Version App - LaserPecker, or using our PC software instead.

bluejetty:00146874:ios.summary: PeekUp is a revolutionary new dating app for fun and honest dating! In PeekUp, success depends on your mood! Who do you want to be today? A fluffy bunny, an alien, or an "iron" lady? Maybe a superhero or "Mr. X"? AR-masks will help you crea
bluejetty:00146874:ios.description:
PeekUp is a revolutionary new dating app for fun and honest dating! In PeekUp, success depends on your mood! Who do you want to be today? A fluffy bunny, an alien, or an "iron" lady? Maybe a superhero or "Mr. X"? AR-masks will help you create an image in which you will feel as relaxed, easy, and natural as possible! Play, flirt, get new friends! And remember that behind the masks, there are only real people and no bots!
Real photos and videos
In our application, only live photos and videos are taken at the time of creating a profile. Forget about silent fakes! Stay masked until the end, or show your real face to someone you like!
Fast and fun profile creation
Hide your face with an AR mask,
Take a photo/video,
Add cool stickers describing you and your character,
And that's it – be ready to swipe to choose the ones you like!
"Get closer" Q&A game
Overthinking the next message?
Don't know what to say next?
Can't persuade somebody to take off their mask?
Be more daring – challenge – play the Q&A game and rip off the mask!
Answer deep questions, guess secret desires or unusual facts about who you are interested in!
Zero fakes
Only a real person can create a profile in our application, and no scammers can add someone else's face to their profile. And you are always sure that the person behind the mask is not a bot, and you have to convince him to take it off! Get creative and rip off the mask!
The application has a premium subscription – PeekUp Premium. The service is available by subscription, lasting 7 days, 30 days, or 90 days. The subscription price starts at $4.99.
Your subscription is debited from your iTunes account when you confirm your purchase. The subscription is automatically renewed until it is canceled by the user. The renewal fee will be charged 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage of subscription available after purchasing a subscription in the user account settings.
https://peekup.me/terms

bluejetty:00015736:ios.description:
SpeakEasy Spanish is an offline Spanish phrasebook for travel, pronunciation, and fast everyday conversations.
It combines native-speaker audio, phonetic spellings, favorites, flashcards, and a built-in translator for one-off phrases.
Designed for English-speakers heading to Spain, Mexico, Latin America, and the Caribbean, it helps you handle essentials, follow replies, and sound more natural without relying on a data connection.
Browse by category or search in seconds for restaurants, transportation, hotels, shopping, emergencies, and more.
Practice before you go with flashcards, save your most-used phrases as favorites, and keep the right Spanish close at hand.
FEATURES 
• Over 1,000 essential travel phrases with Spanish and phonetic translations, plus audio. Some content requires in-app purchase.
• Separate translations for both European Spanish and Latin American Spanish. 
• Audio clips recorded by a European Spanish speaker AND a Latin American Spanish speaker to help you perfect your pronunciation. 
• Flashcards with English on one side and Spanish on the other side, that you can use to study and test yourself.
• Built-in translator to translate those one-off phrases you need. Unlimited use requires in-app purchase.
• Slow-play feature that plays audio at a slow speed to assist learning.
• Search facility to instantly find the phrase you’re looking for.
• Favorites feature to provide fast access to your favorite phrases.
• Supports dark mode and light mode.
• Dynamic type (large font) support.
• Support for US English, UK English and Canadian English spelling.
• No internet connection required. The app will work no matter where you are.
INCLUDES PHRASES SUCH AS: 
• Where is the restroom (toilet)? 
• Do you speak English? 
• I speak a little Spanish 
• I don’t speak Spanish 
• I speak English 
• Could you speak more slowly? 
• Is there someone who speaks English? 
• Are you married? 
• Let’s go to a restaurant 
• Do you understand me? 
• Call a doctor! 
• I’ve run out of medication 
• I need the consulate 
• How do I get to the … ? 
• How much does a ticket cost? 
• When is the next museum tour? 
• Please call a taxi 
• How much does this cost? 
• My luggage has been lost 
• Where can I rent a car? 
• My car has broken down 
• Can I see the menu? 
• Do you have a menu in English? 
• What do you recommend? 
• That was delicious! 
• Do you accept credit cards? 
• A glass of red wine 
• Where can I buy … ? 
• Can I try this on? 
• I need a hotel … 
• I have a reservation 
• I have lost the room key 
• What is the exchange rate? 
• What time is it? 
• Can I get a cash advance? 
• You are very pretty 
• You are very handsome 
• What is your telephone number? 
• I will miss you 
• Thanks for the evening

bluejetty:00128274:ios.name: Perfect Pitch Toddler Learning
bluejetty:00128274:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00128274:ios.description:
Give your child the gift of perfect pitch.
Perfect pitch is impossible to learn as an adult but studies have shown that you can teach it to a child while he or she is still in their language learning stage of development. If you've got a child under 5 then don't miss out on your chance to give them the superpower of perfect pitch.
Never heard of Perfect Pitch?
Sometimes known as absolute pitch, perfect pitch is the ability to hear a note and recognise exactly what note it is. Some people will do interval training as an adult, which is learning to count the tones between notes but a person with perfect pitch could hear a melody, walk over to a piano and repeat the exact thing on their first try. 
How does it work? 
Perfect Pitch Toddler is a collection of games, created to appeal to small children. Each game, as well as being fun to play, teaches children to listen to notes on a piano and identify them. It does this by showing animals that represent the notes on a keyboard; the Ant is the note of A, the Bee is the note of B, and so on. This makes it easy for children to form a strong relationship between the sound and a familiar image, rather than presenting them with the complexities of a traditional keyboard. 
The Games
There are currently 8 Games to choose from:
Who's in the Crate?
Guess what animal's in the crate by listening to the notes as the crate disassembles.
Listen and Learn
This one's just for little tiny babies. There's no interaction in this game. Just hear the note and see the corresponding animal.
Play Along
Play a nursery rhyme as the notes move along across a stave. Including: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, Row Row Row Your Boat, and Incy Wincy Spider.
Up or Down
Listen to a group of three notes and answer whether the progression is going up or down.
Whack a Note
Hear the note to indicate what animal is about to appear out of a hole. Try to tap it in time.
Which Floor?
Listen to what octave the note is played at to tell what floor in the house the animal is on.
Match Two
Turn the cards and find the matching notes.
Silhouettes
Answer what animal is the silhouette.
Perfect Pitch Toddler is completely ad-free and in-app purchase free.

Main Fea
bluejetty:00013686:ios.description:
All praise is due to Allah.
This app presents the full recitation of Sheikh Khalil Al-Khusairi, one of Egypt’s renowned Qur’an reciters, together with a collection of practical Islamic tools designed to support your daily worship.
Main Features
 • Qur’an Audio
 • Listen offline in a lightweight, space-saving audio version.
 • Enjoy high-quality streaming whenever you are connected to the internet.
 • Save individual Surahs for offline listening in high quality – download only what you need and remove them later to free space.
 • Prayer Times
 • Accurate local prayer times.
 • Adhan alerts and smart notifications for every prayer.
 • Daily Adhkar
 • Morning, evening, and daily adhkar collections.
 • Automatic reminders so you never miss your adhkar.
 • Compact App Size
 • Lightweight install (around 200 MB) so it downloads quickly and saves phone storage.
 • Ad-Free Option
 • Upgrade for a smooth, uninterrupted listening experience.
Why This Update Matters
Earlier versions required more space to keep all recitations offline in full quality, which made it difficult for many users to install or update.
Now the app is smaller and faster while still giving you every listening choice you need:
 • Offline playback in light audio by default.
 • High-quality streaming online.
 • The ability to save any Surah you wish in high quality for offline use.
You also get prayer-time notifications, adhkar reminders, and a refreshed, modern design.
Privacy Policy: https://www.ahmadnakore.com/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00038054:ios.name: MindSpace - Mind Map
bluejetty:00038054:ios.summary:
Quickly create clean and simple mind maps.
Edit them on Mac, iPad, and iPhone. Export anytime to PDF, Images, Markdown, and other formats to share in your work and studies.
Quickly Create Personalized Mind Maps
• Efficiency: We split "Them
bluejetty:00038054:ios.description:
Quickly create clean and simple mind maps.
Edit them on Mac, iPad, and iPhone. Export anytime to PDF, Images, Markdown, and other formats to share in your work and studies.
Quickly Create Personalized Mind Maps
• Efficiency: We split "Themes" into "Layouts" and "Color Schemes", carefully designing over 50 layouts and 60 color schemes. They support one-tap switching and can be freely combined into multiple styles.
• Personalization: You can create your own layouts and color schemes, presetting almost all formatting options such as growth direction, width, spacing, structure, shapes, and the color of each individual branch.
• Freedom: You can set different layouts for two separate mind maps, or even different layouts for different branches to form a hybrid structure mind map to present your content. You can also set it to "Manual Layout" to flexibly place every single node.
Enrich Your Mind Maps in Multiple Ways
• Notes: Add a place for supplementary information with support for quick viewing.
• Links: Add a web link or local link. Local links can specify and jump to concrete nodes within the file.
• Tasks: Add task buttons that can display progress checkboxes.
• Relationships: Add relationship lines between two nodes or internal positions within a node.
• Summaries: Add curly braces or polygon shapes for multiple nodes.
• Images: Insert local images and set their alignment with text.
• Drawings: Drawings made with Apple Pencil can also be inserted inside nodes.
• Equations: Support adding LaTeX equations and modifying them at any time.
• Stickers: Built-in with more than 1,000 beautiful stickers.
AI Assistant Doubles Your Efficiency (Optional)
• Expand: Enter an idea to quickly branch out content from different angles.
• Convert: Transform a long article into a clearly structured mind map.
• Image to Mind Map: Convert images containing text into a mind map with the matching structure.
• Rewrite: Re-output much better text for a specified node.
Mainstream Import & Export Formats
• Import: Supports Markdown, OPML, TXT, FreeMind, iThoughts, etc.
• Export: Supports PDF, JPG, PNG, TXT, Markdown, OPML, etc.
More Convenient Features
• Outline: One-tap toggle to outline mode, or start editing and arranging structures directly from the outline view.
• Shortcuts: Provides a rich keyboard shortcut system that is fully customizable.
• Focus Mode: Light up only your selected node and its related nodes for seamless presentation work.
• Other Features: Canvas guides, widgets, auto-follow, and more.
Data Security
We build the App using the most safe and reliable architecture—a document-based editor. Your data belongs solely to you. The AI assistant only processes data you provide to it, and you can turn off AI globally.
Subscription Information
• You can subscribe to the "Pro" version monthly or annually.
• Payments will be charged to your iTunes Account. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
• Manage or cancel subscriptions anytime in your App Store Account Settings after purchase.
Email: todo-color@outlook.com
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://rednowapp.github.io/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00036938:ios.summary:
Where speed meets destruction. Drive fast, shoot faster. Race, fight, win!

bluejetty:00036938:ios.description:
Where speed meets destruction. Drive fast, shoot faster. Race, fight, win!
This is more than just a racing or fighting game. Battle Cars, Awarded an honourable mention in the Pocket Gamer Awards 2025 for Best Game Innovation. Battle car is a car shooter where your skills behind the wheel and in combat are put to the ultimate test in a cyberpunk post-apocalyptic MOBA action game with a unique 3D graphic style. 
Roar the engine and get ready for a high-octane brawl in Battle Cars! Dive into intense gameplay against Fury machines crafted by players from around the globe and compete in thrilling PVP car combat. The better you assemble it, the more fights you will win. 
Battle Cars awaits! Upgrade, and rule the rage in the battlefield. Be the best driver, control the streets with your mad fury. Crush the war game, cross out enemies, make the wheels burn, don't stop accelerating until fire is burning in your exhaust pipe, wreck their cars into twisted metal, and claim the title of King of the Road.
FEATURES
DIVERSE CAR LINEUP
With 15+ unique customizable cars, and over 12 guns & 12 collision / melee weapons, you're ready to combine them to conquer any scenario. Enhance your favorites and customize them with a lot of patterns, camouflage, and decals to become a legend in the PvP arena! Fill your garage with brawl vehicles like buggy, armored vehicles, cyber trucks, sports racing cars and monster trucks. Don't cross out or discard any of them, you’ll need all of them to dominate! The gameplay is as hot as the wheels.
SPECIAL CAR ABILITIES
Equip your car with FPS weapons, machine guns, missiles, sniper rifles, rocket launchers, and flamethrowers for extreme fun and intense vehicle combat. Car abilities are key to gaining the upper hand and eliminating your enemies, blitz them all to become the best Vigilante.
VARIED 4v4 PvP MODES
Each mode demands different strategies and skills, catering to experienced players. Free-For-All offers unpredictability, while 4v4 battles focus on team dynamics. Capture the Flag requires strategy, and Domination demands coordination. Modes unlock gradually, providing new challenges in diverse Battle Royale arenas. Quick matchmaking and under-five-minute battles ensure fast-paced action for every preference.
UNIQUE MAPS
Battle across varied environments, from neon-lit cities to desert roads and futuristic arenas. Each map demands specific tactics, pushing you to adapt and conquer. Navigate a dystopian cyber metropolis, avoid traps, and use the terrain to your advantage. Take jump runs for spectacular twists and aerial maneuvers. Are you ready to survive in a battlefield full of explosions, crossfire, and cars crashing?
ALLIANCES AND ALLIANCE WARS
Team with your friends, join forces in squad, and engage in thrilling Alliance Wars. Form gangs and become a road warrior in this epic car warfare. Participate in gang wars, distribute the roles Speedsters, Attackers, Suppliers, Tanks, Defenders and crush your rivals with your warlord tactics. Build strategies in intense team battles and rise to lead league leaderboards. 
INTUITIVE CONTROLS
Enjoy smooth drive & FPS-inspired controls tailored for Max competitive PvP epic combats and customize your setup to suit your play style. Execute perfect maneuvers and dominate the war zone with ease.
PLAY ANYWHERE
Battle Cars is optimized for most 5G/LTE networks, allowing for seamless play on the go. With quick matches, it's perfect for players looking for fast-paced automobile combat.
Join the paradise of chaos and gasoline. Time will tell if your name will be written on the page of the greatest heroes or villains.
For any questions or support, you can reach us at battlecars@tinybytes.com
PLEASE NOTE:
 In-game purchases are available. Some paid items may not be refundable based on their type.
Privacy Policy:
https://tinybytes.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00069423:ios.description:
Experience the Classic Sudoku Puzzle – Now Better Than Ever!
Sudoku, originally known as Number Place, is a timeless logic-based number-placement puzzle. Your goal is simple yet challenging: fill a 9x9 grid so that each column, row, and 3x3 block contains the numbers 1 through 9 without repetition.
This version of Sudoku offers six difficulty levels – Beginner, Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert, and Master – so players of all skill levels can enjoy and improve their puzzle-solving abilities.
Why You’ll Love This Sudoku Game:
 • Clean & Focused Gameplay: No intrusive pop-up ads to disrupt your concentration.
 • Smart Hints: Get helpful tips when you need them most.
 • Optional Ads: Only when you choose – to continue after 3 mistakes or to receive a smart hint.
 • Track Your Progress: Improve your skills as you work your way up through the difficulty levels.
 • Five Mini Games Built In: Number Match, Merge, Sort, Cross Math, and the new Number Connect – all offline, all in the same app.
We designed this game to be relaxing yet challenging, providing the perfect balance for beginners and seasoned Sudoku enthusiasts alike.
Your Feedback Matters!
If you have suggestions or feedback, we’d love to hear from you. Every message and review is personally read, so please don’t hesitate to reach out. And if you enjoy the game, we’d truly appreciate your review on the App Store!
Download now and enjoy endless Sudoku puzzles at your fingertips.

bluejetty:00088225:ios.description:
Screen TV Mirror: Air Cast App enables users to seamlessly mirror their phone's screen on any compatible smart TV wirelessly and without any delays. This versatile application caters to various needs, from delivering presentations to enjoying movies and immersive gaming experiences on your television.
It's important to highlight that Screen TV Mirror: Air Cast App functions independently and is not affiliated with any specific TV brands. The application boasts a wide array of features, allowing users to mirror their phone's screen, cast photos and videos directly from their photo library to the TV, and even replicate the phone's camera feed on the TV screen.
How to utilize it:
To initiate screen mirroring between your phone and TV, follow these essential steps: connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi network. Once connected, launch the app and establish a connection with your TV. Then, tap the "Screen Mirroring" button and follow the provided instructions to commence seamless mirroring.
Screen TV Mirror: Air Cast App offers a premium version that provides access to the complete set of features. Users can opt for a weekly or yearly subscription, with a complimentary 3-day trial available. Unlock premium features, such as full-screen mirroring, unrestricted photo casting, and video casting to your TV.
Enjoy a 3-day trial with each subscription option: Weekly Subscription, Monthly Subscription, Yearly Subscription.
Payments are processed through your iTunes account upon purchase confirmation, and subscriptions automatically renew unless you disable auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the current subscription period ends. Conveniently manage your subscriptions, and any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited upon subscribing to the publication, as applicable.

With intuitive controls and a quick introduction, you're able to jump right into your first battle! In this strategy card game, you can always quickly change between perfecting your deck building skills and waging epic card wars.

bluejetty:00044095:ios.description:
Do you enjoy flowers? Have you ever tried flower arrangement games? Happy Bloom Blast is a classic flower elimination game that is stress-relieving and relaxing. Join us and start playing fun flower arrangement games!

Organize messy flowers into pots to create bouquets. Select a flower, drag it to another pot, and combine three identical flowers to eliminate them. Each pot holds a maximum of three flowers. Are you ready for the challenge? Download Happy Bloom Blast now, enjoy the enchanting experience of blooming flowers, and begin your flower-arranging journey!

Введите даты поездки, направление и получайте доступ к самым выгодным вариантам проживания, перелетов и перевозок за считанные секунды. Будь то отдых или деловая поездка, сервис Яндекс Путешествия сэкономит ваше время, деньги и нервы.
Основные бонусы приложения:
• Выгодные цены на отели и гостиницы мира
Цены напрямую от отеля и без наценок.
• Бронирование отелей и апартаментов
Больше миллиона номеров в отелях, санаториях и апартаментах России и мира. 
• Широкий выбор апартаментов и квартиры посуточно, в том числе варианты, проверенные Яндекс Путешествиями. 
• Безопасная бронь жилья
Сотни тысяч отзывов, фото и видео от реальных постояльцев.
• Помощь как в момент бронирования, так и после
Поддержка 24/7 по телефону и в чате. Даже в выходные. И в Новый год.
• ЖД билеты и билеты на самолет
Планируйте всё путешествие в одном приложении.
ОТЕЛИ, ГОСТИНИЦЫ и АПАРТАМЕНТЫ
Хотите снять жилье на море или забронировать апартаменты в горах? Гостевые дома, апартаменты, отели Турции и другого зарубежья — снять номер в отеле или квартиру посуточно можно всего за несколько минут!
Бронирование с Яндекс Путешествия — это легко и просто, а главное безопасно. Проверяйте отзывы, общий рейтинг и описание гостиницы, отеля или квартиры, чтобы убедиться, что это именно то, что вам нужно.
ПОИСК И ПОКУПКА АВИАБИЛЕТОВ
Поиск дешевых авиабилетов работает в реальном времени и показывает только актуальные цены на авиабилеты как в России, так и за ее пределами.
Если вы еще сомневаетесь, где вас ждут самые дешевые авиабилеты, просто зайдите в приложение, введите даты, пункт назначение и убедитесь сами. Яндекс Путешествия работает с авиакомпаниями напрямую, позволяя вам совершить самый выгодный заказ авиабилетов без наценок и комиссий.
ЖД БИЛЕТЫ НА ПОЕЗДА
• В приложении можно не только бронировать жилье, но и покупать ЖД билеты по России и ближайшему зарубежью. Используйте схемы выгонов и фильтры, чтобы выбрать лучшее место. Вы также можете выбрать отложенную оплату: оплатить билеты на поезд позднее. 
МОЯ ПОЕЗДКА
Проверять детали путешествия стало гораздо удобнее. Вся важная информация отображается за 30 дней до поездки на главном экране и доступна в режиме офлайн. Внутри — информация о билетах, бронировании отеля или квартиры и их местоположение. 
Если вы путешествуете самолетом, в приложении отобразятся аэропорт, время рейса и вылета, а при поездке поездом — его номер и вагон. 
Вы также можете увидеть карту интересных мест неподалеку, запланировать экскурсию или купить билеты на мероприятие, чтобы разнообразить досуг. 
Поиск отелей и апартаментов в России может стать непростой задачей, но только не у нас. Москва, Санкт-Петербург, Казань, Сочи и другие популярные города уже ждут вас. Приобретайте дешевые билеты на авиа и ЖД билеты по выгодным ценам и вперед!
Забронировать отель или апартаменты, купить дешевые авиабилеты и ЖД билеты, запланировать отдых в России, а также в Египте и других странах. Все и даже больше, вы найдете в Яндекс Путешествия. У нас выгодные авиабилеты и билеты на поезд, цена на отели и апартаменты, удобные маршруты и приятные цены. 
Думаете, куда поехать на море на недельку или где провести выходные? 
Мы подскажем, где вам отдохнуть.
