bluejetty:00187801:ios.name: Evrotrust
bluejetty:00187801:ios.summary: Evrotrust is a unique mobile app to make your work with e-documents as technically and legally secured, as it is in the paper world. It allows you to remotely identify yourself before banks, telecoms, the state, or just to password-less log
bluejetty:00187801:ios.description:
Evrotrust is a unique mobile app to make your work with e-documents as technically and legally secured, as it is in the paper world. It allows you to remotely identify yourself before banks, telecoms, the state, or just to password-less login to websites. Use it to remotely sign any kind of e-documents with qualified e-signature, having same legal effect as handwritten. Once signed, documents could be sent for qualified secure delivery to others as it was done by the well-known courier services.
MAIN FUNCTIONALITIES
• Remotely identify yourself through a new generation remote video identification, to avoid face-to-face appearance. The system secures automatic face recognition based on national ID documents (where such integration is in place) or by an operator.
• Remotely e-sign. Get free qualified certificates for e-signatures and e-seals, valid for 2 years. Use these to remotely create legally binding qualified e-signatures and e-seals.
• Securely send and receive e-documents from your mobile or from Internet. The qualified secure delivery service proves the sender, the recipient, the time and the integrity of the documents sent.
SELF-SIGNING
• Self-sign your own documents and send to others in seconds;
• Access to Evrotrust web-platform for uploading and sending documents to others for signing;
• Secure encrypted storage of all signed and received documents;
• Profile access from multiple smart devices.
INTEGRATED PARTNERS
• Remotely enroll as a client and e-sign at no cost with our integrated partners - banks, telecoms, etc.;
• Enjoy remote signing of documents for e-government services;
• Password-less login to many websites and control intrusive events.
SECURITY
• Sign with Touch ID or by your face;
• Create legally binding e-documents, remotely signed,delivered and time-stamped with evidential value.
SUBSCRIPTION PLANS
For personal use make choice of among three subscription plans:
• Free
 o Try the Evrotrust remote services free of charge;
 o 3 free remote signatures/identifications and receive documents from others;
 o Remotely request and get free qualified certificates, valid for 2 years and create legally binding qualified e-signatures.
• Plan 5 – Available at the application as an in-app purchase. It includes:
 o All features from the Free plan;
 o 5 remote signatures/identifications per month.
• Plan 100 – Available at the application as an in-app purchase. It includes:
 o All features from the Business plan;
 o 100 remote signatures/identifications per month.
All subscriptions are charged to user’s iTunes account and are automatically renewed until cancelled by user.
Downgrade to lower plan is allowed at any time. It takes effect as of the moment of expiry of the current plan. Same applies to cancellation of subscription.
For enterprise packages, please contact us.
COUNTRIES COVERED
• Check list: http://www.evrotrust.com/doc/eIDAS/Countries_en.html
LEGAL STATUS AND COMPLIANCE
• Legal status. Evrotrust Technologies JSC is a European Qualified Trust Service Provider according to Regulation (EC) 910/2014, listed at the TSL of the European Commission.
• Compliance. Evrotrust is subject to annual conformity assessment audits. It is compliant with:
 o Regulation (EC) 910/2014, particularly with ETSI EN 319411-1, ETSI EN 319411-12, ETSI EN 319421.
 o ISO 9001:2015, ISO 27001:2013, ISO 20000-1:2018, ISO 22301:2012 related to electronic identification and services under Regulation (ЕС) 910/2014.
• Insurance. Evrotrust keeps insurance for professional negligence, meeting the coverage and all statutory requirements.
Privacy policy: https://www.evrotrust.com/doc/eIDAS/Privacy_Policy_v3.1_Mobile_Evrotrust.pdf
Terms of Use: https://www.evrotrust.com/doc/eIDAS/Evrotrust_ContractMobileServices_v2.0_en.pdf

bluejetty:00017435:ios.description:
WikiTest is a modern book test that uses a borrowed smartphone.
“Marc's apps are unbelievable.”
—David Blaine
“The greatest app for magicians. It's incredible.”
—Asi Wind
- You ask a spectator to search for ANY object, person or place on Wikipedia on THEIR phone to bring up its article.
- Whilst you look away, the spectator scrolls through the article and thinks of a random word on the page.
- You then tell the spectator EXACTLY what object they're looking at, as well as what word they're merely thinking of on the page!
The text (and of course their phone) can be thoroughly inspected after the routine with NOTHING to find!
* Works with ANY borrowed modern smartphone, tablet or computer.
* You NEVER touch their phone!
* VERY easy to perform.
* NO accomplice required.
* NO memory work needed.
* Works in English, French, German, Spanish, Dutch, Italian, Swedish, Portuguese, Norwegian, Danish, Japanese, Indonesian, Hebrew, Russian, and Ukrainian, with more languages added regularly.
No other devices are needed to perform the effect (you only need your iPhone!)
However, if you have one, WikiTest comes with a fully functional Apple Watch app. It also supports popular devices such as the PeekSmith and Oblivious Notifier.
*** WikiTest was voted "Magic Trick Of The Year", and was performed on the TV special "Beyond Magic".
WikiTest also integrates with many other apps, such as Earworm and Diverter!
WikiTest also has an optional Pro Tools package, giving:
- Live Peek - see what is being typed in real-time
- Image Peek - peek the article's image
- Auto Translate - automatically translate all searches in any language to your native language
- AutoPair - pair with your spectator automatically
- Real Main Page - use the real main page in performance
- QuickLink - pair immediately with a fast pairing method
- Article Extract - see a short article extract from the searched article on both the Peek Screen and the Apple Watch app
- NFC Support
- Further app integrations
...and much, much more!
---- 
If choosing to subscribe, note:
- Your Pro Tools payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel your subscription any time.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period by going to your iOS Account Settings after purchase.
- The subscription price is currently $5.49 USD/month.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
- Terms of Use can be found here: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
This app is for entertainment purposes only.

Looking for a chill way to pass time or sharpen your brain between tasks? Dive into this oddly satisfying pin-pulling puzzle where gravity is your best ally—and sometimes your trickiest foe.
 How to Play
Strategic Pulling: Remove the pins one by one to set colorful coins in motion.
One Goal: Get all the coins safely into the transparent drum at the bottom.
Think Before You Yank: Pull the wrong pin too early, and you might trap coins, block paths, or send them spiraling the wrong way.
Every level is a mini physics challenge, full of bounce, roll, and aha moments.
 Why You’ll Be Hooked
Simple Start, Smart Finish: Easy to pick up—hard to put down. Each level builds on the last with new twists and tricky layouts.
Brain Boosting Fun: Boosts logic, planning, and problem-solving without the pressure.
No Stress, Just Vibes: No timers, no pressure—just pure puzzle zen at your pace.
Play Anytime, Anywhere: Works offline. Perfect for travel, queues, or cozy evenings on the couch.
For Everyone: Whether you're a kid discovering cause-and-effect or an adult craving clever distraction, this one’s for you.
 Pro Tips
Start From the Top: Pins blocking more coins? Remove them first to open the path.
Watch the Flow: Let gravity do the work—observe how coins fall before acting.
Trial & Triumph: Some puzzles take a few tries. Every fail teaches the next move.
Ready to master the art of the perfect pull? The pins await. Let the coins roll!

Looking for a chill way to pass time or sharpen your brain between tasks? Dive into this oddly satisfying pin-pulling puzzle where gravity is your best ally—and sometimes your trickiest foe.
 How to Play
Strategic Pulling: Remove the pins one by one to set colorful coins in motion.
One Goal: Get all the coins safely into the transparent drum at the bottom.
Think Before You Yank: Pull the wrong pin too early, and you might trap coins, block paths, or send them spiraling the wrong way.
Every level is a mini physics challenge, full of bounce, roll, and aha moments.
 Why You’ll Be Hooked
Simple Start, Smart Finish: Easy to pick up—hard to put down. Each level builds on the last with new twists and tricky layouts.
Brain Boosting Fun: Boosts logic, planning, and problem-solving without the pressure.
No Stress, Just Vibes: No timers, no pressure—just pure puzzle zen at your pace.
Play Anytime, Anywhere: Works offline. Perfect for travel, queues, or cozy evenings on the couch.
For Everyone: Whether you're a kid discovering cause-and-effect or an adult craving clever distraction, this one’s for you.
 Pro Tips
Start From the Top: Pins blocking more coins? Remove them first to open the path.
Watch the Flow: Let gravity do the work—observe how coins fall before acting.
Trial & Triumph: Some puzzles take a few tries. Every fail teaches the next move.
Ready to master the art of the perfect pull? The pins await. Let the coins roll!

bluejetty:00133603:ios.description:
With SoundHound Chat AI, simply ask for what you want, add follow-up questions, and get fast, accurate, up-to-date responses. Built on our leading independent voice AI platform, this app brings together the best-in-class conversational and generative AI technology for faster, more helpful experiences.
SoundHound Chat AI is the next-generation personal assistant that brings conversational intelligence to life in ways that we’ve only dreamed about. It integrates with dozens of SoundHound’s knowledge domains, pulling real-time data like weather, sports, stocks, flight status, restaurants, to name a few, combined with the most cutting-edge large language models.
Gone are the days of disappointing and irrelevant web results or “sorry, I didn’t get that” responses. With SoundHound Chat AI, you’ll get the speed and accuracy of search using just your natural voice, and receive knowledgeable, in-depth responses that make for the richest conversational experiences yet.
How it works.
No need for awkward search queries. Just speak to SoundHound Chat AI naturally, like another person. For example, “Hey SoundHound, plan an evening out with my wife and I in Manhattan with dinner and live jazz?”... “What is the address and hours of operation for Blue Note in New York City" or “Hey SoundHound … How far am I from home? … Send a text to my wife … I’ll be home in 30 minutes,” even, “Hey SoundHound … I need some ideas for a 15th wedding anniversary gift for my wife.” You’ll be amazed by the detailed responses and helpfulness.
Want to try something even more complex? SoundHound Chat AI can use follow-up questions and commands to filter, sort, or add more information to the original request, and provide responses based on currently available data from a host of various domains. 
“Hey SoundHound … Show me hotels in San Francisco for tomorrow staying for 2 nights that cost between 200 and 300 dollars per night and are pet friendly and have a gym and a pool?”... “Now sort by lowest price but nothing less than 250 and don’t show anything that doesn’t have WiFi.” Or, “Hey SoundHound … show me coffee shops with Wi-Fi” … “Which ones are within walking distance and are open after 9:00pm on Sundays?”
Here are some other examples:
Extend knowledge:
“Hey SoundHound … Explain, like I am 5 years old, how to change a car tire”
“How far can I drive on a spare tire?”
“What’s the best tire brand for me to buy?”
Enhance productivity:
“Hey SoundHound … Can you ask me questions to prepare me for my quiz on the American Revolution”
“Hey SoundHound … What are common questions a junior accountant would be asked in an interview?”
“Hey SoundHound … How do I get ink stains out of a granite counter”
Assist with everyday tasks”
“Hey SoundHound … I have ground turkey, green beans, garlic, onions and bell peppers. What can I make for dinner that will take me less than 20 minutes?
“Hey SoundHound … What was the score of yesterday’s Knicks game?”
“Hey SoundHound … How do I get out a spaghetti sauce stain?”
Plan a day of fun activities:
“Hey SoundHound … Will it rain in Napa on Wednesday?” … “What is one Napa winery I need to visit if I like Riesling?” … “What are some breakfast spots around there that have outdoor seating?” … “How long does it take to drive to the third one from Oakland?”
SoundHound Chat AI takes speed and accuracy to a new level thanks to the leading independent voice AI platform built with generative AI, allowing for complex and engaging conversations and content. Download the fastest and most accurate independent voice assistant on the market now!
Terms of Use: https://www.soundhound.com/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00124301:ios.summary: Are you looking for free brain games for kids and adults? Tic Tac Toe Game (Noughts and Crosses) is an iPhone and iPad version of one of the oldest and most popular strategy games, if you are a lover of logic games this is the right iPhone
bluejetty:00124301:ios.description:
Are you looking for free brain games for kids and adults? Tic Tac Toe Game (Noughts and Crosses) is an iPhone and iPad version of one of the oldest and most popular strategy games, if you are a lover of logic games this is the right iPhone game app for you!
Challenge yourself and friends with this top iPhone strategy game app today. With different skill levels and multiplayer option this logic game for kids and adult that can be played as easy entertaining pastime games or addictive brain training games. Download the best strategy game online now; have fun in the same time as you exercise your mind and logical reasoning with this free iPad game!
Tic Tac Toe Game Rules:
Player take turns in placing Xs and Os (or other theme symbols) on the playing board until the game is over.
The game is over when either one of the players has three in a row, in any direction of the playing board, or when the 3×3 playing board is full. 
The player who first gets 3 in a row wins the game. If the playing board is full (all nine squares) and there is still no winner, it will result in a draw game.
With this app you can play tic tac toe against your iPhone or tic tac toe multiplayer against family and friends. Basically the simple game rules are the same regardless if you play tic tac toe 2 player or 1 player.
iPhone Tic Tac Toe Game Features:
• 1 Player against iPhone or 2 Player (tic tac toe multiplayer) with same device
• Skill levels: Easy, Medium, Hard or Expert
• Resettable statistics and score tracking
• Multiple tic tac toe themes for iPhone to choose from
• Auto save when you get an interruption on the phone or exit the application
Play mind games and get some brain training:
People have always been interested to challenge the mind with mind games and exercise the brain with brain training games. Our brain is a muscle and just like every other muscle it needs exercise to develop and keep fit; download this top iPhone game if you want to get some brain training and play fun brain games for kids and adults!
This iOS game is an iPhone and iPad version of one of the oldest and most famous classic strategy games. Tic tac toe originates from a game called Terni Lapilli that was played in the time of the Roman Empire, now days it is played all over the world and also known as Noughts and Crosses or Xs and Os. The different names of the game originate from a more recent time; the first written text that refers to the name "Noughts and Crosses" appeared in the year 1864 and the name "Tick Tack Toe" twenty years later. This is a simple game that usually is played with a pencil on paper, but there are also many options to play tic tac toe online today.
If tic tac toe games are played perfectly by both players they will always result in a draw, your main tic tac toe strategy should be not to make any mistakes!
Do you enjoy to play classic strategy games and to solve logic puzzles? Then the iPad tic tac toe app is the perfect mind game app for you!
Download Tic Tac Toe Game (Noughts and Crosses) iPhone app now, challenge yourself and friends with this mind training game or just play pastime games!

Welcome to the Rock Retirement Club (RRC), your one-stop destination to make the most of your retirement journey! With a comprehensive step-by-step process, practical planning tools, expert coaching, and a vibrant community, we ensure that you not only rock your retirement but also have fun along the way. Join us and experience the RRC difference, facilitated by The Retirement Answer Man, Roger Whitney, and supported by our RRC faculty.
*Quick head’s up! We are only open for enrollment during select times. Please reach out to our team directly to learn more about the next open enrollment.
FEATURES:
1. Comprehensive Step-by-Step Agile Process:
- Follow along with our Retirement Master Class to create a well-structured, easy-to-adjust plan that can help you confidently navigate your retirement journey.
- Benefit from expert guidance on managing retirement's financial and non-financial aspects.
2. Practical Planning Tools:
- Access an array of innovative tools and resources to streamline your retirement planning, budgeting, and goal-setting.
- Stay organized and on track with personalized checklists, templates, and interactive tools.

- Receive group coaching and education from retirement expert Roger Whitney and our knowledgeable RRC faculty.
- Leverage their expertise to help you make informed decisions and optimize your retirement experience.

- Connect with like-minded individuals on the same retirement journey, sharing experiences, insights, and encouragement.
- Participate in lively online discussions, Q&A sessions, and local events to make new friends and enrich your retirement life.
5. Exclusive Meetups & Workshops:
- Attend insightful meetups and workshops on a range of retirement-related topics, from financial planning to personal development.
- Gain valuable knowledge and skills to make your retirement even more rewarding and satisfying.
Join the Rock Retirement Club today and embark on an unforgettable retirement journey filled with fun, friendship, and fulfillment. With RRC by your side, you'll be well-equipped to make the most of your retirement!

bluejetty:00025310:ios.description:
Earth in 2201, the most brilliant inventors of the Skynet organization created a machine that could travel through space and time.
Our main character, Yasuo, is on a mission to join this journey. However, a big explosion happened, and Yasuo, lost in time, arrived in a strange place where dangerous monsters were always waiting. Survival was the ultimate goal.
In the journey to find his way back home, in addition to surviving before the hordes of aggressive monsters, a horrifying truth is gradually being revealed... this is the future Earth, and he is forced to find a way to save the Earth from this horde of monsters.
In Hero Survival IO, Yasuo, an invincible warrior with limitless strength and talent, will have to take up his weapon and fight victoriously in these dangerous wars! Use skills and strategies to destroy dangerous monsters. Overcome the dangers set in each new chapter to become the last survivor. Always upgrade your weapons and skills if you want to survive.
Game features:
- Killing monsters: Defeat hordes of powerful enemy monsters with weapons and precise movements.
- Powerful skills: Diverse abilities with beautiful images; combining equipment intelligently to upgrade skills; successfully completing levels.
- Simple Play: Clear all chapters, upgrade characters, open weapon chests, and unlock maps with one-hand control!
- New experience: Different stages; different difficulties. All-new experiences await.
Are you ready to enter the challenging and dangerous battle of survival, defeat monsters, and become the last survivor?
All feedback is welcome! We will do our best to make you have a better gaming experience!
Contact us: zetylioslegend@gmail.com

bluejetty:00160419:ios.name: Calisthenics Family
bluejetty:00160419:ios.summary: Ready to start your Calisthenics Journey? Build muscle, lose weight and master impressive bodyweight skills with the #1 calisthenics workout app. Proven plans for every level, a gamified level system that makes training addictive, and Calis
bluejetty:00160419:ios.description:
Ready to start your Calisthenics Journey? Build muscle, lose weight and master impressive bodyweight skills with the #1 calisthenics workout app. Proven plans for every level, a gamified level system that makes training addictive, and Calisthenics Intelligence that thinks along with every workout.
Created by calisthenics experts Michael & Yannick and loved by thousands of athletes worldwide.
NEW: CALISTHENICS INTELLIGENCE
The world's most advanced and accurate calisthenics intelligence system: built by certified calisthenics coaches, based on 10 years of real-world coaching experience. Your workouts now adapt to you:
• Smart suggestions for reps, weight and resistance bands, based on your previous results
• A clear Today target and a Milestone finish line for every exercise
• Hit your milestone? The app levels you up automatically: more weight, a lighter band or a harder variation
• Max effort exercises track your personal records and challenge you to beat them
LEVEL UP LIKE A GAME
• Earn skill points by reaching goals like your first 5 pull-ups
• Watch your personal skillboard grow: every skill counts toward your total calisthenics level
• From your first push-up to the human flag: what's your rank?
YOUR PERFECT PLAN IN 30 SECONDS
• Answer a few questions and get the plan that matches your goal
• 50+ workout plans for every level: at home, outside or in the gym
• Every plan built on clear targets and real progression
550+ EXERCISES, ZERO GUESSWORK
• The biggest calisthenics exercise library out there
• Demo videos and coaching cues for every movement
• Too easy or too hard? Swap any exercise for an easier or harder variation
• Start every session right with a quick 10-minute warmup
TRACK EVERYTHING
• Log reps, weight and resistance bands
• Set personal bests and review your full exercise history anytime
JOIN THE FAMILY
• Share your journey with a global community of calisthenics athletes
• Follow your friends, celebrate their achievements and race them to the next level
Start today. Download the app and level up!
TRAINING INSIDE THE APP
Complete Workout Plans
The Full Calisthenics Journey to unlock all skills, Calisthenics Basics for strong foundations, Calisthenics at Home for no-equipment training, and Weight Loss to burn fat. Each plan is structured in 3-5 levels with clear requirements at every phase.
Skill Courses
Master the Handstand, Muscle Up, Human Flag, Front Lever and Back Lever step by step, with safe progressions built in.
Flexibility & Mobility
Shoulder Mobility, Hip Mobility, Hamstring Flexibility and Backbending programs to move better, prevent injuries and unlock new skills faster.
Targeted Workouts
Quick sessions for chest, back, legs, shoulders or skills: straight from our YouTube channel, now fully loggable in the app.
WHO'S BEHIND THIS?
Calisthenics Family is created by Michael & Yannick, brothers, athletes and coaches who turned their passion into the ultimate calisthenics training experience. For us, calisthenics isn't just a way to get fit: it's a game you'll get addicted to, and a lifestyle that makes you stronger every week. As you progress, you become part of the Family: a worldwide community of athletes who push each other to grow.
Ready to join? Download now and start leveling up!
This app offers a Premium subscription. Payment will be charged to your Apple account upon purchase, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renewal can be turned off anytime in your App Store settings.
This app is free from ads.
Terms of Service: https://calisthenics-family.com/terms-conditions/

bluejetty:00023286:ios.description:
The classic card game you love — play anytime, anywhere, no Wi-Fi needed. Solitaire Klondike brings you pure, authentic gameplay that sharpens your mind and melts away stress, one deal at a time.
Whether you call it Klondike, Patience, or just Solitaire, this is the timeless game beautifully reimagined for iPhone and iPad.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- 100% offline — no Wi-Fi, no data, no interruptions
- Draw 1 for a relaxing session, Draw 3 for a real challenge
- Daily Challenges to keep every day fresh and rewarding
- Vegas Scoring for players who crave competition
- Unlimited hints and undos — experiment without fear
- Winnable deals mode — every hand has a solution
- Satisfying winning animation when you complete the board
- Customize card backs, table themes, and backgrounds
TRAIN YOUR BRAIN
A few minutes of Solitaire a day is a proven way to boost focus, memory, and strategic thinking. Whether you're unwinding after work or keeping your mind active during a commute, every deal is a fresh mental workout.
- Great for commutes, coffee breaks, and cozy evenings
- Clear, large cards and intuitive controls — perfect for all ages
- Relaxing enough to unwind, engaging enough to keep you hooked
FEATURES AT A GLANCE
- Authentic Klondike rules — just like the original
- Portrait and landscape orientations supported
- Left-handed mode for comfortable one-hand play
- Smooth drag-and-drop or tap-to-play controls
- Auto-complete when victory is within reach
- Detailed statistics and personal best tracking
- Timer and move counter for competitive players
- Lightweight — won't eat your storage
Join millions of players who start their day with a round of Solitaire. Every deal is a fresh chance to relax, reset, and feel that satisfying win.
Download Solitaire Klondike now and rediscover the card game that never gets old.
Questions or feedback? Tap Settings → Support. We read every message.
Happy dealing!

bluejetty:00126633:ios.description:
Type less. Say more.
LazyBoard turns the messages you send every day into one-tap keys, right inside your keyboard, in any app. Save replies once, then send them in a single tap: "On my way!", "Thanks for your order", your address, your email signature, support answers, and more.

• Reply 10x faster: insert full sentences, paragraphs and emails with one tap.

• A place for every phrase: organize replies into color-coded folders.
• Paste photos & GIFs: save images and GIFs and send them from the keyboard or iMessage.
• Clipboard folder: keep copied text and reuse it anytime.
• Fast search: find any saved phrase in seconds.

PERFECT FOR

Your phrases work without Full Access. Photos, GIFs and the clipboard need Full Access, which iOS requires for those features. Your data stays on your device and in your iCloud — never shared.

bluejetty:00066465:ios.description:
Download for a 30-day free trial of our top subscription plan! Visit our website for more information on available plans and add-ons.
ForeFlight is the leading flight app for VFR and IFR pilots everywhere, making flight planning and flying easier, safer, and more enjoyable.
FLIGHT PLANNING, BRIEFING, & FILING
Plan flights with Touch Planning on the Map or full-featured form-based Flights view. Tap out a route in seconds and quickly see if flights will be affected by weather or TFRs. Helpful Route, Altitude, and Procedure Advisors make planning easy and accurate. Generate a graphical preflight briefing and file your flight plan directly from the app. Print a professional-grade Navlog for inflight reference.
WEATHER
Interactive weather layers include animated radar, global satellite and winds aloft, global icing, turbulence, and surface analysis, graphical AIR/SIGMETs, flight category, visibility, and more. View decoded METARs, TAFs, and MOS forecasts. Thoughtfully organized Imagery view puts a full range of forecast tools at your fingertips.
PLATES, CHARTS, & MAPS
Both VFR and IFR operations are covered with all of the essentials required for planning and navigation: data-driven Aeronautical Maps, VFR Sectionals, High/Low Enroute charts, SIDs, STARs, approach and taxi charts, and terrain, satellite, and street map views.

bluejetty:00073230:ios.description:
ChatOn–Your Advanced AI Chatbot Assistant
Meet ChatOn, your chat AI and multi-model AI assistant, engineered to streamline your personal and professional tasks. ChatOn brings together the most advanced AI assistant technology in one smart, intuitive app.
ChatOn is the ultimate all-in-one AI toolbox for everyone, from bloggers to business leaders. Need to draft emails, create pics, or generate ideas? Turn to our intelligent chatbot built on GPT-5, Gemini 3.5, Claude Sonnet 5, and Sonar for help.
With nearly 100M+ users worldwide, this smart software solution speeds up content creation by up to 30% thanks to its collection of 100+ AI prompts.
HOW IT WORKS
Step 1. Type a request for your AI assistant or pick from our prompts
Step 2. ChatOn will process your request using AI tools
Step 3. Get your answer via the AI chatbot interface as text, image, or summary
WITH CHATON AI, YOU CAN
Write, edit, and proofread your text
Get quick answers and explanations
Brainstorm ideas
Turn ideas into visuals with our image generator
Plan daily tasks, trips, schedules, etc.
KEY FEATURES
IMAGE & VIDEO GENERATOR
Create stunning high-quality AI images and videos from photos within the chat. Refine details, swap backgrounds, enhance quality, and adapt visuals in seconds.
IMAGE-TO-TEXT CONVERTER
ChatOn AI generator can extract text from your photos and add it directly into the chat AI. This means you can scan a book page and turn its text into editable data.
AI WRITING ASSISTANT
ChatOn, built on GPT-5 and Claude Sonnet 5, gives you a versatile AI writing chatbot and generator for any project (emails, speeches, social posts, etc.) Pick the length and tone of the chatbot's answers and get ideas for follow-up questions to keep your chat going.
WEB ANALYZER
Our chatbot AI uses GPT-5 to search the web in real time. ChatOn finds up-to-date links, making your assistant reliable for checking facts or making smart decisions.
DOC MASTER
Summarize, rewrite, translate, and ask questions about any doc with our chatbot AI. Just upload a PDF and get a quick summary to help you study or work.
YOUTUBE PRO
Share a YouTube link for the AI chatbot to summarize, translate, or answer questions about its content. You can drop in a long tech review video and get the key takeaways in seconds.
TEXT EDITING TOOLS
ChatOn, powered by GPT-5, helps you write product descriptions, polish intros, and summarize articles. Also, you can craft resumes and cover letters or generate emails. Try this: request a friendly follow-up email or a professional CV and add an AI-generated graphic to make it stand out.
SOCIAL MEDIA POST CREATOR
Built on GPT-5, our AI writing assistant and image generator can create content for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, or X. Just ask the chatbot to write a caption for you!
MATH GURU
Built on GPT-5 and Gemini 3.5, our chat AI helps you actually understand the math problem rather than just giving you the answer. Try sharing a math problem and watch the chatbot in action!
Explore the potential of GPT-5, Gemini 3.5, Claude Sonnet 5, and Sonar to make the most of this intelligent chatbot and generator.
Download ChatOn and start chatting in the AI chat made for real-life scenarios, from planning and decision-making to content creation, analysis, and practical daily problem-solving.
FAQ
1. Can ChatOn create text and images in multiple languages?
Yes! The chatbot and image generator support 19+ languages and adapt responses for both writing and visuals.
2. Which AI models is ChatOn built on?
This chat AI is built on GPT-5, Gemini 3.5, Claude Sonnet 5, and Sonar.
UNLIMITED ACCESS TO ALL FEATURES
- You can subscribe for unlimited access to all app’s features.
- Subscriptions are billed automatically at the rate depending on the selected subscription plan.
By using the app, you confirm that you acknowledge and accept our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:

FileHub is your local file and content hub.
Manage files, sync with iCloud, transfer between your computer and iPhone, watch videos, read ebooks, play audio, and clean up similar photos, all in one place.
Files are not just for storage. With FileHub, they are ready to open, continue, organize, and use.
【File Management】
- Manage local files and folders
- Sort, search, organize, and browse by directory
- Quickly find recently added and recently opened files
- Preview and open many common file types
【iCloud Sync】
- Supports iCloud document sync
- Access important files across your devices
- Keep files on your device and in your own iCloud
- See local and cloud file status clearly
【Fast Transfer】
- Built-in Wi-Fi file transfer
- No cable required
- No extra desktop software required
- Upload or download files from a computer browser
【Watch, Read, Listen】
- Play local videos
- Read PDF, TXT, and EPUB files
- Play music, course audio, and audiobooks
- Continue watching, reading, or listening from where you left off
【Photo Cleanup】
- Scan and group similar photos
- Recommend the best photo to keep in each group
- Preview and confirm before deleting
- Help free up local and iCloud storage space
【Private and In Control】
- Files stay on your device and in your iCloud
- No third-party content library required
- Built for personal documents, media, and long-term organization
FileHub is perfect if you:
- Often transfer files between your computer and iPhone
- Want one place for documents, videos, music, and ebooks
- Use iCloud to access files across devices
- Need to clean up similar photos and reclaim storage
- Prefer local, simple, and controlled file management
FileHub. Keep your files organized, accessible, and ready to use.

bluejetty:00083113:ios.summary:
Welcome to EasyPerformer, the most powerful Audio, Video and Lyrics app.
With Easy Performer you can easily play audio or video files by using our user-friendly interface. Perform live on stage, or at home while using all playback function
bluejetty:00083113:ios.description:
Welcome to EasyPerformer, the most powerful Audio, Video and Lyrics app.
With Easy Performer you can easily play audio or video files by using our user-friendly interface. Perform live on stage, or at home while using all playback functionalities EasyPerformer offers. You can also insert your own lyrics to any of your songs, and show them realtime on the screen while performing.
Create your own Setlists that each can handle up to 280 songs, with individually customisable settings. This can be useful if you need different song layouts at different moments. 
Import your audio- and video files easily from your local device or from an external cloud like iCloud, OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive e.t.c. We also have a unique tool to make importing your files even easier. To try this tool, go to the website “import.easyperformer.com” for more information.
Improve your performance with features like smooth fade-out and setting a starting point for rehearsals. But there's more! Explore options like auto-play, song looping, showing what's played, starting videos in full screen, and much more.
For the more advanced sound engineer familiar with MIDI, we also offer a Plugin! With the MIDI Plugin you will be able to configure MIDI commands within EasyPerformer. Add commands to your tracks at specific times of the Track, or simply add commands to single Pads.
EasyPerformer is a handy app for pros in audio and video, or just for fun at home. Whether you're presenting at work or having a karaoke night, EasyPerformer is perfect. Easily enter your lyrics, and create custom karaoke sessions for all your songs. Enjoy better and easier audio playback with Easy Performer!
You can use the app for free, but there's a limit on how many Pads and Setlists you can use. Purchase PRO to unlock EasyPerformer and gain access to all Pads and unlimited Setlists!

bluejetty:00022591:ios.description:
KakaoMap will show you the fastest routes in Korea!
With KakaoMap, you can find everything you want in a map app,
from directions to hot restaurants and local attractions, and more!
► You need to find the fastest route?
[Fastest and most accurate map]
You will get the latest information updated within 24 hours for cars, public transportation, walking and bicycle.
[Navigation system included]
No need to install a separate navigation app. When you search for a route, KakaoMap will give you navigation directions right away.
[Comprehensive search within one search window]
You can find all information you need using one search window including a bus number, a bus stop, a specific place, etc.
► When you need local information
[Recommendation just for you]
KakaoMap will provide useful information based on your current location including hot restaurants, keywords, spots, events, etc.
[Search areas on the map]
You can see search results right away by using the "Re-search this area" feature on the map.
[Places suggested by data]
KakaoMap analyzes big data on visitors and provides information on a specific place by age, gender and day of the week.
► Need more systematic maps?
[Favorites organized by group]
You can manage Favorites by group and indicate them on the map. Folders can also be followed and shared.
[Road View]
After searching for a route, you can see the place you plan to visit in advance using the Roa View feature.
[Realistic 3D Map]
We provide a more realistic vector-based map which can be rotated or tilted 360 degrees. It looks very real!
[Real 3D Sky View]
When you want to search a three-dimentional map, you can use 3D Sky View.
► Other convenient features
- Favorite places shown on the map
- Real-time bus information to help you reduce wait time
- Real-time traffic information to help you find fastest routes
- Convenient and accurate subway map
- Use Friends Location when you want to know where your Kakaotalk friends are 
- Hyper Accurate Bus services for Busan, Chuncheon, Mokpo, Ulsan, Jeju and Gwangju
► KakaoMap shares data with Health Application(Workouts, cycling distance, active energy burned) when using bike navigation.
► KakaoMap loves to hear your suggestions.
► Questions & Feedback
- maps@kakaocorp.com
- Kakao Customer Service Homepage 
(http://www.kakao.com/requests?locale=ko&service=59)
- Customer Service: 1577-3321
- Developer: 1577-3754
——
► Information about permission accessed
[Optional permissions]
- Location : To search nearby places and show directions using the current location info.
- Mic : Voice Search
- Camera : To review and report places, and to take photos for profile setting
- Photos : To review and report places, and to attach photos for profile setting
- Notification : Receive Arrival/Location-Sharing/Recommendation Alarms and Important Notices
- Health: Used to save your cycling navigation records
* You can still use the service even if you don't give the above permissions.

Dive into the world of Heroes Infinity and begin your epic journey through many lands and cities. Collect & build your epic team of heroes to achieve victory.

- A real-time strategy battle filled with dynamic effects and varied skill animations.
- Many heroes are waiting for you to Unlock & Combine them into a powerful team.

bluejetty:00178824:ios.summary:
“Never thought I’d run into an idle game this good & creative!”
You are the mighty Pharaoh, a tycoon of Egypt! But you're no idle Egypt tycoon, you need to build a town to recruit and attract and manage villagers to create your pyramid. Us
bluejetty:00178824:ios.description:
“Never thought I’d run into an idle game this good & creative!”
You are the mighty Pharaoh, a tycoon of Egypt! But you're no idle Egypt tycoon, you need to build a town to recruit and attract and manage villagers to create your pyramid. Use the best strategy to earn cash and gold to become the richest Egypt tycoon!
Pyramids are not cheap, so you'll need to become rich in cash and gold to educate and train your villagers to build a glorious pyramid. There is no time to idle, if you’re truly an Egypt tycoon or pharaoh, you will need to manager everything well so you can invest in the right areas - almost like a capitalist of today, but in Egyptian times as a millionaire or billionaire.
You can automate a lot of things, so you idle, offline or online. Then use your cash and gold profits to invest in the different areas, such as the classroom, mine, jetty, farm and market - like an idle millionaire! 
You can farm away in the first areas, it’s almost a hay day every day for you as your villagers work hard for you, the idle Egypt tycoon, in a simulation of an Egyptian town or village. Make hay every day while the sun shines and get rich on this adventure as a capitalist of Egypt!
You don’t need to just tap, tap, tap or click, click, click - all you do is invest your cash and gold profits and upgrade the areas as a tycoon or capitalist or idle millionaire. 
One key area is your mine, where you have to get your villagers to dig and mine away - but don’t be an idle miner tycoon, get them to do the work for you! They have to dig the mine to create big blocks for your pyramid. It’s a bit like you are the miner tycoon - they do the hard work, while you get rich with your cash and gold to build your pyramid. Lucky you! But it’s not a clicker or tapper game, no need to click and tap and farm away. However, it’s very satisfying and addicting when you can build the pyramid and you tap to build the pyramid. The stones from your mine fly over to create your Egyptian pyramid. What an adventure for the idle Egypt tycoon manager capitalist!
FEATURES
Find hidden objects in this tycoon game to earn more cash to profit like a millionaire. No need to adventure as they are in plain sight.
Automate your villagers to increase your profits and income in the idle Egypt tycoon management game.
You can earn cash and make profit, either offline or online - earn like a capitalist millionaire tycoon!
Hire the High Priest to keep your town open for ten hours - the best way to idle to become an Egypt tycoon and millionaire!
Profit when you upgrade using the best strategy in this tycoon simulation or simulator game
Prestige your town to unlock the next town along the River Nile - best way to earn millionaire profits to win more cash for the pharaoh manager!
Your villagers are Idle miners to help dig and unlock stones to build big Egypt pyramids!
No internet connection needed to play this idle tycoon empire management game
There are no supermarket, police station, prison or rollercoasters in this idle tycoon game! Maybe the occasional idle miner who would love to be a pharaoh or Egypt tycoon!
Name your village and get customisable characters for your idle villagers and miners.
Different areas to unlock:
PAPYRUS - you’ll need to farm papyrus for a real hay day pay day!
CORN - you can’t be idle as you need corn
BOAT YARD - to hit the high seas
CLASSROOM - you’ve got to learn to earn to become an idle Egypt tycoon! RIVER JETTY - new villagers arrive at the jetty to help you become an idle capitalist
MARKET - you can’t be a tycoon with a market to buy and sell things 
TEMPLE - this is your headquarters to access all the different areas
 FISHING - hope there are no hungry sharks here when you go fishing! 
You will not find a rollercoaster or police station or prison or supermarket in this idle tycoon game - we can promise you that! And it’s not a tapper or clicker game either. But it’s the best idle tycoon game you’ll find for best strategy and invest game.

bluejetty:00116548:ios.description:
Leo – Carsharing made simple in Montreal! 
Discover Leo, your new self-service carsharing solution in Montreal!
Need a car for a quick errand, a day trip, or even longer? Leo offers a simple, flexible, and affordable alternative.
No sign-up fees, attractive rates, and an all-inclusive service (parking, insurance, gas, and roadside assistance).
How it works:
• Quick sign-up – Download the Leo app and register in just a few clicks.
• Instant access – Reserve a nearby car directly through the app.
• Easy pre-booking – Reserve a car for 24 hours or more, up to 90 days in advance.
• Keyless access – Unlock the car and start your trip straight from your phone.
• Freedom to go – Take breaks while keeping your car and drive anywhere across Canada.
• Simple return – At the end of your trip, just return the car within the Leo zone, and you’re done!
• Pay as you go – Only pay for the time you use.
Download Leo today and rediscover the freedom to move!

bluejetty:00031335:ios.description:
Train hockey stickhandling skills anywhere with the SuperDeker App. The world-famous Advanced Hockey Training System for all players has gotten a big upgrade. Connected to the SuperDekerPRO, the SuperDeker App is the best way to get real-time feedback in your stickhandling training. 
ELEVATE YOUR HOCKEY TRAINING SESSIONS WITH THE SUPERDEKER APP 
The SuperDeker Pro Advanced Hockey Training System is the only system that utilizes patented lights and sensor training technology to improve your game. The SuperDeker App harnesses the power of your smartphone to help you take your hockey training to the next level. Use the App side-by-side with the SuperDeker Pro. 
TRACK YOUR SCORES TO MAKE REAL-TIME IMPROVEMENTS 
Submit your scores to worldwide leaderboards to measure your progress against other players. Use SuperDeker’s Advanced tracking technology to track progress visually. 
COMPETE AGAINST FRIENDS AND THE WORLD 
The SuperDeker App features upgraded score tracking with SuperDeker Pro Leaderboards. Choose from a multitude of game-mode leaderboard options to compete in every aspect of your skills. Compare your score against your friends with custom usernames. Create a username and hone your skills to watch your account rise through the ranks! The SuperDeker Pro device has 10 built-in games. The SuperDeker App unlocks an additional game and unlocks all options for a total of 21 games with subscription of the app
ACCESS EXCLUSIVE TRAINING RESOURCE: DEKEUNIVERSITY 
Deke University (DEKEU) is where the game’s best players train new skills, drills, and exercises to improve their game. There was once a time when a good hockey player being meant simply skating hard and shooting often, but those days are gone. To be successful today, you need to constantly improve your skill – that’s why we created DekeUniversity. 
DekeUniversity is a community of forward-thinking hockey players focused on building the best hockey training resources for players of all ages and skill levels. Log on today at DekeUniversity(https://superdeker.com/DekeUniversity) for hundreds of instructional videos, articles, and podcasts all to improve your hockey training experience.

bluejetty:00013879:ios.name: BOSS Small Business Accounting
bluejetty:00013879:ios.developer: 1C-RARUS TAS, MAS ULIYATI CHEKLANGAN JAMIYATI XORIJIY KORXONASI
bluejetty:00013879:ios.summary: Don’t waste your time on things that don’t bring you revenue. Boss was created to give you an opportunity to do business whenever and wherever you want. Our tutorial will help you harness the power of the app, even if you have never worked
bluejetty:00013879:ios.description:
Don’t waste your time on things that don’t bring you revenue. Boss was created to give you an opportunity to do business whenever and wherever you want. Our tutorial will help you harness the power of the app, even if you have never worked with accounting software before. With Boss, your business, big or small, can fit on your smartphone.
You will be able to use your mobile device to:
- Sell or buy goods and services (retail, wholesale, store credit, Debt, Cash).
- Maintain inventory records and generate price lists.
- Create and distribute pricing tables to your wholesale customers.
- Receive and spend money in any currency.
- Conduct mutual settlements with customers, suppliers, and other partners.
- Record inventory counts and revaluation of stock.
- Scan barcodes with your device’s camera.
- Keep accounts in multiple currencies at the same time.
- Estimate your expenses and profitability. 
- Print documents directly from the app.
A penny saved is a penny earned, and with Boss, you will save a lot of money. No need to buy a barcode scanner, an extra PC, or business software. With Boss, all you need is your smartphone. Start saving money now!
Features included with Boss:
- Multi-currency option allows you to run transactions with your customers in multiple currencies at the same time.
- Add a barcode and a photo to any product. This feature makes inventory bookkeeping so much easier.
- Make out an invoice directly from the app, and send it by email or share with any other messaging app.
- Generate any kind of report in just a few seconds: sales report, debt report, balance report, cost-of-sales, profit and loss report, and so on.
- Ability to calculate and itemize your expenses.
- Inventory is maintained in real time.
- Choose the best possible ROS (Return on Sales) calculation for your business.
- Two user modes: The Cashier and The Owner. The Owner can choose the number of functions available for the Cashiers.
How it works in practice:
On the main screen, you can see key business indicators such sales, leftover stock, income, debt, accounts receivable, and costs. You can add any additional indicator you need.
Quick action buttons are located at the top of the main menu. They are “Sell,” “Pay,” “Receive Payment,” and “Rates of Exchange.”
The following actions are below:
- Sales: Goods Issues and Drop Off.
- Money: Inflow (cash receipt voucher), Outflow (cash payment voucher), Transfers, and Rates of Exchange.
- Purchases and Stock: Transfers, Capitalization, Deactivation, Inventory, and Input of Leftover Stock.
- Catalogs - Goods and Services (Assortment), Clients (Customers), Suppliers, Employees, Currencies, Cash Desks, and Stocks.
The above are followed by Reports. Reports are presented as adjustable tables and graphics. Different filters are available. Types of reports are:
- Sales Report: This report describes sales from customers, goods, stocks, and documents. It can take into account earning capacity and extra charges.
- Goods: This is a report of a leftover stock. Here you can find prime costs, quantity, and sum at any price.
- Money report: Four types are available: Leftover stock, Money turnover, Dynamics, and Cash Flow.
- Debt Report: May be analyzed. Includes Accounts Receivable, Dynamics, and Money Turnover.
- Incomes and costs are available taking into account articles that may be added.
- Price list: It is important to be able to change the prices just in the price list. Revaluation will be made by upgraded price lists.
- Financial Result.
Paid subscription options:
- Auto-renewable subscription - $6.99 per month or $66.99 per year.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- You can Cancel subscription by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase (do it at least 24-hours before the end of period to avoid the next period charge)
Privacy Policy - https://boss-app.online/en/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service - https://boss-app.online/en/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00022360:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00022360:ios.description:
Your airport. Your rules. Start with a single runway and build it into a hub that never sleeps.
Airport Simulator: Plane City puts you in the manager's seat. Every takeoff, every gate, every passenger is your call. Join over 15 million players worldwide!
BUILD IT YOUR WAY
- Design terminals, runways, gates and cafés from the ground up. Decorate inside and out, place custom buildables, and shape a layout that runs clean and looks like nobody else's.
RUN IT AROUND THE CLOCK
- Plan flight schedules, coordinate plane rotations and assign aircraft to gates. Watch the peaks build across your 24-hour day, open extra stands and keep every departure on time. Short-haul, long-haul, everything connected.
KEEP PASSENGERS MOVING
- Speed up check-in, widen your security lanes, cut the queues. Add the services travelers actually want and design a journey that flows from arrival to takeoff. Happier passengers, busier airport.
GROW YOUR FLEET
- Collect detailed 3D aircraft and give them custom liveries. Assign them to routes, fulfil contracts and unlock bigger, more advanced planes as your network expands. Then watch them taxi, rotate and land.
PARTNER WITH AIRLINES
- Negotiate deals, welcome new carriers and grow your roster, then fly for them. Progress through the Wings of Trust Pass, a relationship-powered system that turns loyalty into exclusive unlocks. In addition, every flight you operate for an airline earns XP on its own Airline Pass, and each tier unlocks new rewards. The more you fly for a carrier, the more it gives back.
EARN YOUR WAY TO MADEIRA
- Madeira (FNC) is the one every aviation fan knows, where the runway meets the cliffs and the ocean, one of the most spectacular approaches in the world. It unlocks last, and only once you have proved yourself. Start with the quiet hub of Faro (FAO), grow through Beauvais (BVA) and take on FNC.
ENJOY AND WATCH YOUR PLANES
- This is more than a management game. Aircraft rolling up to the stand, ground crews at work, terminals filling, a departure lifting off the runway as the next one lines up. Plan your expansion, then sit back and let it run.
ABOUT US
- We are Playrion, a French studio in Paris, making free-to-play mobile games born out of a real obsession with aviation. Our office is full of plane models, including a Concorde built out of LEGO.
If you love planes, airports, or just watching a busy terminal come alive : welcome aboard.
Join the community: https://www.paradoxinteractive.com/games/airport-simulator/about

bluejetty:00044991:ios.summary:
Remember well with Timeshel! 
Add moments from your phone to your Timeshel story anytime during the month. When each month is done, we automatically print & ship your photos to you in our custom Timeshel Photobox. 
Getting monthly prints
bluejetty:00044991:ios.description:
Remember well with Timeshel! 
Add moments from your phone to your Timeshel story anytime during the month. When each month is done, we automatically print & ship your photos to you in our custom Timeshel Photobox. 
Getting monthly prints creates a physical, tangible story that builds overtime. Its a completely different - and much more meaningful experience - than occasionally ordering photo prints.
Download and explore the app at no cost. Subscribe anytime to get 10 or 30 prints. 
Simple and transparent pricing - Change options anytime: 
+ 30 prints & Photobox for $19.95 per month. Shipping & tax included. 
+ 10 prints & Photobox for $9.95 per month. Shipping & tax included.
// Rectangle and square prints! 
Upload squares, or rectangles. The app will tell the difference and print accordingly. Use our built in photo cropping tool after you upload to change print format anytime. 
// Flexible Subscription:
Forget to upload? No problem. Go back and upload to any missed month anytime and submit to print & ship immediately so you never miss out on building your story. Users frequently update their story every 2-3 months. 
Need a break? Select 'Skip Month' to not be billed for that month
Friendly reminders and push notifications to make sure you never forget. Super friendly customer support if you ever need help. 
// Worried about quality? 
Don't! We use a very high quality photo print process and premium photo papers to create a genuine archival photo print product. 
// Want doubles? 
Get multiple copies of any moment you love. Share them with friends and family. 
// Add additional recipients & share your story: 
Send a copy of your Timeshel story to any family member or loved one for a discounted price. A simple and beautiful way to keep in touch. 
// Multiple device support: 
Share login credentials and build your story collaboratively across multiple devices. No more texting photos back and forth to print!

bluejetty:00015555:ios.description:
IMAGINE YOUR CITY… AND BRING IT TO LIFE!
Draw your roads, lay your rails, place your buildings and create a city just the way you like it: small houses, tall buildings, parks, shops, monuments… Here, everything begins with a simple swipe of a finger.
Place Pango and friends in their roles: firefighter, mail carrier, doctor, shopkeeper… They drive, work, visit, wander around, go home to sleep at night… and bring life to everything you create. Every street becomes a story, every district an adventure.
Pango Build City is an open-ended construction game that develops creativity, organisation, exploration and fine motor skills. An intuitive, open experience perfectly suited for children aged 3 and up.
A PANGO CREATION
With over 15 years of experience and more than 15 million children worldwide, Pango is a trusted name for parents looking for calm, intelligent and gentle games.
Pango Build City continues this philosophy: a lively building game designed to spark creativity, logic and the pride of creating.
WHY PARENTS LOVE PANGO BUILD CITY
- Boosts imagination and sense of organisation
- Builds logic and understanding of how a city works
- Strengthens fine motor skills through road and rail placement
- 100% open construction: children create, modify and expand their city freely
- A gentle, lively world with no stress or competition
- Simple, smooth and perfectly adapted to small hands
- 3 pre-built cities to support younger children
A 100% CHILD-SAFE GAME
• No in-app purchases 
• No advertising 
• No external links 
• Built-in parental controls 
• Complies with children’s data protection standards 
THE PANGO VALUES: CREATIVITY, AUTONOMY, KINDNESS
At Pango, we design experiences from a child’s perspective: simple, open and enriching. Our games nurture curiosity, encourage independence and let every child imagine their own world.
Need help? A question? pango@studio-pango.com
More information: www.studio-pango.com
DOWNLOAD PANGO BUILD CITY and let your child imagine, build and bring their own city to life: A WORLD TO CREATE, ADVENTURES ON EVERY CORNER!

bluejetty:00034958:ios.summary: Code Teens is a cutting-edge app that provides young people with a fun and interactive way to learn how to code. Code Teens allows users to play, create and share games through a system of code blocks that makes it easier to understand the
bluejetty:00034958:ios.description:
Code Teens is a cutting-edge app that provides young people with a fun and interactive way to learn how to code. Code Teens allows users to play, create and share games through a system of code blocks that makes it easier to understand the basics of coding.
The app also features a variety of multiplayer games and personal challenges to play and learn about coding. Conquer all the challenges and collect all the characters!
Key features:
- Intuitive interface: The visual and easy-to-use design allows young people to easily learn how to code.
- Code blocks: Drag and drop code blocks to create projects, encouraging logical understanding and creativity.
- Step-by-step tutorials: Access a wide variety of tutorials that guide users through fun and educational projects.
- Active community: Share your projects with a global community of young coders, discover the creations of other users, and get inspired by new ideas.
- Cross-platform compatibility: Develop your projects on any device, whether it's a computer, a tablet, or a cell phone.
- Play and compete in multiplayer leagues.
- Games and personal challenges to beat your own best scores. 
- Create and share your own games.
Why choose Code Teens?
- Fun learning: Coding becomes a fun and motivating activity, fostering young people's interest in technology.
- Skills development: Enhances problem-solving skills, critical thinking, and creativity.
- Code Land + Code Teens: A single subscription for two projects for all ages. Code Land for the youngest members of the household and Code Teens from the age of eight upwards.
Join up to the coding revolution with Code Teens and unleash your creative potential in the world of technology!
Download Code Teens now and start coding your ideas!
ABOUT LEARNY LAND:
At Learny Land, we love to play, and we believe that games must form part of the educational and growth stage of all children; because to play is to discover, explore, learn and have fun. Our educational games help children learn about the world around them and are designed with love. They are easy to use, beautiful and safe. Because boys and girls have always played to have fun and learn, the games we make - like the toys that last a lifetime - can be seen, played and heard.
At Learny Land we take advantage of the most innovative technologies and the most modern devices to take the experience of learning and playing a step further. We create toys that could not have existed when we were young. Read more about us at www.learnyland.com.
Privacy Policy: We take Privacy very seriously. We do not collect or share personal information about your children or allow any type of third party ads. To learn more, please read our privacy policy at www.learnyland.com.
Contact us: We'd love to know your opinion and your suggestions. Please, write to support@learnyland.com.
Terms of Use: http://learnyland.com/terms-of-service/

Let's go to Little Panda birthday party! You can prepare a creative birthday gift, dress yourself impressively and go to the party! 
Product description: 
Go to the party with a DIY gift, which will not only show your respect but also enrich your imagination! 
Make a birthday cake. 
A birthday cake could be your first party gift! Mix the flour, eggs, sugar and cheese together, pour them into the molds and bake in the oven. At last, decorate your cake with whipped cream and fruits! 
Make a birthday card. 
A birthday card could be your second party gift! Select the birthday card you like, write your best wishes and paint with pretty color, then decorate the card with stickers such as flowers, plants, gift boxes, etc. 
Pick a big gift box for the party.

bluejetty:00156359:ios.description:
Neveo, the best gift for grandparents.
A MONTHLY PHOTO JOURNAL IN THREE STEPS
• You create – You and other family members upload your photos from your phone.
• We print – At the end of the month, Neveo displays the photos on a page in a beautiful photo journal that we print out and send.
• We deliver – A few days later, your grandparents will receive the photo journal containing all your printed memories!
HOW TO CREATE YOUR FIRST PHOTO JOURNAL
• Download the application, create your account and choose the plan that suits you best.
• Upload your photos. You have until the last day of the month to add more photos.
• Add descriptions. This is not obligatory but it always makes the experience more user friendly!
• Invite your family to take part. Brothers, sisters, loved ones, etc. In short, everyone who has nice photos to add.
• That’s it!
WHY SEND GRANDPARENTS A NEVEO PHOTO JOURNAL?
At Neveo, we believe the photo continues to be an ideal way to maintain family bonds. The proof is that we all love to leaf through our family photo albums and recall our fond memories. But we also know that our daily activities do not always leave us with enough time to share photos of our children and vacations with grandparents.
WHY CHOOSE NEVEO?
• Speed – It only takes a few minutes a month to create your photo journal: whatever the format, all you have to do is upload your photos. And even if you don’t have the time to write a little note, that’s okay, the layout is still nice.
• Ease – Our application is really easy to use, no need for in-depth formatting knowledge! We designed an application that is both intuitive and easy to use.
• Quality – The photo journal is printed on high quality paper so that your photos look as good as possible.
• No obligation – Do you no longer wish to send grandparents a photo journal? No problem: you can stop your subscription at any time.
• Green – For each subscription, we plant a tree in collaboration with the NGO Graine de Vie.
WHO ARE WE?
We are a young and enthusiastic team who want to put the grandparents at the heart of their families. This project has motivated us since 2016 and we hope it will allow many children and grandchildren to strengthen the bond with grandparents.
•••
Want to know more? Visit our website at www.neveo.io or follow us on Facebook and Instagram to discover some great family stories.

bluejetty:00071390:ios.description:
Practice Questions | Detailed Progress Tracking | Custom Study Sessions | Explanations | References
The PSI Test Prep app is your best streamlined, mobile companion to prepare for your licensure tests. Our premium content includes questions that are similar to what you’ll see on test day, explanations, references, topic breakdowns, and more. The app will help you advance your knowledge level while tracking your progress in detail. That way you can follow PSI’s national insurance content outlines while pinpointing where you need to improve before test day.
For each premium test, the app comes built-in with free major topic areas which you can study. To get the full benefits of the app, conveniently upgrade to the full set of questions via affordable in-app purchases called “Study Packs.”
### EXAMS INCLUDED
- National Real Estate Salesperson Exam (1,000+ questions)
- Life, Accident and Health (735 questions, 500+ flas)
- Accident and Health (411 questions)
- Life Insurance (434 questions)
- Property Insurance (434 questions)
- Casualty Insurance (264 questions)
- Personal Lines Insurance (439 questions)
- Property and Casualty Insurance (718 questions)
### CONTENT FEATURES
- Sharpen knowledge with thousands of comprehensive questions
- Follows PSI’s national insurance content outlines
- Questions similar to what you’ll see on test day
- Track your progress and pinpoint where to improve
### STUDY FEATURES
- Generate custom study sessions by topic and knowledge level
- Each question comes with explanations, topic breakdown, and references
- Detailed study progress and insights across all major topic areas
- Keep track of your test day with the calendar countdown
### PREMIUM FEATURES
- Access all questions within the Study-Pack
- Unlimited studying for up to 12 months
### ABOUT THE APP
The PSI app is powered by Memorang, an advanced AI learning platform developed by MIT engineers and physicians to make advanced learning simpler for any subject. Learn more at https://memorang.com/partners
### DISCLAIMERS
Each Study-Pack subscription contains restricted, premium content that requires an in-app purchase in order to access it for a limited period of time (e.g. 12 months). When this period expires, you will lose access as Memorang does not support auto-renewal. If you wish to extend your access (e.g. you moved your exam date), you can add time via additional in-app purchases.
A purchase will be applied to your iTunes account on confirmation to grant access to this Study-Pack for the selected limited period of time. When this period expires, you will lose access to the Study-Pack since PSI does not support auto-renewal. If you wish to extend your access for any reason (e.g. you moved your test date), you can add time via additional in-app purchases.

bluejetty:00162329:ios.name: Right Bite
bluejetty:00162329:ios.summary:
Eating healthy should feel enjoyable, not restrictive. With Right Bite, you can enjoy healthy meal plans that taste great, designed by chefs and dietitians to support your goals.
Right Bite makes healthy eating simple with 700+ chef-craft
bluejetty:00162329:ios.description:
Eating healthy should feel enjoyable, not restrictive. With Right Bite, you can enjoy healthy meal plans that taste great, designed by chefs and dietitians to support your goals.
Right Bite makes healthy eating simple with 700+ chef-crafted meals, built around premium ingredients, balanced nutrition, and real variety. No planning. No calorie tracking. No cooking required. Just great tasting meals designed to help you eat well every day.
HEALTHY MEAL PLANS THAT FIT YOUR GOALS
Right Bite offers structured healthy meal plans designed to support different nutrition goals, including:
• Weight loss
• High protein nutrition
• Balanced everyday eating
• Lifestyle wellness
Every meal is dietitian-approved and chef-crafted, designed to deliver the right balance of nutrition and flavour. Whether you're starting a new routine or improving your everyday nutrition, Right Bite makes healthy meal plans easy to follow.
HEALTHY MEALS THAT ACTUALLY TASTE GREAT
The biggest reason people struggle with healthy eating is taste. Right Bite focuses on creating healthy meals that are full of flavour, so consistency becomes easier.
Our chefs design meals using high quality ingredients, bold flavours, and carefully crafted recipes so healthy eating feels satisfying rather than restrictive. You should look forward to your meals, not feel limited by them.
700+ MEALS. REAL VARIETY.
Healthy eating should never feel repetitive. Right Bite offers 700+ healthy meals across multiple cuisines, including:
• Breakfast, lunch, dinner, sides, and snacks
• Arabic, Asian, Indian, and international dishes
• A wide range of flavours and ingredients
New dishes are regularly introduced so there is always something new to enjoy.
CALORIE CONTROLLED MEALS WITHOUT THE WORK
Right Bite meals are designed to support structured nutrition. Meals are:
• Calorie controlled
• Macro balanced
• Dietitian approved
• Designed for weight loss and healthy eating goals
You get the benefits of meal prep and calorie-controlled meals without the effort of counting calories or tracking macros.
HEALTHY MEAL PREP MADE EASY
With the Right Bite app you can:
• Browse hundreds of healthy meals
• Choose meals that fit your goals
• Manage your meal plan easily
• Stay consistent with your nutrition routine
Healthy meal prep becomes simple when everything is planned for you.
LIVE RIGHT
Right Bite isn’t about restrictive dieting. It’s about building sustainable habits and enjoying healthy food that tastes great. With premium ingredients, chef-crafted recipes, and hundreds of meals to choose from, Right Bite helps make healthy eating part of your everyday lifestyle.
Eat well. Feel better. Live Right.

bluejetty:00127750:ios.description:
Map My Fitness – All-in-one Workout Tracker & Fitness Planner
Stay on top of your health goals with Map My Fitness, the all-in-one Workout Tracker and Fitness Tracker designed to help you build better habits, stay consistent, and train smarter. Whether you're getting started with daily exercise or optimizing your performance at the gym, this powerful fitness app keeps you accountable and inspired.
Join a community of over 100 million users committed to movement, wellness, and self-improvement. Map My Fitness makes it easy to log every workout—at home, in the gym, or on the go—and see real results on your iPhone or Apple Watch.
TRACK FITNESS EVERY ACTIVITY, EVERY DAY
- Log over 600+ activities including walking, running, cycling, gym workouts, strength training, and more
- Use the built-in Workout Tracker to track distance, time, pace, calories, and heart rate
- Perfect for daily yoga, HIIT, and cardio workout routines
- Monitor your progress with accurate GPS tracking and detailed performance stats
- Easily record both indoor and outdoor sessions including yoga workout, gym training, and cross training
No matter your style—calm yoga workouts, intense lifts, or steady cardio—this Fitness Tracker keeps everything in one place.
PLAN & PERSONALIZE YOUR FITNESS ROUTINE
- Create your own workout planner to match your goals and schedule
- Browse the exercise video library of 100's of routines
- Set weight loss, performance, or endurance goals and track your journey
- Use built-in tools to adjust intensity and track consistency
- Perfect for beginners building a routine or athletes fine-tuning a plan
- Stay motivated with streaks, reminders, and progress summaries
Your training, your pace. This Workout Tracker grows with you.
CONNECT TO YOUR DEVICES & APPS
- Sync with Apple Watch, Garmin, Polar, Suunto, and other top fitness wearables
- Form Coaching tips for Garmin users to improve your form and prevent injury.
- Pair with Apple Health to track your heart rate, close your activity rings, and sync health data
- Pair with MyFitnessPal to balance your nutrition/meal planning and calorie burn
- Connect Bluetooth wearables for advanced performance tracking
- Integrate your Fitness Tracker with other top fitness apps for a complete picture of your wellness
Whether you're indoors doing a gym workout or outside jogging, your progress is always up to date.
TRAIN SMARTER WITH MVP PREMIUM
Level up with Premium features made for serious progress:
- Personal training plans that adapt to your fitness level
- Live Tracking to share your workout with loved ones for safety
- Heart rate zone analysis to optimize every cardio workout
- Limited Ads – focus on your workout and minimize distractions in the app.
- Custom workout splits, pace alerts, and deeper insights
- Perfect for anyone serious about gym training, daily exercise, and long-term results.
MOTIVATION THROUGH COMMUNITY
- Connect with friends or meet new workout partners
- Share your achievements and get inspired by others
- Join fitness challenges to stay engaged and win rewards
- Support and be supported by millions of users just like you
- From solo stretches to group gym workouts, motivation is only a tap away.
YOUR FITNESS JOURNEY STARTS NOW
Download Map My Fitness today and make every move count. From tracking cardio workouts to building your ideal workout planner, this powerful Workout Tracker and Fitness Tracker is your everyday companion for a healthier, stronger you.

bluejetty:00161005:ios.name: Qibla Pro - Kaaba Compass
bluejetty:00161005:ios.summary:
Qibla Pro has one job: show you the qibla the second it opens. No ads, no accounts, no analytics, nothing to unlock. Free, forever.
FINDING THE QIBLA, MADE BEAUTIFUL
Open the app and a living constellation of stars searches with you, glidi
bluejetty:00161005:ios.description:
Qibla Pro has one job: show you the qibla the second it opens. No ads, no accounts, no analytics, nothing to unlock. Free, forever.
FINDING THE QIBLA, MADE BEAUTIFUL
Open the app and a living constellation of stars searches with you, gliding as you turn. The moment your direction is found, the stars rush together and crystallize into a giant arrow pointing to the Kaaba. When you face Makkah, the whole screen floods green. That is the entire app, and that is the point.
APPLE WATCH
The full experience on your wrist: raise, glance, pray. A twinkling band hugs the edge of the screen while it searches, then becomes your arrow, with haptic taps guiding you as you turn.
ALWAYS READY
• Works without internet: GPS and compass do the work once your location is found
• Home Screen widgets and Apple Watch complications with your qibla bearing
• Haptic feedback when you reach the qibla, and when you drift off it
• Full VoiceOver support: vibration and spoken guidance lead blind users to the qibla
• 13 languages: English, Arabic, French, German, Spanish, Japanese, Turkish, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Urdu, Indonesian, Malay, Bengali
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your location never leaves your device. There are no analytics, no tracking SDKs, no accounts, and nothing to sell, because there is no data. The privacy label says it plainly.
FREE, FOR EVERYONE, FOREVER
I built Qibla Pro in Beirut because prayer should never wait for an ad. It is my gift to the Muslim community. There is a small tip jar; tips unlock nothing in the app, and if you would rather give to someone in need, that makes us both happier.
Remember me in your duas.

bluejetty:00127926:ios.description:
You are just one touch away from a spectacular Italian card game! Have HOURS OF FUN and challenge with La Scopa, also multiplayer online.
And... IT'S FREE!!!! Get it now and discover how entertaining a card game can be! Collect the cards from the table and, if you grab the last one, shout “Scopa!”, nice and loud! 
What you get with La Scopa:
- Invite a friend to play online (multiplayer) or find an opponent with Game Center
- Choose your level: 3 difficulty modes against the computer (A.I. artificial intelligence)
- Play both LANDSCAPE and PORTRAIT orientation
- Choose your deck: La Scopa got all the original Italian regional decks (Napoletane, Siciliane, Piacentine, Piemontesi, Triestine and more), in high resolution that will look astonishing on your iPhone and iPad. Or you can play with the classic Poker cards!
- Be part of the Global High-Score (Leaderboard): there’s one for each difficulty level
- Enjoy the fun challenges and badges to collect on Game Center
- Play with Accuse (Declarations) and up to 21 points or 31, 41 or 51 and choose among many other options (Rebello, Napola, Scopa d'Assi).
La Scopa was among the first games to make it to the App Store and it's been collecting 5 stars in every Country, with kind comments like these:
"Played this game as a child...love it".
"Like the original card game from Naples.".
"An enjoyable SCOPA game with a challenging computer opponent.".
Get it now for free!
And do not miss on our La Briscola and Tressette to have a complete classic card game suit on your iPhone and iPad!
Facebook www.facebook.com/outofthebit
Twitter @outofthebit
