“Curious has mastered making learning addictive.” -- Pand
bluejetty:00062111:ios.description:
Are you Curious? Get a daily workout of lessons, puzzles(including Crossword), and Curios and grow your Curious Quotient (CQ)! Who knew exercising your brain could be this much fun?
“Curious has mastered making learning addictive.” -- PandoDaily
“A Netflix For Learning” -- Forbes
“Curious stands out from sites like Khan Academy, Coursera, Udacity, Udemy, and Lynda.com by focusing on learning 'for learning’s sake.'” -- VentureBeat
“Curious Helps Hobbyists Share Their Skills” -- Mashable
Curious helps people reclaim between 5 to 30 minutes a day to learn something new! 
Ready to learn? Here’s how the game of lifelong learning works:
- First, we start with a brief interview.
- You tell us how much time you want to spend learning a day: 5, 15, or 30 minutes
- We customize your learning experience and build you a beautiful CQ wheel. Every wheel is unique!
- You receive a daily, personalized learning workout via email and on your Curious dashboard.
- You complete your workout by reading Curios (our well-loved daily fun fact), solving puzzles, and watching lessons.
- Add lessons and topics to a focus area for longer term learning goals. 
- Track your progress every time you learn. You’ll be so much more interesting!
Learn from over 25,000 video lessons on virtually any topic. Whether you want to learn how to crochet a scarf, plant an organic garden or play guitar, Curious helps you stay happy and healthy with a daily learning workout across eight key knowledge areas:
Aesthetic (crafts, photography, sewing, drawing, interior design, crochet, graphic design)
Humanities (public speaking, languages, storytelling, political science, history)
Mind / Body (cooking, fitness, nutrition, confidence, meditation, yoga, mindfulness)
Music (music theory, piano, guitar, singing, drums, ukulele, harmonica, violin, DJ skills)
Play (home DIY, sports, travel, games, gardening, camping, puzzles, biking, running)
Relationships (psychology, parenting, communication, marriage, dating, pets, leadership) 
S.T.E.M. (science, web development, math, biology, hardware, computing, engineering)
Work (Microsoft Office, entrepreneurship, budgeting, marketing, finance, blogging, analytics)
And you get recommendations from your (and our) favorite NPR shows: Science Friday, PRI's The World, BBC World Service, Marketplace, and more!
You also get 5 new puzzles every day: classic crossword puzzle, math mayhem with KenKen, and more.
Download the Curious app and start for FREE! Daily Curios and intro lessons available to all users; subscribe for full access to the entire lesson library. FREE trial included with each subscription. 
What have you got to learn? Get addicted to the game of lifelong learning & stay Curious!
--

1 year: $69.99
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on your country of residence.
Your Curious subscription automatically renews at the end of the subscription term unless auto-renewal is turned off. Subscription renewals cost the same amount as the original subscription, and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. You may turn off auto-renewal at any time after purchase by going to your iTunes Account Settings.
Privacy policy: https://curious.com/legal_app#privacy
Terms of use: https://curious.com/legal_app#terms

bluejetty:00156321:ios.description:
Introducing the M&T CentreSuite mobile app!
For M&T Commercial Card Client Use Only. This app is accessible to existing users of the M&T CentreSuite online card and expense management system.
M&T CentreSuite delivers a 24x7 on-the-go experience with access to a wide array of expense-management and card management features and benefits. Cardholders can enjoy a simpler, less time-consuming expense reconciliation process. Administrators can quickly review cardholder activity. Simply download now to enjoy all the functionality you're already using with M&T CentreSuite card and expense management today.
Depending on your M&T CentreSuite access today, you may be able to do the following:
• Track purchases by viewing statements and individual transactions
• Check authorizations and declines
• Manage receipts by quickly snapping photos with your smartphone
• Create and submit expense reports including the ability to view and code posted transactions 
 - Start an expense report on your phone and then pick up right where you left off on your desktop computer or on your phone at another time
 - If you’re an Expense Approver, you can review, approve or reject expense reports and view all attached receipts
• Temporarily suspend your account if needed, such as when a card is misplaced
• Manage account preferences and passwords
• Create and submit out-of-pocket transactions
Depending on card program administrator's current access today, you may be able to do the following:
• Perform basic account management
 - Submit real-time credit limit increases
 - Change single purchase limit
 - Change Merchant Category Group
• View statements
• View authorization and decline details
• View and attach receipts
• Perform Expense Report management:
 - Create
 - Submit
 - Review
 - Revise
 - Reject
 - Approve
Use of these features and services requires internet and/or data access through a computer or mobile device. bluejetty:00171704:ios.description:
Welcome to Toy Block 3D: City Build, an immersive idle simulator game that allows you to unleash your creativity and build your pocket world using toy blocks. Get ready to dive into a world of construction and crafting as you create a bustling metropolis, one block at a time. 
Have you ever dreamed as a child to build your own city from a construction set? What would you do first? Police station? Maybe the fire department? Or a hospital? Create a real pocket world with your own hands! Hire workers and build various buildings. Build your dream home with constructor blocks! 
In Toy Block 3D, you start with a single brick, and as you connect and stack bricks together, you'll witness your pocket world come to life. Every house is unique and has a different building structure, from police stations and fire departments to parks and skyscrapers. Shop Groceries Your Way
 • Order groceries with Pickup (where available) or Delivery
 • Scan a recipe to quickly find ingredients and add them to your cart
 • Shop thousands of additional grocery and household items
Save More on Groceries
 • Browse weekly ads and sales
 • Clip digital coupons and apply them at checkout
 • Discover personalized deals, bonus rewards and Cash Back offers
 • Track and redeem fuel points for gas savings
Fast, Convenient Checkout
 • Use Kroger Pay for fast checkout in-store
 • Add your Plus Card Card to Apple Wallet
 • View purchase history and quickly reorder favorite items

Terms apply: https://www.pay-less.com/i/terms/website-and-app.

No internet? No problem
Maps and journey planning even work offline
Regular map updates
Auto-magic updates keep our maps always up-to-date and box fresh
Every step of the way
A step-by-step guide means you’ll never get lost again

An ad-free experience
Proper VIP treatment, with no ads, ever
Priority support

bluejetty:00035146:ios.name: Charades Guess Game · Guessly
bluejetty:00035146:ios.summary: Ready to turn ordinary hangouts into unforgettable moments? Meet Guessly — a charades party game for nonstop fun with friends and family. Whether you love classic charades or fast-paced guessing challenges, Guessly turns every gathering int
bluejetty:00035146:ios.description:
Ready to turn ordinary hangouts into unforgettable moments? Meet Guessly — a charades party game for nonstop fun with friends and family. Whether you love classic charades or fast-paced guessing challenges, Guessly turns every gathering into an exciting social experience.
Guess the word on your screen using hilarious clues from your friends. Act it out, describe it, sing, or dance — it's your party, so let your creativity run wild! Perfect for house gatherings, wild parties, cozy pajama nights, family game nights, bachelorette bashes, and road trips. With a free deck, custom decks you build yourself, and 48 premium decks to unlock, Guessly keeps every round fresh, social, and unforgettable.
If you love charades and group guessing games, this app is built for you. Hold the phone so your friends can see the word while you guess from their clues. Easy to learn, exciting for groups, and perfect for players of all ages.
Why you'll love Guessly:
– Free Forever: Play the free deck and create your own custom decks to play unlimited — no payment required.
– AI Deck Generation: Describe any theme and let AI build a custom deck for you. Your first AI deck is free; unlimited AI generation is included with the subscription.
– More with Subscription: Unlock 48 premium decks (3,500+ words) and unlimited AI-powered deck generation with an optional paid auto-renewing subscription.
– A great party format for sleepovers and family nights.
– Easy to pick up and play, whether you're new to charades or already a pro.
– Fresh updates: new decks, seasonal themes, and clever phrases added regularly.
How to Play:
1. Gather your group and choose a deck that matches your party's vibe.
2. One player holds the phone facing the group — everyone else can see the word, but the guesser can't.
3. Friends act, describe, sing, or give clues while the player guesses.
4. Tilt the phone to mark a correct guess or skip to the next word.
Guessly delivers endless laughs, better connections, and unforgettable memories for any group.
Subscription details: Guessly offers an optional auto-renewing subscription that unlocks all premium decks and unlimited AI deck generation. The price and billing period are shown in the app before you purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
Enjoying the app? Leave a rating and a review! Got feedback? Write us at guessly.support@smakapps.io and help us make Guessly even better.
Privacy Policy: https://www.smakapps.io/privacy-policy
Terms and Conditions: https://www.smakapps.io/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00061515:ios.description:
The Paylocity Mobile App gives you the tools you need to stay connected and access HR and payroll information, all in one intuitive experience. 
Easily view paychecks, clock in and out, check schedules, update personal information, access messages, and complete tasks, all from a personalized home screen. Submit receipts, reconcile expenses, and use company cards with built-in controls. 
It’s just another way Paylocity helps you handle it all with one unified platform. 
Why employees love it: 
- Secure access to everything you need — with just one login 
- Edit personal info, search the company directory, or view current and historical pay info 
- Receive push notifications for activities like time-off request approvals, checks becoming available, chats, and more 
- Access Community, Paylocity’s social collaboration hub, to get important updates from leaders and connect with peers 
- Request access to a portion of earned wages before payday 
- Track expenses and card use 
- Review schedules and timesheets 
- Clock in and out 
- View an interactive org chart to check organizational structure and reach out to colleagues 
Why supervisors love it: 
- Experience one, unified platform 
- Submit, view, and approve time-off requests with real-time push notifications 
- Review and approve expense reports and timecards 
- Manage Journal entries for direct reports 
- Create, view, and edit schedules and shifts 
Security features: 
- Biometric functions are available for secure quick logins 
- All activities are encrypted and routed safely to secure Paylocity servers 
- Sessions will time out if inactive to prevent unauthorized access 
- Excessive failed login attempts will lock a user account 
App usage: 
To use the Paylocity Mobile App, your employer must be a Paylocity client, and you must be an authorized user with Paylocity credentials. Security role rights, specific access to the Paylocity mobile application, and functionality listed below may vary from company to company.

Plant Identifier — Your Reliable Plant Care Assistant
The world is full of fascinating plants, and everyone has experienced the curiosity of wanting to know more about a flower, tree, or shrub they've come across in a park or their own garden. **Plant Identifier** is your go-to app for identifying plants from photos and taking better care of them.
This app is equally useful for plant enthusiasts and professional botanists. Instantly identify plants, detect diseases, and receive actionable care advice. Build your personal plant collection and stay on top of their health with the app’s comprehensive features.
Why Choose Plant Identifier?
• **Plant Recognition:** Snap a photo, and the app instantly identifies the plant species and provides detailed information.
• **Disease Diagnosis:** Quickly detect any issues with your plants and get recommendations on how to treat them.
• **Build Your Garden:** Add your favorite plants to the "My Garden" section and monitor their well-being.
• **Care Schedule:** Get reminders for watering, fertilizing, and other maintenance tasks.
• **Tips & Videos:** Access expert care tips and watch informative videos for better plant maintenance.
• **History of Identifications:** Keep all your identifications in one place for easy reference.
Who Is This App For?
Plant Identifier is perfect for:
- Nature lovers who enjoy discovering plants during walks in parks and forests.
- Gardeners looking for an easy way to manage and care for their plants.
- Professional botanists who need fast plant identification and disease diagnostics.
Start Your Plant Journey Today
Plant Identifier is more than just an identification tool — it’s your companion for exploring the beauty of nature, caring for your plants, and growing your knowledge.
**Important:** This app is for informational purposes only and should not replace professional advice.

listings.description:
Plant Identifier — Your Reliable Plant Care Assistant

The world is full of fascinating plants, and everyone has experienced the curiosity of wanting to know more about a flower, tree, or shrub they've come across in a park or their own garden. **Plant Identifier** is your go-to app for identifying plants from photos and taking better care of them.

This app is equally useful for plant enthusiasts and professional botanists. Instantly identify plants, detect diseases, and receive actionable care advice. Build your personal plant collection and stay on top of their health with the app’s comprehensive features.

Why Choose Plant Identifier?

• **Plant Recognition:** Snap a photo, and the app instantly identifies the plant species and provides detailed information.
• **Disease Diagnosis:** Quickly detect any issues with your plants and get recommendations on how to treat them.
• **Build Your Garden:** Add your favorite plants to the "My Garden" section and monitor their well-being.
• **Care Schedule:** Get reminders for watering, fertilizing, and other maintenance tasks.
• **Tips & Videos:** Access expert care tips and watch informative videos for better plant maintenance.
• **History of Identifications:** Keep all your identifications in one place for easy reference.

Who Is This App For?

Plant Identifier is perfect for:
- Nature lovers who enjoy discovering plants during walks in parks and forests.
- Gardeners looking for an easy way to manage and care for their plants.
- Professional botanists who need fast plant identification and disease diagnostics.

Start Your Plant Journey Today

Plant Identifier is more than just an identification tool — it’s your companion for exploring the beauty of nature, caring for your plants, and growing your knowledge.

**Important:** This app is for informational purposes only and should not replace professional advice.

———————————————————————————————

• The length of the subscription is 1 month, this subscription is auto-renewing. You can stop the subscription at any moment;
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and is identical to the cost of the renewal.

bluejetty:00132554:ios.name: Cayman Good Taste
bluejetty:00132554:ios.summary: Cayman’s best restaurant app allows you to review 100s of menus, and find culinary events & promotions and book tables – all updated daily by Cayman Good Taste, the Island’s best restaurant guide. This app is the most up to date and compreh
bluejetty:00132554:ios.description:
Cayman’s best restaurant app allows you to review 100s of menus, and find culinary events & promotions and book tables – all updated daily by Cayman Good Taste, the Island’s best restaurant guide. This app is the most up to date and comprehensive resource for Cayman’s culinary scene and links to the best method for booking or requesting tables at restaurants. It provides detailed information related to restaurants, bars, menus, food events and promotions, and its advanced search and filtering capabilities enable you to find your ideal restaurant and get the most from the Culinary Capital of the Caribbean!
BOOKING TABLES
The app provides you with the best method of booking a table. Virtually all restaurants have a different reservation system ranging from simply making a phone call or sending an email, to providing a real-time booking capability. We have worked with restaurants to understand the most efficient way to book a table and update this regularly as restaurants change their systems. Please note that the restaurant is responsible for confirming any reservations made via this app.
RESEARCHED BY LOCALS
Our team updates menus, promotions and events daily to ensure you have the very latest information at your finger tips. Additionally, the team researches seasonal information for Valentine’s Day, Mother/Fathers Day, Thanksgiving, Easter, Christmas and many other special occasions and create special articles to ensure your finger is always on the pulse of Cayman’s culinary scene!
RESTAURANT ROULETTE
The Restaurant Roulette module on this app is designed to provide some light-hearted fun for foodies who want to let fate decide where you are going to dine next! However we can’t be held responsible for your dining experience, as depending on the category you chose, restaurants are chosen randomly from over 200 options! 
FEATURES
• Book a table
• Filtering by cuisine, price, area, etc.
• Real-time notifications
• Favourites
• Near Me function 
• Culinary events & promotions
• Menus with dietary requirements
• Restaurants that offer delivery / takeout
• History (recently viewed information)
• Maps
• Editors picks
PRIVACY
The Cayman Good Taste app has been designed to not use or exploit any user data. Data is stored based on Device ID and no personal data is required, stored or used.
FUTURE VERSIONS
The Cayman Good Taste app is constantly evolving and the next version of the app is already in development, but we would love to hear what you would like to see in the app, so please get in touch!
DEVELOPER INFORMATION
This app has been designed by Acorn Media and developed by Netclues Inc., who are also based in the Cayman Islands, with researchers and developers based in India, and clients around the world. Visit www.netclues.ky for more information.
PUBLISHER INFORMATION
The content on this app is maintained and updated by Acorn Media. We are based in the Cayman Islands and provide the following products:
• Explore Cayman – The Definitive Guide to Exploring Cayman
• Cayman Good Taste – The Definitive Guide to Dining and Entertainment in the Cayman Islands
• Cayman Resident – The Definitive Guide to Living and Working in the Cayman Islands
• Cayman Parent – The Definitive Guide to Parenting in the Cayman Islands
• What’s On Cayman – The most comprehensive app for events and what is happening in the Cayman Islands.
CONTACT US
Email info@acorn.ky or phone +1 (345) 946 3200 or visit www.acorn.ky for more information.

bluejetty:00060695:ios.description:
MP3 Audiobook Player is the easiest and most convenient app for listening to audiobooks in MP3, MP4, AWB, OPUS, OGG, FLAC, AWB, M4B, M4A formats on your iPhone, iPod Touch or iPad!
••• The app does not feature any audiobooks, but only plays your own audio files •••
The purpose of this app is to make listening to audiobooks in different formats easy and convenient! 
There are lots of websites with all kinds of audiobooks dubbed by professional actors and enthusiasts. Most of such audiobooks are distributed as folders with multiple audiofiles in different formats. 
I'm, the author of the app, listen to audiobooks all the time. Therefore, I did my best to make MP3 Audiobook Player a tool that has everything necessary to make this process intuitive and convenient.

• Adjustable playback quality (0.5x to 5.0x).
• Boost sound ( for audiobooks with low volume )
• The book cover is loaded from an image file in the book’s folder or from an embedded image from an audio file.
• Automatically saves the current playback position for all audiobooks.
• Supports CarPlay and integrations with over 50 other car models from Ford, GM, Mazda, BMW, Jaguar, Landrover and many more
• Jump to any file (can be enabled in settings).
• Supports standard headphone controls.
• Supports Apple Watch.
• Playback control from the Control Center and Block screen.
• A sleep timer with adjustable sleep periods or sleep after the end of the current chapter.
• Possibility to add/remove books through iTunes and from the computer via Wi-Fi
• Support WebDav for adding audiobooks directly from Explorer on PC or from Finder on MacOS

bluejetty:00157812:ios.description:
MyAspirus puts your health information in the palm of your hand and helps you conveniently manage care for yourself and your family members. With MyAspirus you can:
• Communicate with your care team.
• Review test results, medications, immunization history, and other health information.
• Connect your account to Apple Health to pull health-related data from your personal devices right into MyAspirus.
• View your After Visit Summary for past visits and hospital stays, along with any clinical notes your provider has recorded and shared with you.
• Schedule and manage appointments, including in-person visits and video visits.
• Get price estimates for the cost of care.
• View and pay your medical bills.
• Securely share your medical record from anywhere with anyone who has Internet access.
• Connect your accounts from other healthcare organizations so you can see all your health information in one place, even if you've been seen at multiple healthcare organizations.
• Receive push notifications when new information is available in MyAspirus. You can check whether push notifications are enabled under the Account Settings within the app.
Select features are also available on Apple Watch.
To access MyAspirus, you must create an account with Aspirus, our healthcare organization. To sign up for an account, download the app and or visit us at myaspirus.org. After you’ve signed up, turn on Face ID, Touch ID, or a four-digit passcode to quickly log in without needing to use your MyAspirus username and password each time. Then, make sure you have push notifications enabled to receive updates on your device when new information is available in MyAspirus.
For more information about MyAspirus’ features visit www.aspirus.org/myaspirus

- Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
- Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
- Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
- Transfer money between your accounts
- Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
- Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
- View and save your monthly statements
- Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the TRUFI CU app, you must be enrolled as a TRUFI CU digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00068948:ios.summary: Learn countries, capitals and flags with Quiz World Countries. This world geography quiz turns the map into a place to explore, practice and test your knowledge. Study for school, prepare for your next trip or enjoy the challenge of getting
bluejetty:00068948:ios.description:
Learn countries, capitals and flags with Quiz World Countries. This world geography quiz turns the map into a place to explore, practice and test your knowledge. Study for school, prepare for your next trip or enjoy the challenge of getting every answer right.
PUT YOUR MAP SKILLS TO THE TEST
Name the country or city shown on the world map, or find a country from its name. Recognize a country's flag, choose the flag that matches its name and identify countries from their outlines. Test your knowledge of capitals, regions and populations, then compare which country has more people or a larger area. With Premium, mix question types for a varied challenge.
LEARN FROM EVERY ANSWER
Choose from two, four or six answer options where available. Work through levels with increasingly difficult questions. Missed questions return later in the level, giving you another chance to learn the answer. With Premium, you can also type answers instead of choosing from a list.
STUDY BEFORE YOU PLAY
Browse the interactive learning map or search the list of countries. Open a country's fact card to discover its capital, region, population, area and largest cities. Take your time exploring Europe, Asia, Africa, the Americas and Oceania, then test what you remember.
MAKE YOUR OWN TRAVEL MAP
Mark the countries you have visited, share your map with friends and see your current location while traveling.
FREE PLAY AND PREMIUM
Play most quiz modes for free, with short video ads before certain levels. Optional Premium unlocks full access, mixed questions, keyboard answers, ad-free play and offline practice. Focus on the continents or regions of your choice, and keep learning without an internet connection, even on a plane.
Premium subscription prices vary by country and currency. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: https://www.quiz-geo.com/disclaimer/

bluejetty:00027609:ios.description:
AI Diary & Journal
Now document your life with Journal. Never miss a beautiful memory – A sanctuary for your mind and soul
Track your goals, mood and happiness. From once-in-a-lifetime events to everyday moments, Journal’s elegant interface makes journaling about your life a simple pleasure.
Why you need to jounaling your life?
Journaling might be the most underrated activity that can boost your productivity and well-being in just a few minutes a day. Just jot your thoughts down or record what happened during the day for a simple way to manage stress, enhance creativity, increase happiness, improve health, and increase work performance.
What is Journal App about?
This is a versatile app, and you can turn it in whatever you want to track. Your gratitude diary, Mood tracker, Exercise, Meditate, Eat and be grateful. Take care of your Mental, Emotional and Physical health by reduced anxiety. A Paper notebook and pen are fine for journaling, but we offer you more, We give you more context on what you’ve accomplished and where you might want to go. 
►Benefits◄
●Reach happiness and self-improvement being mindful of your days
●Make reflection a daily habits
●Discover what makes you happy 
●Use a big database of beautiful icons for your personalized activities
●Mix and match your own moods with funny emojis
●Deep dive into advanced statistics for every mood, activity or group
●Note down wish list quickly
●Share statistics with your friends
●Turn on Pin Lock and keep your diary safe
►Top Key Features◄
●Beautiful Designs – Concentrate on your writing with easy layouts that has everything you need
●Tell Your Stories – Add more than one Photos & Videos and Audio recordings, Songs, Location, Weather tag to bring your journal entries to life.
●To-DO list – Journal with pictures helps to organize ideas or thoughts to maximize productivity by making notes and lists instantly
●Trip Journal – Enable travel journal including travel photos in an orderly manner.
●Business Planner – Write Memos, create agendas, craft presentations as notes using journal as a task manager app
●Pleasant interface - A minimalist, uncluttered interface helps you focus on your thoughts and make journaling a pleasant experience.
●Syncing - Syncing will make sure your journal's up to date no matter what device you're using.
●Exporting - Just in case the app stops being developed or you want to move to a different journaling platform, you'll want to be able to export your entries in a format other programs can read, such as PDF or RTF.
●Reminders - Perhaps the biggest challenge to journaling is remembering to do it. Automatic reminders help you keep up the habit.
●Password Protection – Journal with lock helps to keep your data safe and private. Security code and Pin lock allows you to keeping your entires private. Data stored in the app is securely protected.
Terms of use: https://popularappsandgames.wordpress.com/
Privacy and policy: https://popularappsandgames.wordpress.com/privacy-policy/
Try this beautifully designed & stunningly simple Micro diary journal App now!

bluejetty:00084211:ios.description:
Survive, Collect, Craft, Trade with Players, and Perfect your Dream Build.
Delve into dream worlds to face your past Visions from lingering nightmares stuck to the back of your brain. Collect over 350 Visions and possess them as your own friends to help you become more powerful as you jump from the Lucid World to the Dream World.
Earn experience, loot, materials, and other unlocks that will stay with you permanently in the Lucid World. In your Dreams, gain new and powerful boons to temporarily help you erase any Visions in your way.
In the Lucid World, craft new items and materials for use in your Dreams, or trade them with other players worldwide in the Bazaar. Create custom loadouts to tackle the variety of challenges that can be encountered in three activity modes with a range of difficulties.
In Horde Runs, survive waves of Visions as they close in on your position. In Extraction Lairs, you will explore randomly generated dungeons filled with a healthy amount of plunder. To escape with all you've collected, you will need to find the exit and defeat the Final Vision. In Invasion Zones, a never-ending supply of Visions will rain down upon you relentlessly as you try to catch falling loot and duck danger.
The Visions you encounter can be turned into your own personal pets called Casters, fighting besides you with their own stats, perks, and utility. If you cannot get the perfect god roll, craft your own with materials or browse the Bazaar for other players' listings.
hellamental is free-to-play, has no ads, no Wi-Fi required, and no restrictions on the the amount of time you can play.

bluejetty:00148284:ios.description:
Build stronger, more defined glutes at home with guided, time-based workouts created for women of every fitness level. No gym or equipment required.
Choose from three progressive 28-day programs focused on your booty, full body, or glutes and core. Each program gives you a clear training schedule that gradually becomes more challenging as you progress.

• Glutes and booty
• Legs and lower body
• Abs and core
• Cardio
• Full body
• Upper body 
Every session follows a simple structure with a warmup, one complete workout and a cooldown. Exercises are time based instead of repetition based, with rest periods already included.
CHOOSE YOUR LEVEL
Select Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced. The exercise sequence stays consistent while the work time and intensity adapt to your level.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO STAY CONSISTENT
• Clear exercise demonstrations and instructions
• Workouts you can complete without equipment
• Personalized program recommendations
• Flexible workout days and reminders
• Workout history, streaks and achievements
• Exercise favourites
• Custom workout creation
• Progress tracking 
Whether you want to strengthen your glutes, improve endurance or build a more consistent routine, Booty Workout gives you a structured plan you can follow at home.
Download the app and start building a stronger you, one workout at a time.
Results vary depending on consistency, effort and individual factors.
Some programs and features require an automatically renewing subscription.

bluejetty:00129357:ios.summary:
Are you looking for a way to analyze your face and find your best selfies? Or maybe you want to better understand your facial proportions compared to the golden ratio? Miroir is the app you're looking for!
Miroir uses on-device machine lea
bluejetty:00129357:ios.description:
Are you looking for a way to analyze your face and find your best selfies? Or maybe you want to better understand your facial proportions compared to the golden ratio? Miroir is the app you're looking for!
Miroir uses on-device machine learning to perform detailed face analysis using real facial measurements. Analyze facial ratios and facial proportions from a single photo.
Lengths, angles, spacings, and facial ratios are measured precisely to give you a complete facial analysis. Every measurement includes a description and an ideal reference value so you can better understand your facial structure.
Key Features:
- Advanced face analysis
- Detailed facial measurements and facial ratios
- Golden ratio reference values for all measurements
- Replay every individual facial measurement
- Auto-rotates and aligns your face for consistent measurements
- Your photos and face data always stay on your device
- Offline and on-device machine learning for maximum privacy
Miroir provides facial measurements based on a single front-facing photo. Results are intended to help you explore facial structure and facial proportions through measurable face analysis. Miroir cannot evaluate your overall facial beauty. Attractivity of facial features, shapes and types is all down to personal preference.
__________
Miroir Pro:
Unlock unlimited photo analysis and access all face ratios. Choose a monthly or annual subscription, or unlock Pro forever with a one-time Lifetime purchase. You can manage or cancel your subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://sandratra.com/legal/terms

bluejetty:00064351:ios.description:
Everything you love about Vogue - anytime, anywhere. Get the news, shop the latest trends, and connect with fellow fashion obsessives from around the world with the Vogue app.
On the Vogue app, you can:
- Get the inside line on the top stories from Vogue editors.
- Engage with fellow fashion enthusiasts in discussions on your favorite topics.
- Shop editor-approved buys and the latest trends all within the app.
- Test your runway IQ with our daily Runway Genius quiz.
- Discover new topics to join the conversation across the globe.
- Never miss a story by following Vogue editors and contributors and exploring their latest posts.
- Take a front row seat at every international show.
- Explore our archive of 20,000+ fashion shows by designer, season, location and type
- Browse 1 million+ runway images— dating back to 1988—with AI-powered image search.
- Vote on your favorite looks, then see how your selects stack up to the Vogue community.
- Save looks and collections to your mood boards, with advanced organizational tools.
- Get a close-up look at all the details from Dior, Chanel, Louis Vuitton, and so much more.
- Follow your favorite brands and topics so you never miss a Vogue moment.
- Share your favorite looks and collections with others via email, text, and social media.
- Browse thousands of photos capturing street style worldwide, shot by our renowned photographers.
- Read reviews from Vogue’s internationally recognized writers for our insider take.
The app is free to download. Subscribers receive unlimited digital access to Vogue Runway. Users need to be logged in and subscribed to access Vogue Runway content. All Vogue subscribers will have unlimited digital access to the app as part of their existing subscription. App subscribers have full access to the Web site. Users who have trouble accessing stories can e-mail appfeedback@vogue.com for assistance.
You can choose from two subscription options:
- Monthly subscription: $4.99. Non-refundable. Cancel anytime.
- Annual subscription: $19.99. Non-refundable. Cancel anytime.
Prices above are shown in USD and they’ll be shown in your local currency at the time of purchase.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by updating the user’s App Store Subscription settings after purchase. Payment will be charged to iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
Please note: Users can cancel their subscription anytime from App Store settings.
Information about our Terms of Service & Privacy Policy can be found at:
Privacy Policy: http://www.condenast.com/privacy-policy
App User Agreement: https://www.condenast.com/app-terms-of-use

bluejetty:00116017:ios.description:
Make informed choices about your health, every day.
Just Well combines vital tracking and smart food analysis to help you stay on top of wellness goals.
Simple to use, health-focused, designed for daily living.
Disclaimer: 
This app promotes general wellness and supports healthy habits. It does not provide medical advice and is not a substitute for professional consultation. Please consult a doctor before making any medical decisions, and use this app responsibly.
What You Can Do with Just Well:
1. Scan meals, nutrition labels, and barcodes
→ Instantly analyze your food content—check sugar, nutrients, and ingredient highlights. Get AI-powered insights that help you better understand your meals and support informed choices.
2.Generate low-sugar, goal-based recipes
 → Create AI-powered meal ideas tailored to your dietary needs: low-carb, plant-based, high-fiber, and more.
3.Log daily health stats and lifestyle habits
→ Log your weight, temperature, blood pressure, and other daily stats to better understand your wellness trends over time.
4.Stay informed with practical tips and real health insights
→ Discover daily wellness tips and curated reads to support healthier routines and help you stay on track with your goals.
Subscription Plans:
Choose from Weekly, Monthly, or Yearly options to suit your needs.
· Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon purchase confirmation.
· After purchase, you can manage your subscription and disable auto-renewal in your Account Settings.
· To avoid being charged for the next cycle, make sure to turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
Terms of Service: https://www.veristenlabs.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.veristenlabs.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00026906:ios.description:
Know more about San Antonio with the San Antonio Express-News app. Stay informed with trusted journalism wherever you are. 
• Get San Antonio news alerts and notifications, customized by preferred topics 
• Catch high school football, college sports and San Antonio Spurs coverage 
• Stay on top of Texas news, weather, business, food and trending stories
• Tune in to the podcasts Spurs Insider, ENside Politics, ¡Nosotros! for informative and fresh perspectives
• Page through the e-Edition, a digital replica of the newspaper
• Stay sharp with Puzzmo’s reimagined favorites and brand-new puzzles
• Listen to Express-News stories with Everlit, a text-to-audio tool 
• Check out exclusive guides and compelling columns and commentary
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS:
• Subscribe for unlimited digital access to the app, ExpressNews.com, e-Edition and newsletters. Get 1 month free, then $14.99 per month. Cancel anytime. 
• Current digital and print subscribers have unlimited access to the app. 
• Digital subscribers: Sign in to the app to access your benefit. 
• Print subscribers: If you haven’t activated your digital access yet, look for “Activate Access” at the bottom of the app welcome screen. 
PAYMENT: Payment will be charged to your iTunes account with the confirmation of your purchase and will automatically renew each month unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of your monthly period.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
PRIVACY POLICY: www.ExpressNews.com/privacy_policy/
TERMS OF SERVICE: www.ExpressNews.com/terms_of_use/
FEEDBACK: We want to hear from you! Let us know if you have questions or suggestions: feedback@express-news.net or 210-250-2000.

• Arrange your order, open the app, enter pickup and drop-off, then book it.
• Our pro drivers will pick up the supplies and ensure the order is correct.
• Real time updates and tracking URL allow you to follow and share the status of your delivery.
• Once your Curri driver arrives, we'll collect a signature and photo at drop-off for your records. Till next time.
PRICING 
• Transparent and upfront pricing.
• What you see is what you pay.

Curri is your pro delivery service. Emergencies. Fleet replacement. Delivering within the hour, all throughout the week. With affordable options, we ensure your deliveries meet the requirements your customers have come to expect in this digital age.

Curri handles all of your construction-related deliveries: supply runs, site-to-site, warehouse-to-site, in-store pickups from Home Depot or Lowe’s. You name it, we have you covered. 

HOW IT WORKS

• Arrange your order, open the app, enter pickup and drop-off, then book it.
• Our pro drivers will pick up the supplies and ensure the order is correct.
• Real time updates and tracking URL allow you to follow and share the status of your delivery.
• Once your Curri driver arrives, we'll collect a signature and photo at drop-off for your records. Till next time.

PRICING 

• Transparent and upfront pricing.
• What you see is what you pay. 

SOCIAL

• IG/Twitter/FB: @teamcurri

bluejetty:00061927:ios.name: Absolute RC Simulator
bluejetty:00061927:ios.summary: Professional RC flight simulator - a must have for anyone flying RC. Probably the most realistic behavior on mobile phones and tablets. Our models fly the same as real RC models, in real RC flying fields. Do not fly your real RC model befo
bluejetty:00061927:ios.description:
Professional RC flight simulator - a must have for anyone flying RC. Probably the most realistic behavior on mobile phones and tablets. Our models fly the same as real RC models, in real RC flying fields. Do not fly your real RC model before trying this program! Don't crash your models, crash ours! Crashing models here cost nothing.This application will save you money, frustration and many days in waiting for model parts. 
Learn to fly without fear. Rain or wind outside, start flying right now!
The program includes wide range of RC planes and helicopters, from starter models to expensive aerobatic and scale models. This is the only RC simulator that includes RC boats and RC cars, in addition to excellent simulation of RC planes, RC helicopters and RC drones. Great for experienced modelers, and even greater for kids or someone who is just starting in this exciting hobby. 
The program includes 3 free interactive object sets that can be loaded on any flying field when flying helicopters. The interactive objects can be used to learn landing and precise model control. 
In addition to the fixed point camera that represents the RC pilot point of view, we have included follow up camera, and pilot view camera. That is very useful when you are learnings because the model never gets away. 
Notes: 
1. This is not a game. You are controlling flying RC models that reacts like real flying models. It takes some time to learn, and is not easy. 
2. The onscreen control sticks are just indicators! They are made small so they do not obscure the screen. 
3. Sliding your finger anywhere on the right screen half affects the right control stick , the same for the left screen part - sliding finger there moves the left control stick. You do not need to keep your fingers on them.
The program includes intelligent Auto Pilot that can help you with some or all of the controls. Please use it initially the get a feel of flying and progress faster.
We suggest to select beginner settings at first few days before you can comfortably progress further.
Have fun and keep flying!

bluejetty:00180717:android.name: Wine Factory Idle Tycoon Game
bluejetty:00180717:android.summary: Ever been wondering how a wine idle game could work, how does a real wine empire tycoon feel? What does wine experience look like and how does a wine factory work in general? Well, here is a perfect chance for you to get it all. Welcome to
bluejetty:00180717:android.description:
Ever been wondering how a wine idle game could work, how does a real wine empire tycoon feel? What does wine experience look like and how does a wine factory work in general? Well, here is a perfect chance for you to get it all. Welcome to Wine Factory - brand new idle clicker game. Build your factory from scratch! Plant, harvest, age, deliver taste and maybe last not least - earn money running the business. Let this simulator feel like exquisite wine taste and make you a wine game tycoon!
Start running a low-income wine factory and work your best idle game to expand it. Plant more, harvest more, hire experienced workers who can ease the process cycle, deliver wine orders, purchase the latest facilities and add such wine appreciation places like a wine bar. Work, manage, invest, earn and let this wine simulator game help you chase a big dream: building a wine factory empire!
HARVEST GRAPE, AGE, STORE THE WINE
Plant, harvest grape bushes and use it to produce the finest wine out there. Get your hands on securing the very first step of winemaking - harvest fresh ripe grape, get workers take really good care of it to then let it age in well aged barrels themselves. After storing it for some time in the Cellar, voilà, the finest wine is ready to be delivered, served and cherished!
HIRE DIFFERENT MANAGERS TO EASE THE WORK
Not even a single world’s greatest leader can’t do everything on his own and wine business here is not an exclusion. A key to building a wine factory in an idle game and becoming a tycoon is to divide tasks, hire the right people to run and manage their part of the great business machine. Pushing it forward till the tycoon's money arrives. So hire workers, farmers, grape pickers, managers, movers, and many more to make sure that each and every step of the wine factory business works accurately and with no delay.
IMPROVE FACILITIES AND TRANSPORT
Loaders, winepress, truck and bottling lines…This winery factory idle game got it all. It’s essential to make adjustments, buy the latest and newest facilities, and update existing ones. Not only to modernize the factory pipeline but also do it all to make wine taste better. Satisfied customers means income stats coming up, right?
EXPAND VINEYARDS AND WINERY
Expanding is a step to success. These vineyards have huge potential and can give much more when it’s simply more grapes planted and harvested. Same works for wine factory: Middle wine factory, Huge, Advanced ones…This wine idle game has got some wine factory names. You’ll never get bored with the variety of business buildings you have to run here!
THROW PARTIES AT A WINE BAR
Even the hardest working tycoons could have a little bit of fun. Show society how parties, discos and the most different cultural events are being held. Open up a true wine society while hosting parties at your very own unique wine bar. Earn Prestige coins and receive rewards for throwing the most memorable wine bar events ever! A lot of wine and fun going in this idle game, huh?
COMPLETE QUESTS AND ORDERS
Well, all this hard work needs to be paid off, literally. Wine taste calls to be delivered to clients and shared with customers. This is how great tycoon money can be earned.
If you like management and idle games, you’ll enjoy Wine Factory idle. A casual but no less interesting and fun idle clicker game calling for strategic decisions to be taken to transform a wine factory into a real idle game deal of wine business showing profitable results. Let good managers and workers help you to progress making improvements, delivering the best idle wine experience. Make the winery a high-quality business factory and become the greatest winery tycoon in the world!

---Intro---
-An adventure RPG based on the classic "Chinese Paladin"
-"Chinese Paladin" debuted in 1995 on PC and instantly became a classic. Over the years, over 20 related games and 7 TV adaptations have been released. Play this game to relive beloved storylines and characters. Veteran players can relive memorable moments, while new players can experience the enchanting world and swords and immortals.

In "Chinese Paladin," you will find elegant Chinese fantasy design, detailed character portrayals, and heart-stirring plot. Relive the first prominent Xianxia RPG and experience the most authentic world of immortals.

Embark on a mysterious journey, encounter magical beings and experience love and hatred in the world of immortals. From the tranquil town of Yuhang to the enigmatic lands of Hmong, travel in mesmerizing and immersive scenery.

Strategize your team comp with a unique character development system and discover hidden combat formations. Revisit the Yuhang Inn, reveal hidden quests, and unveil untold stories of the Three Realms, with numerous Easter eggs scattered throughout waiting for you to discover.
-Adventure with Friends-
Embark together on a journey with fellow adventurers. Forge bonds with like-minded partners, joining the Golden Orchid Feast to invite heroes from all corners to witness blood oaths, and engage in real-time sparring on your journey!
-Abundant Rewards for F2P Players-
Start now and get 100 free draws! Draw powerful five-star heroes with ease! Join activities with generous rewards and freely select numerous characters! You can also save up resources for a week without any pressure to spend!

- Extract frames in original 4K & HD quality
- Export as JPEG, PNG, or HEIF
- Create thumbnails for YouTube & TikTok
- Turn video clips into shareable memes
- Lightning-fast processing with zero quality loss
---
KEY FEATURES

Multiple Export Formats
Save your frames as JPEG, PNG, or HEIF. Choose the format that works best for your needs.
Full Metadata Preservation
Keep all original video metadata intact in your exported photos - date, location, camera info, and more.
iCloud Photo Library

Clean & Simple Interface

- Sports Fans: Freeze the winning goal or that incredible play
- Families: Save precious moments from home videos
- Meme Makers: Extract the perfect reaction frame

- Video Input: MP4, MOV, M4V, HEVC
- Photo Export: JPEG, PNG, HEIF
- Quality: Up to 4K Ultra HD
- Storage: Local and iCloud Photo Library

FREE VS PREMIUM
Free:
- Unlimited frame extraction
- Export to Photos
- All video formats supported
Premium:
- Unlock all export formats
- Priority processing
- Ad-free experience

PRIVACY FIRST

・進捗が自動でセーブされるため、途中からスタートすることが可能です
・進め方に詰まったときは「ヒント」と「答え」を用意していますので最後までサクサク進めることができます
・最後まで無料でお楽しみいただけます
■◇■-------遊び方-------■◇■
・気になる場所をタップして調べてみましょう
　謎解きやアイテムが見るかるかもしれません
・手に入れたアイテムはアイテムボックスをタップすることで拡大表示されます
・アイテムは別のアイテムと組み合わせたり、フィールドで使用することができます
・いろんな場所に謎解きのヒントが隠されています。いろんな所をタップしてヒントを見つけましょう
・もしも進め方や謎の解き方がわからなくなってしまった場合は
　「ヒント」のボタンがありますので使ってみましょう
　もし「ヒント」を見ても解けない場合は「答え」も用意していますので安心して進められます
・途中から始める場合はタイトル画面の『CONTINUE』ボタンから続きが始められます
■◇■-------提　供-------■◇■
下記サイトより効果音を使用させていただきました。
ポケットサウンド様　 http://pocket-se.info/
効果音ラボ様　https://soundeffect-lab.info/

bluejetty:00126249:ios.summary:

Free UpCall application is the practical and safe solution to identify unknown numbers. When you receive a call from a Turkcell unknown number, you can find
bluejetty:00126249:ios.description:
Dou you want to know who’s calling, even the number isn’t saved in your contacts? 
Free UpCall application is the practical and safe solution to identify unknown numbers. When you receive a call from a Turkcell unknown number, you can find out who the caller is while your phone is ringing, you can query a Turkcell unknown number via the advanced search tool and reach the person you want to call easily.
In the UpCall application, in addition to unknown numbers, there are many different features; with the do not disturb feature, you can use your phone as if it is turned off when it is on, you can personalize the operator name with the operator name setting, you can choose a tone for the callers, you can add photos, stickers and notes to your calls.
DOU YOU WANT TO KNOW WHO IS CALLING? 
When you get a call from a Turkcell number that is not saved in your contacts, you can see who is calling while your phone is ringing. The caller IDs appears on the screen if the callers have given permission to share their names.
YOU CAN ALSO CALL THE NUMBERS YOU DON'T KNOW
Now, your directory is not just made up of saved numbers, you can also find and call numbers you don't know. Thanks to UpCall, you can query a Turkcell number from a name and a name from a number. In addition, you can search for a place number by simply typing its name, view its location on the map, and draw a route.
LET THE OTHERS KNOW WHY YOU’RE CALLING!
By adding a photo, sticker and note to your call, you can tell the other party why you are calling while the phone is still ringing. In order to benefit from this feature, the application must be installed on the called one’s phone too.
BE AWARE OF SPAM CALLS
You can mark numbers as spam and receive a notification if they call again: You can mark a selected number as spam, get alerted when it calls back, and choose not to answer the call. 
Marking a number does not block it; it simply triggers a warning.
BE UNREACHABLE WITH DO NOT DISTURB
If you want to be unreachable but at the same time keep your phone on, UpCall is the solution for you!
The callers will hear the announcement that "the person you are calling cannot be reached". But you can keep on using your phone and making calls.
CUSTOMIZE OPERATOR NAME
With UpCall, you can change the operator name on the screen of your mobile phone.
CHOOSE YOUR TONE FOR THE CALLERS 
You can choose a tone for the callers that they can listen to while your phone is ringing. Thus, you can inform why you can’t pick up the phone.
ALL YOUR CALLS NOW ON ONE SCREEN
Unlike your phone's call screen, you can see all your calls on a single screen. For example, you can learn from your call records, who called you when your mobile is turned off or busy or when the called ones are reachable. You can receive service notifications for call services (KimAramış, CepAçık, ŞimdiAra, KimArıyor…etc) within the application instead of SMS. You must have a subscription to search services for this feature.
* This application can be used by all operator subscribers in Turkey. Some features are only available to Turkcell subscribers due to network restrictions. 
For details and Frequently Asked Questions, you can visit https://www.turkcell.com.tr/servisler/upcall#sss

listings.name: UpCall
listings.description:
Dou you want to know who’s calling, even the number isn’t saved in your contacts? 
Free UpCall application is the practical and safe solution to identify unknown numbers. When you receive a call from a Turkcell unknown number, you can find out who the caller is while your phone is ringing, you can query a Turkcell unknown number via the advanced search tool and reach the person you want to call easily.
In the UpCall application, in addition to unknown numbers, there are many different features; with the do not disturb feature, you can use your phone as if it is turned off when it is on, you can personalize the operator name with the operator name setting, you can choose a tone for the callers, you can add photos, stickers and notes to your calls.

DOU YOU WANT TO KNOW WHO IS CALLING? 
When you get a call from a Turkcell number that is not saved in your contacts, you can see who is calling while your phone is ringing.  The caller IDs appears on the screen if the callers have given permission to share their names.

YOU CAN ALSO CALL THE NUMBERS YOU DON'T KNOW
Now, your directory is not just made up of saved numbers, you can also find and call numbers you don't know. Thanks to UpCall, you can query a Turkcell number from a name and a name from a number. In addition, you can search for a place number by simply typing its name, view its location on the map, and draw a route.

LET THE OTHERS KNOW WHY YOU’RE CALLING!
By adding a photo, sticker and note to your call, you can tell the other party why you are calling while the phone is still ringing.  In order to benefit from this feature, the application must be installed on the called one’s phone too.

BE AWARE OF SPAM CALLS
You can mark numbers as spam and receive a notification if they call again: You can mark a selected number as spam, get alerted when it calls back, and choose not to answer the call. 
Marking a number does not block it; it simply triggers a warning.

BE UNREACHABLE WITH DO NOT DISTURB
If you want to be unreachable but at the same time keep your phone on, UpCall is the solution for you!
The callers will hear the announcement that "the person you are calling cannot be reached". But you can keep on using your phone and making calls.

CUSTOMIZE OPERATOR NAME
With UpCall, you can change the operator name on the screen of your mobile phone.

CHOOSE YOUR TONE FOR THE CALLERS 
You can choose a tone for the callers that they can listen to while your phone is ringing. Thus, you can inform why you can’t pick up the phone.

ALL YOUR CALLS NOW ON ONE SCREEN
Unlike your phone's call screen, you can see all your calls on a single screen. For example, you can learn from your call records, who called you when your mobile is turned off or busy or when the called ones are reachable. You can receive service notifications for call services (KimAramış, CepAçık, ŞimdiAra, KimArıyor…etc) within the application instead of SMS. You must have a subscription to search services for this feature.

* This application can be used by all operator subscribers in Turkey. Some features are only available to Turkcell subscribers due to network restrictions. 

For details and Frequently Asked Questions, you can visit  https://www.turkcell.com.tr/servisler/upcall#sss

bluejetty:00015418:ios.description:
Make the most of your visit with the Longleat App! 
The Longleat App is the perfect, pocket-sized guide to our iconic Safari Park. 
Jam-packed with fascinating facts, interactive maps, curious quiz questions and handy reminders; our app will serve you intriguing information based on where you are and ensure that you don’t miss a thing as you explore the park. 
App Highlights: 
- Safari Drive Mode! As you immerse yourself in the animal kingdom and discover the UK’s original safari park, the app will become your personal tour guide. Using an interactive map, audio will automatically play as you venture into each safari enclosure. 
- Don't miss a moment. Eager to enjoy a House tour? Hoping to hop aboard our Safari Bus? Check out the day planner to see what’s happening at the park throughout the day and even set yourself helpful reminders. 
- Discover more! Learn more about our animals than ever before. Whether you’re enjoying the Jungle Cruise, exploring Main Square or taking a wild ride in the Safari Drive Through, tap on a species to enjoy our creature quiz, read fascinating facts and learn more about Longleat’s conservation work. 
- Live park updates. Keep an eye on the app or watch for push notifications from us – offering you live event information, notable news, exclusive special offers and unmissable upgrades. 
So what are you waiting for? Adventure calls…

bluejetty:00153665:ios.description:
Boost Your Stamina, Increase Firmness, and Gain More Control in just 5 Minutes a Day.
StayUp is designed for men who want to take ownership of their health and build lasting physical confidence. Whether your goal is improving endurance, building strength, or gaining more control, it starts here.
StayUp strengthens the muscles that truly matter. It’s simple, fast, and powerful - when you show up and commit.
We’ll give you the plan, the tools, and the system to build strength, last longer, and feel in control when it matters most.
KEGEL TRAINING PLAN – The Foundation for Stronger Men's Health
Our Kegel Training Plan is a step-by-step system focused on strengthening the Pelvic Floor (PF) muscles, which run from your tailbone to your pubic bone. These muscles are involved in core stability and support bladder and bowel control.
Without regular training, PF muscles can weaken over time, but like any muscle group, they can be strengthened through targeted, consistent exercise.
Personalized to You:
This is not a one-size-fits-all program. Your workouts dynamically adjust based on your progress and your unique needs. Whether you're starting strong or looking for foundational improvements, the plan evolves with you.
Proven Results:
Recent studies show significant improvements when men consistently train these muscles. In fact, over 80% of users report measurable benefits in both strength and control over time.
Simple, Discreet, and Effective:
* Just 5 minutes per day
* Guided instructions synced with your phone’s vibration
* Private and flexible - exercise anytime, anywhere
* No equipment needed
* The difficulty automatically adjusts as you progress
Why It Works:
Weak pelvic floor muscles are a hidden cause of many men’s health concerns. By improving the strength and tone of this foundational muscle group, you can build stamina, control, and overall performance.
ALL THE ABOVE MAKES STAYUP A COMPREHENSIVE SOLUTION FOR IMPROVING MEN’S SEXUAL HEALTH

The use of this app does not establish a doctor-patient or any other professional healthcare relationship. It is recommended to consult a healthcare professional before starting any exercises or making lifestyle changes.

高效练琴神器：练琴进步快，就用小叶子
【精准纠错——行业领先的纠音准确率99.99%】
弹对音符变绿，弹错光标停止不前，停顿超5秒给予键盘提示，错音、漏音、错节奏及时纠正，辅助黄色小键盘标识，提升识谱能力，不懂钢琴，也能一眼识别练琴错误！
【个性指导——效率更高，回课进度快】
多维度评分，个性化练琴方案，分手、合手练习，智能分析练琴问题，找到薄弱环节，筛选练习重点，有效练习，进步更快！
【打分排行榜——激发练琴积极性】
每次练琴都有打分，进步看得见，还能与全国千万琴童一起PK，练琴更主动！
【入门到十级——10万+海量钢琴琴谱、乐理题库】
古典到流行，入门到十级，小汤到大汤、车尔尼到莫扎特，想要演奏的曲谱，即刻智能为你找到。乐理动画系列故事、钢琴考级必备，帮助孩子学习乐理知识，激发练琴兴趣！
零基础趣味学琴：学琴进步快，就用小叶子
【铃木音乐教学法+权威教材——专业学琴，效果好】
通过“学、练、演、测、拓”五个环节，让零基础学习者真正感受音乐艺术、轻松掌握演奏技巧。
【游戏化学习趣味互动——学琴不枯燥，简单易学】
游戏化学习，利用人工智能技术进行趣味互动，赏析，节奏游戏训练、趣味问答、演奏练习等多个环节，让学琴有趣，不枯燥！

bluejetty:00014440:ios.description:
MindMeister is the one and only mobile mind mapping app you’ll ever need. Whether you’re using it in the boardroom, the classroom, the presentation hall, or the lunch meeting, MindMeister can help you organize, prioritize, and even generate new thoughts.
Designed from the ground up as an extension to our award-winning, browser-based interface, the MindMeister app stores your mobile creations and seamlessly syncs them with your online account.
Feature highlights in the free “Basic” plan:
- Create up to three free mind maps 
- Seamlessly sync maps and folders with your free online account
- Multi-touch support for drag & drop, zoom, pan
- Add icons, colors, styles and map themes
- View and edit notes, links, tasks and attachments on ideas
- Draw connections between nodes
- Play presentations
- Share maps directly from the device
- Real-time collaboration
Additional features in the “Personal” plan:
- Create and edit unlimited mind maps
- Add files and images to topics
- Export maps in PDF and PNG format
- Priority support
Additional features in the “Pro” plan:
- Export maps in MS Word and MS PowerPoint format
- Export slides as zip file
NOTE: Requires a free account registration.
The “Basic” version of MindMeister is free. You can try the “Personal” plan free for 1 week after signing up! If you enjoy your “Personal” trial, do nothing and your membership will automatically continue as an auto-renewing month-to-month subscription.
If you subscribe via iTunes: Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of your selected plan above.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings on the device.
If you haven’t subscribed through iTunes, you can manage your subscription through MindMeister.
Privacy policy: https://www.mindmeister.com/privacy
Terms of use: https://www.mindmeister.com/legal

bluejetty:00182858:ios.name: Horse Hotel - care for horses
bluejetty:00182858:ios.summary:
Horse Hotel makes you the owner of your own horse ranch. Take care of the horses, look after their needs, and discover exciting games, until they return to their owners happy.
***RUN YOUR OWN HORSE HOTEL***
Manage your own hotel for horses
bluejetty:00182858:ios.description:
Horse Hotel makes you the owner of your own horse ranch. Take care of the horses, look after their needs, and discover exciting games, until they return to their owners happy.
***RUN YOUR OWN HORSE HOTEL***
Manage your own hotel for horses! You are responsible for their health and well-being. There is enough space on your green pastures for all horses. Each horse has to be examined in order to see if it’s healthy. Feed them, nurse them, and play with them. Make sure they have everything they need before they go back to their owners.
***EXCITING HORSE GAMES AND CHALLENGES***
There are a lot of different horse breeds waiting for you, and each breed has its own individual needs. Take a look at the horse’s file to find out what exactly the horse needs. This will help you to provide the best care for the horse. If your horse needs more endurance play the obstacle course minigame. If the horse is lacking in confidence, you can build it up with flatwork exercises in the riding arena. To increase its ability, just play the dressage minigame. But one thing all horses have in common: they need your affection, so don’t neglect to give them treats and pet them!
***EXPAND YOUR HOTEL TO TAKE IN MORE GUESTS***
To turn your horse ranch into a luxurious hotel, you will find lots of expansions in the shop which will create more space for more horses. But bear in mind that the bigger your hotel gets, the more demanding your guests will become. Earn more coins by completing missions so you can afford to improve your hotel and take care of more and more horses. Besides maintaining your hotel, caring for your horses is the order of the day: clean out their stables everyday so all the horses enjoy a comfortable stay with you!
• Run your own hotel for horses and turn it into a luxurious hotel
• Discover exciting minigames
• Feed and take care of different breeds of horse
• Collect coins, complete quests, and spin the wheel of fortune
Visit us on Facebook: facebook.com/tivolamobile

Never buy the wrong hair product again. And never wonder what to do next.

Scan any hair product for an instant match to YOUR hair, then meet Hannah, your personal AI hair coach, for answers, plans, and product picks made for you. 

Join 60,000+ people getting their best hair with hair2hair, the #1 Hair Care App in the App Store.

Free to download. Free scans and Hannah messages included every week.

SCAN IT. KNOW IN SECONDS.
Point your camera at any shampoo, conditioner, mask, oil, or styler. hair2hair reads the barcode or label and tells you if it's a Perfect fit, Could work, or Not for you, based on your hair type, porosity, concerns, and goals. Not a generic score. Yours.

MEET HANNAH, YOUR HAIR COACH (NEW)
Hannah knows your hair profile, your routine, and what you've been using. Ask her anything:
• "My ends feel dry no matter what I use"
• "What should I do on day 3 hair?"
• "Is this shampoo okay for color-treated hair?"
She answers for your hair, not the internet's, and hands you product picks that fit your routine.

SNAP A PHOTO. GET REAL ANSWERS. (NEW)
Send Hannah a photo of your hair and she'll tell you what's going on: frizz, dryness, buildup, breakage, and what to do about it tonight.

BIG WEEK? HANNAH PLANS IT. (NEW)
Wedding, beach trip, first day back at work. Tell Hannah what's coming and she plans your wash days, prep, and styling around it, right in your calendar.

A ROUTINE YOU'LL ACTUALLY STICK TO
Check off your steps from the Home screen in seconds. Log how your hair felt. Set a once-a-day reminder that fits your evening.

SEE WHAT'S ACTUALLY WORKING (NEW)
Your logs plus your reactions equal proof, not guesswork. See how often you had a good hair day with a product versus without it, then keep what delivers and drop what doesn't.

KNOW WHAT'S REALLY INSIDE
Every ingredient explained in plain language: the heroes, the helpers, and the tricky ones, with a personal note on why each one matters for your hair.

PICKED FOR YOUR HAIR GOALS
Frizz, volume, growth, curls, shine, scalp health. Browse thousands of products matched to your profile, and see which ones are available where you live.

WHAT PEOPLE SAY
"A total game changer. I can see what products work for my hair before even buying them."
"When my hair is curly this app is a life saver!!"
"This app motivates me to keep up my routine."

WORKS FOR EVERY HAIR TYPE
Straight, wavy, curly, or coily. Fine or thick. Low or high porosity. Color-treated, heat-styled, or natural. Your profile drives everything.

hair2hair Premium unlocks unlimited scans and product verdicts, unlimited routine regeneration, and more time with Hannah. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://hair2hair-2-3.on-forge.com/privacypolicy
Terms of Use: https://hair2hair-2-3.on-forge.com/termsofservice

Download now and scan your first product in under 30 seconds.

bluejetty:00098861:ios.description:
Start in chill, build at will
A cold wave is sweeping across the Three Kingdoms. The lovely refugee girl, Xiao Zhen, stands by, rubbing her hands and watching you expectantly…
Let’s build a bonfire, gather your brothers and sisters, and start chopping wood to build your home together! My Lord, with Xiao Zhen by your side, conquering the Three Kingdoms has never been more relaxing, play smart and win with ease!
[Rescue Refugees—Light a Bonfire for Warmth and Friendship]
Refugees quickly become a hardworking team! Manage them easily with the new Morale System: assign jobs, handle various resident events to boost morale, and unlock special skills that make your settlement more efficient!
[Friends at Work—Team Up for Greater Success]
Invite your friends with our innovative Guest Worker system! Bring your buddies into the city to help out. Daily interactions boost your friendship and their productivity, building your dream city has never been more fun or effective.
[Gather Resources, Build Your City—Easy and Relaxed]
Cut trees, mine, and hunt to gather resources, build houses, barracks and more. Expand your territory step by step, recruit new troops, and strengthen your forces so you’re always ready for war!
[Casual Gameplay—Enjoy a Fun Twist on the Three Kingdoms]
Enjoy a variety of mini-games! Test your wits in the Clash of Steeds challenge, optimize your strategies in resource escort and raids, and experience the Three Kingdoms in a fresh, immersive way.
[Boss Battles—Form Powerful Teams with Legendary Heroes]
Log in for 7 days to receive powerful SSR Heroes like Diao Chan and Guo Jia! Upgrading heroes is easy. Everyone shares in the level-up benefits, so there’s no hassle over resource allocation. Build a powerful team, use auto-expedition to take on World Bosses anytime, and keep collecting resources even while offline!
[Expand Territory—Conquer the Land with Ease]
Join alliances to siege cities and heal injured troops with just one tap, even when you’re offline, allies can manage your teams for you. World conquest is simple. No need to grind endlessly! Rally your like-minded friends, expand your alliance, and compete to become Asia’s strongest leader in the Three Kingdoms!

bluejetty:00061757:ios.name: Tigo Energy Intelligence
bluejetty:00061757:ios.summary:
Tigo Energy’s next generation Energy Intelligence (EI) mobile application is the most powerful asset management and commissioning solution for your Smart Solar PV array. 
Lay out, configure, commission, and monitor your system all from you
bluejetty:00061757:ios.description:
Tigo Energy’s next generation Energy Intelligence (EI) mobile application is the most powerful asset management and commissioning solution for your Smart Solar PV array. 
Lay out, configure, commission, and monitor your system all from your mobile phone. This application not only monitors your array, but it also enables you to interface directly with Tigo's Cloud Connect Advanced (CCA) software via local Bluetooth technology. This enables installers to configure Tigo systems, troubleshoot system issues on-site, set up the connection to the internet, and much more.
Similar to Tigo’s web-based software, you can see a system or fleet of systems with an intuitive interface. Once you download the EI app, you will be able to manage your system on-the-go from anywhere in the world.
Your smart solar array, optimized by Tigo, automatically detects problems and will alert you when there are issues that need your attention. Once the system is configured, you can see module-level detail and historical data to ensure you’re getting the most from your solar investment.
You can demo the software even before you have installed a system. Download the app today, and click the demo button to see what it looks like. You can also log in to our website for a demo of our online software at www.tigoenergy.com. 
Tigo's basic monitoring service enables you to see module-level data for free. Download today to see how to get the most out of your solar system.

- Comments management with advanced filtering and search

• Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited, as soon as you purchase a subscription.
• You can view our Privacy Policy here: https://innovatty.com/instagram/InsTrack/privacy.html

bluejetty:00126742:ios.description:
What child is not fascinated by bugs? With “The Bugs I: Insects?” you will enjoy discovering insects with lovely animations and games. Meet ants, bees, beetles, butterflies ... A fun and educational game for the most curious children!
" The Bugs I: Insects?" is the perfect app for learning about insects. With simple texts, educational games and incredible illustrations, children will learn basic information about insects: how they live, what they feed on, metamorphosis, etc.
This app also has lots of educational games to play without any rules, stress, or time limits. Suitable for all ages!
CHARACTERISTICS 
• To learn basic information about the most fun insects.
• To discover curiosities about the insects: Why do ants walk in a row? What do insects use antennas for?
• With dozens of educational games: create your own bug, dress the beekeepers, find the stick insects, make the butterfly cycle ...
• Completely narrated. Perfect for non-readers and children who are just starting to read.
• Content suitable for children aged 4 and over. Games for the whole family. Hours of fun.
• No Ads.
WHY " The Bugs I: Insects?"?
Because it is a user-friendly educational app that excites children with educational games and nice illustrations about bugs and insects. Download it now to:
• Discover fun insects and play with them.
• Learn about insects: what are they and how do they live?
• Bees, ants, beetles, butterflies, stick insects, ladybugs, praying mantises ...
• Play fun and educational games.
• Enjoy educational entertainment.
Children love to play and learn about bugs through games. " The Bugs I: Insects?" contains explanations, illustrations, realistic images and games about bugs and insects.
ABOUT LEARNY LAND
At Learny Land, we love to play, and we believe that games must form part of the educational and growth stage of all children; because to play is to discover, explore, learn and have fun. Our educational games help children learn about the world around them and are designed with love. They are easy to use, beautiful and safe. Because boys and girls have always played to have fun and learn, the games we make - like the toys that last a lifetime - can be seen, played and heard.
At Learny Land we take advantage of the most innovative technologies and the most modern devices to take the experience of learning and playing a step further. We create toys that could not have existed when we were young.
Read more about us at www.learnyland.com.
Privacy Policy
We take Privacy very seriously. We do not collect or share personal information about your children or allow any type of third party ads. To learn more, please read our privacy policy at www.learnyland.com.
Contact us
We'd love to know your opinion and your suggestions. Please, write to support@learnyland.com.
Terms of Use: http://learnyland.com/terms-of-service/
