bluejetty:00157723:ios.description:
Discover Oahu with GyPSy Guide, the most trusted and loved app for exploring Hawaii’s island paradise. With 340+ audio points that play automatically along the scenic drives, experience the island’s top sights and hidden gems through 4 incredible tours filled with fascinating stories and stunning scenery.
1) Oahu Island Circle Drive: Experience Oahu’s highlights with a full-circle route featuring lush rainforests, coastal cliffs, and scenic lookouts.
2) Beaches & Volcanoes: Explore pristine beaches, volcanic craters, and iconic spots like Diamond Head and Hanauma Bay.
3) North Shore Loop: Discover world-famous surf beaches, the charming town of Haleiwa, and peaceful tropical valleys.
4) Pearl Harbor: Step back in time at this historic site, honoring the events of World War II and the legacy of its heroes.
COMING SOON:
Explore more of Oahu on foot with our new Waikiki and Honolulu walking tours—perfect for uncovering hidden gems and local stories!
With GyPSy Guide, explore Oahu's stunning beaches, iconic landmarks, and rich culture. Enjoy expertly curated audio tours that reveal breathtaking coastlines, lush valleys, and historic treasures, making every moment of your journey unforgettable.
Why Choose GyPSy Guide for Oahu?
‣ Your Island Insider: Immerse yourself in the aloha spirit with stories and insights from local guides who truly know Oahu—its moolelo (legends), aina (land), and hidden treasures.
‣ GPS-Triggered Audio Stories: Explore effortlessly with GPS-guided storytelling. Discover secret beaches, fascinating paniolo (cowboy) history, and local travel tips—all while you drive.
‣ Expertly Curated Routes: Navigate like a kamaaina (local)! GyPSy Guide highlights iconic landmarks, off-the-beaten-path gems, and must-see attractions to create an unforgettable Hawaiian journey.
‣ No Signal? No Problem: Enjoy stress-free travel! Our tours work offline, using GPS to guide you through Oahu’s scenic routes and remote corners. No Wi-Fi or data is needed. 
What to Expect: Oahu offers a perfect blend of natural beauty and cultural heritage, from iconic surf beaches and lush valleys to historic sites and breathtaking coastal drives—making every journey an unforgettable experience.
GyPSy Guide: It’s Just Like Having a Tour Guide in Your Car
‣ Explore at Your Own Pace: Set your own pace with GyPSy Guide, whether exploring the vibrant streets of Honolulu, relaxing on world-famous beaches, or discovering hidden gems along the coast.
‣ Must-See Stops: Visit top attractions like Pearl Harbor, Diamond Head, and the North Shore while uncovering local secrets along the way.
‣ Top Highlights: With hours of exploration ahead, discover Oahu’s most iconic sights and uncover insider tips to make the most of your adventure. Immerse yourself in the island’s rich culture and history through engaging audio commentary that brings its stories to life.
What You’ll See:
Some of the highlights along the route include:
‣ Hanauma Bay
‣ Diamond Head Crater
‣ Byodo-In Temple
‣ Pali Lookout
‣ Kailua & Lanikai
‣ Laie Sea Arch
‣ North Shore Surf Spots
‣ Haleiwa Town
‣ Dole Plantation
‣ Pearl Harbor
Bonus Perks:
‣ NO EXPIRY: TOURS NEVER EXPIRE—REVISIT ANYTIME.
‣ Regular Updates: Get the latest on roads and attractions.
Hear the Aloha Spirit in Every Word:
‣ “GyPSy Guide transformed our Oahu trip! The audio was fun, informative, and easy to follow. We discovered so much more than we ever would on our own.”
‣ “Absolutely fantastic! Cannot recommend it enough. We came to love the narrator so much we gave him a name! Directions were far better than GPS. Thanks for helping us make our Hawaiian vacation so pleasurable. Will use this guide at other locations.”
Important Info:
‣ iPad Compatibility: Use an iPad with GPS (WiFi + Cellular) for full functionality.
‣ Battery: GPS drains battery—bring a car charger.

bluejetty:00018280:ios.description:
Punto Pago is an innovative app that provides a convenient and fast way to issue Mastercard debit and virtual cards, as well as a marketplace with over 120,000 products and more than 105 categories. It promotes a new way of buying online from local businesses and retailers, based on fair trade principles.
The app includes a variety of features, such as:
 • Free and fast Mastercard issuance and approval within 2 minutes, eliminating the need to go to a bank.
 • A marketplace with unique offers on products from various categories, with the option for free delivery.
 • A wallet feature for easy online shopping, paying for services, and earning cashback.
Punto Pago Mastercard holders can also enjoy additional benefits such as:
 • Free card delivery to your doorstep or at any Punto Pago kiosks.
 • Free card maintenance and the ability to freeze and control expenses at any time through the app.
 • Smart integration with the Punto Pago wallet.
The app also offers secure and protected payment options, a refund guarantee for any issues with products, and a dedicated customer service team to assist with any questions or concerns.
To learn more about Punto Pago, visit their website at www.puntopago.net, contact them via email at info@puntopago.net, or call them at (507) 399 3999. 
They also have a WhatsApp number 6262-5817 for support.

apple-macos:6758256022.name: MorningsideMunch: Dining @ CU
apple-macos:6758256022.description:
MorningsideMunch puts every Columbia dining hall on one map, with live open/closed status, today's hours and full menus. No PDFs, no digging through websites.
Key features:
• Live status for every hall: open, closing soon, opens soon
• See how busy a hall is right now, where Columbia reports it
• Full menus by meal period and station, with allergens and dietary tags
• Build-your-own counters listed in full: cheeses, dressings, proteins, toppings
• Menus for the next 7 days
• Map-first discovery with nearby halls at a glance
• Search by hall or by food, filtered by your dietary preferences
• Alerts an hour before and when halls open or close, for every hall or just the ones you pick
• Favorite halls stay pinned to the top
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• An Apple Watch app with live status and menus on your wrist
• Columbia Dining news and events, with a notification when new articles go up
• Made for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch, in light and dark mode
Built by students for students, MorningsideMunch is designed around how campus dining actually works: busy days, late nights, and quick decisions.
Founded by CEO Hassam Gani, CTO Naowal Rahman, and CIO Farhaan Siddiqui.

apple-itunes:1567623251.name: Krew Social
apple-itunes:1567623251.description:
A world where everyone has their people.
Krew Social helps you find your people in the communities you belong to, like your workplace, campus or unit. See in-person hangouts near you, know who's going, and walk in with something to talk about.
HOW IT WORKS
Browse hangouts: see what's happening across your community and request to join.
Know who's going: view attendee profiles and the interests you share before you go.
Meet your people: Krew suggests hangouts with members of your Krew and new people who have things in common with you.
Build your Krew: add friends for any activity or interest.
Keep it going: stay in touch with your group in group chat.
WHY IT WORKS
The U.S. Surgeon General's 2023 advisory, Our Epidemic of Loneliness and Isolation, calls for strengthening social connection in our communities, workplaces and schools. Krew does it the way that works: small groups of people with a lot in common, doing what they love together, in person.
JOIN YOUR COMMUNITY
Join the community your organization set up for you, or join the public community near you.
People stay where they have their people.
